es.e: an apple tree
es.c: 苹果树

es.e: roast pork and apple sauce (=  a thick sauce made from cooked apples  )
es.c: 烤猪肉配苹果酱汁

d: n 色拉；尤指莴苣 a mixture of raw vegetables, especially  lettuce  ,  cucumber  , and tomato

es.e: Would you like some salad with your pasta?
es.c: 你的意大利面要配些色拉吗？

es.e: a spinach salad
es.c: 菠菜色拉

d: n 兔子，野兔 a small animal with long ears and soft fur, that lives in a hole in the ground；v 让…见鬼去吧

es.e: The rabbit disappeared in the bushes.
es.c: 那只兔子消失在树丛中。

es.e: At this time, a robust rabbit said: "No, or eat me !
es.c: 这时，一只健壮的兔子又说：“不，还是先吃我吧！

d: pron 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人 used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people；n (We)人名；(缅)韦

es.e: ‘Did you go into the supermarket?’ ‘No, we didn’t.’
es.c: “你们进超级市场了吗？”“我们没有进去。”

es.e: Shall we stop for a coffee?
es.c: 我们停下来喝杯咖啡好吗？

es.e: So we all travelled down to Brighton together.
es.c: 所以我们一起都去了布赖顿。

d: pron 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属；来信，尊函 used when speaking or writing to one or more people to refer to something that belongs to them or is connected with them；adj 你（们）的（东西）；信末署名前用语

es.e: This is our room, and yours is just across the hall.
es.c: 这是我们的房间，你们的在走廊那边。

es.e: A lot of people have money problems, but yours are more serious than most people’s.
es.c: 许多人有财务问题，不过你的问题比大多数人的要严重。

es.e: A cash prize of £10,000 or a new car – the choice is yours.
es.c: 一万英镑的奖金或一辆新车——随你选择。

d: n 商店；店铺 a building or part of a building where you can buy things, food, or services；v 购物 to go to one or more shops to buy things

es.e: a barber’s shop
es.c: 理发店

es.e: a fish-and-chip shop
es.c: 炸鱼薯条店

es.e: the local shops
es.c: 当地的商店

d: pron 他们的；她们的；它们的 used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with people that have already been mentioned

es.e: When our washing machine broke, our neighbours let us use theirs.
es.c: 我们的洗衣机坏了的时候，邻居就让我们用他们的。

es.e: Our house is number 25, and theirs is just opposite.
es.c: 我们的房子是25号，他们的就在对面。

es.e: We compared scores and found that theirs were higher than ours.
es.c: 我们比较了一下，发现他们的得分比我们的高。

d: adj [气象][物] 潮湿的；有雨的 covered in or full of water or another liquid；n 雨天；湿气 the rain；v 弄湿 to make something wet

es.e: I’ve washed your shirt but it’s still wet.
es.c: 我把你的衬衫洗过了，不过现在还是湿的。

es.e: wet grass
es.c: 湿草地

es.e: The man in the boat was wet through (= completely wet ).
es.c: 船上的那人浑身湿透。

d: v 呼喊；喊叫；大声说 to say something very loudly；n 呼喊；呼叫 a loud call expressing anger, pain, excitement etc

es.e: There’s no need to shout! I can hear you!
es.c: 用不着大声喊叫！我听得见！

es.e: ‘Watch out!’she shouted, as the car started to move.
es.c: “小心！”汽车开动时，她大声喊道。

d: n (女士)手提袋；(国家、家庭、团体等的) 财力 a bag in which a woman carries her money and personal things；v （嘴巴）皱起，使缩拢；撅嘴 if you purse your lips, you bring them together tightly into a small circle, especially to show disapproval or doubt

es.e: I locked the door and dropped the keys in my purse.
es.c: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

d: adj 现代的，近代的；时髦的 belonging to the present time or most recent time；n 现代人；有思想的人

es.e: Such companies must change if they are to compete in the modern world .
es.c: 此类公司如果想在现代社会中与别人竞争，就必须有所改变。

es.e: They are the youngest children in modern times to face murder charges.
es.c: 他们是近代面临谋杀指控儿童中年龄最小的。

es.e: Smaller families are a feature of modern society .
es.c: 家庭规模变小是现代社会的一个特征。

d: v 表达；快递 to tell or show what you are feeling or thinking by using words, looks, or actions；adj 明确的；迅速的；专门的 clear and definite；n 快车，快递，专使；捷运公司 a train or bus that does not stop in many places and therefore travels quickly

es.e: Parents have expressed their concerns about their children’s safety.
es.c: 父母对自己孩子的安全表示忧虑。

es.e: She expressed an interest in seeing York.
es.c: 她表示有兴趣见见约克。

es.e: Many people have expressed their opposition to the proposals.
es.c: 许多人反对这些提议。

d: n 黑板 a board with a dark smooth surface, used in schools for writing on with  chalk

es.e: He chalked out a design on the blackboard.
es.c: 他用粉笔在黑板上勾划出一个图样。

es.e: She rubbed the exercises off the blackboard after class.
es.c: 下课后她把习题从黑板上擦掉。

es.e: The teacher knocked on the blackboard to catch our attention.
es.c: 老师敲了敲黑板以引起我们的注意。

d: n 仆人，佣人；公务员；雇工 someone, especially in the past, who was paid to clean someone’s house, cook for them, answer the door etc, and who often lived in the house

es.e: Many young girls became domestic servants .
es.c: 许多年轻姑娘成了家仆。

d: n 嗜好；业余爱好 an activity that you enjoy doing in your free time

es.e: What are your hobbies?
es.c: 你有些什么爱好？

es.e: Susan’s hobbies include reading, cooking, and drama.
es.c: 苏珊的业余爱好包括阅读、烹饪和戏剧。

es.e: Retirement gave him the time to pursue his hobbies.
es.c: 退休以后他有充裕的时间来做自己喜欢做的事。

d: n 冬季；年岁；萧条期 the season after autumn and before spring, when the weather is coldest；v 过冬 to spend the winter somewhere；adj 冬天的；越冬的

es.e: Soon it will be winter.
es.c: 很快要到冬天了。

d: n 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼 a living thing that has leaves and roots and grows in earth, especially one that is smaller than a tree；v 种植；培养；栽培；安置 to put plants or seeds in the ground to grow

es.e: Don’t forget to water the plants.
es.c: 别忘记给植物浇水。

d: adj 巨大的；庞大的；无限的 extremely large in size, amount, or degree；n (Huge)人名；(英)休奇

es.e: a huge dog
es.c: 一条大狗

es.e: huge crowds
es.c: 大群大群的人

es.e: Your room’s huge compared to mine.
es.c: 你的房间跟我的比很大。

d: adj 高的；长的；过分的；夸大的 a person, building, tree etc that is tall is a greater height than normal；adv 夸大地；n (Tall)人名；(马里、阿拉伯)塔勒；(芬、罗、瑞典)塔尔；(英)托尔；(土)塔勒

es.e: He was young and tall.
es.c: 他年轻，身材高大。

es.e: a house surrounded by tall trees
es.c: 大树环绕的房子

es.e: This bush grows tall very quickly.
es.c: 这种灌木很快就能长高。

d: adj 富有的；肥沃的；昂贵的 containing a lot of something；n (Rich)人名；(丹)里克；(捷)里赫；(英、西)里奇；(葡、法)里什 The rich are rich people

es.e: Rich mineral deposits have been found in the sea bed.
es.c: 海底发现有丰富的矿床。

es.e: Red meat is a rich source of iron.
es.c: 红肉含有大量铁质。

es.e: This is a system in which the rich are taken care of and the poor are left to suffer.
es.c: 这是个富人受关照，而穷人遭罪的制度。

d: v 使喜欢；使高兴，使满意 to make someone happy or satisfied；int 请（礼貌用语） used to be polite when asking someone to do something

es.e: a business that wants to please its customers
es.c: 希望让顾客满意的一家公司

es.e: She did everything she could to please him.
es.c: 她千方百计讨好他。

es.e: Most children are eager to please .
es.c: 大多数孩子都渴望取悦别人。

d: v 油漆；绘画；装饰；涂色于；描绘；（用语言，文字等）描写；擦脂粉等 to put paint on a surface；n 油漆；颜料，涂料；绘画作品；胭脂等化妆品；色彩，装饰 a liquid that you put on a surface, using a brush to make the surface a particular colour

es.e: The ceiling needs painting.
es.c: 天花板需要粉刷了。

es.e: brightly paintedhouses
es.c: 粉刷得很亮丽的房屋

es.e: The living room was painted in pastel shades of pink and blue.
es.c: 起居室被漆成淡雅的粉色和蓝色。

d: n 商业；[贸易] 生意；[贸易] 交易；事情 the activity of making money by producing or buying and selling goods, or providing services

es.e: Students on the course learn about all aspects of business.
es.c: 这门课程的学生要学习商业活动的各个方面。

es.e: Carl began in the music business by running a recording studio.
es.c: 卡尔是从经营录音棚开始干音乐这一行的。

es.e: We do business with a number of Italian companies.
es.c: 我们和一些意大利公司做生意。

d: adv 已经，早已；先前 before now, or before a particular time

es.e: The design of the new house is similar to those that have already been built.
es.c: 新房的设计与那些已建好的房子相似。

es.e: The performance had already started when we arrived.
es.c: 我们到达时表演已经开始了。

d: adj 勇敢的；华丽的 dealing with danger, pain, or difficult situations with courage and confidence；v 勇敢地面对 to deal with a difficult, dangerous, or unpleasant situation；n 勇士 a young fighting man from a Native American tribe

es.e: brave soldiers
es.c: 勇敢的士兵

es.e: her brave fight against cancer
es.c: 她与癌症的勇敢搏斗

d: v 继续，延续；仍旧，连续 to not stop happening, existing, or doing something

es.e: He will be continuing his education in the US.
es.c: 他将在美国继续求学。

es.e: I felt too sick to continue.
es.c: 我感觉很难受，无法继续下去了。

d: n 猫，猫科动物 to pretend to allow someone to do or have what they want, and then to stop them from doing or having it

es.e: The police played an elaborate game of cat and mouse to trap him.
es.c: 警方跟他玩了一场精心布局的猫捉老鼠游戏，诱他落网。

d: v 发现；发觉 to find someone or something, either by accident or because you were looking for them

es.e: The body was discovered in a field.
es.c: 尸体是在一块田地里找到的。

es.e: Forest Service crews often discover campfires that have not been put out completely.
es.c: 林务局工作人员常常发现未完全熄灭的营火。

d: n 焦炭；可卡因；可口可乐（Coca-Cola） the drink Coca-Cola, or a bottle, can, or glass of this drink；v 焦化

es.e: ...a coke-burning stove.
es.c: …一个烧焦炭的炉子。

d: v 转动，使旋转；转弯；翻过来；兑换 to move your body so that you are looking in a different direction；n 转弯；变化；(损害或有益于别人的)行为，举动，举止 a sudden or unexpected change that makes a situation develop in a different way

es.e: Ricky turned and walked away.
es.c: 里基转身走了。

es.e: She turned her head in surprise.
es.c: 她惊讶地转过头来。

es.e: Brigitte glared at him, turned on her heel (= turned away suddenly because of anger ) , and stomped out of the room.
es.c: 布丽吉特瞪了他一眼，猛地一转身，噔噔噔地走出了房间。

d: v 蒸，散发；用蒸汽处理 if something steams, steam rises from it, especially because it is hot；n 蒸汽；精力 the hot mist that water produces when it is boiled；adj 蒸汽的

es.e: A pot was steaming on top of the cooker.
es.c: 锅在炉子上冒着热气。

d: n [电子] 视频；录像，录像机；电视 a copy of a film or television programme, or a series of events, recorded on videotape；adj 视频的；录像的；电视的 relating to or used in the process of recording and showing pictures on television；v 录制 to record

es.e: Let’s stay at home and watch a video.
es.c: 我们待在家里看录像吧。

es.e: Rewind the video right to the beginning.
es.c: 把录像倒退到开头部分。

es.e: The school will be making a video of the play.
es.c: 学校将把这出戏拍摄成录像。

d: adj 愚蠢的；麻木的；乏味的 showing a lack of good sense or good judgment；n 傻瓜，笨蛋 an insulting way of talking to someone who you think is being stupid

es.e: stupid mistakes
es.c: 愚蠢的错误

es.e: That was a stupid thing to say.
es.c: 那样说可真傻。

es.e: I can’t believe Kate was stupid enough to get involved in this.
es.c: 我简直不能相信凯特这么傻，会介入这件事情。

d: pron 任何事 any thing, event, situation etc, when it is not important to say exactly which

es.e: You can buy anything you want.
es.c: 你想要什么都可以买。

es.e: He was prepared to do anything to make a bit of money.
es.c: 只要能赚一点钱，他什么都愿意做。

es.e: Anything would be better than staying at home!
es.c: 做什么都比待在家里好！

d: n 交谈，会话；社交；交往，交际；会谈；（人与计算机的）人机对话 an informal talk in which people exchange news, feelings, and thoughts

es.e: a telephone conversation
es.c: 电话交谈

es.e: Children quickly get bored by adult conversation.
es.c: 儿童对成年人的谈话很快就会厌倦。

es.e: They had a short conversation in German and seemed to be disagreeing about something.
es.c: 他们用德语说了一会儿，好像对什么事有分歧。

d: n 部分；角色；零件；一些；片段 a piece or feature of something such as an object, area, event, or period of time；v 分离；分配；分开 to move the two sides of something apart, or to move apart, making a space in the middle；adv 部分地；adj 部分的 payme

es.e: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
es.c: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

d: n 门；家，户；门口；通道 the large flat piece of wood, glass etc that you move when you go into or out of a building, room, vehicle etc, or when you open a cupboard

es.e: Could you open the door for me?
es.c: 请你帮我开门好吗？

es.e: The door flew open and Ruth stormed in.
es.c: 门一下子打开了，露丝气冲冲地跑了进来。

es.e: Don’t forget to lock the garage door.
es.c: 别忘了把车库的门锁上。

d: adj 睡着的；麻木的；长眠的 sleeping；adv 熟睡地；进入睡眠状态

es.e: Quiet! The baby’s asleep.
es.c: 安静！ 宝宝在睡觉。

d: n 和平；平静；和睦；秩序 a situation in which there is no war or fighting

es.e: The country is at peace with its neighbours for the first time in years.
es.c: 这是多年来该国与其邻国第一次和平共处。

es.e: By the end of the century, France had made peace with Britain.
es.c: 到那个世纪末，法国和英国议和了。

es.e: a city where people of different religions have lived together in peace for centuries
es.c: 不同宗教的人们和平共处数百年的城市

d: adj 单一的；单身的；单程的 only one；n 一个；单打；单程票 a game, especially in tennis, in which one person plays on their own against another person；v 选出

es.e: A single tree gave shade from the sun.
es.c: 唯有一棵树遮阴。

es.e: They won the game by a single point.
es.c: 他们仅以一分的优势赢得比赛。

es.e: the highest price ever paid for a single work of art
es.c: 为单件艺术品所支付的最高价格

d: v 证明；检验；显示 to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc

es.e: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
es.c: 你错了，我可以证明。

es.e: To prove his point (= show that he was right ) , he mentioned several other experiments which had produced similar results.
es.c: 为了证明自己的观点，他提到了另外几个结果相似的实验。

d: n 步行，走；散步 a journey that you make by walking, especially for exercise or enjoyment；v 散步；走过 When you walk, you move forward by putting one foot in front of the other in a regular way

es.e: It’s a long walk. Maybe we should get the bus.
es.c: 走着去很远，或许我们应该乘公共汽车。

es.e: Rosanna and Forbes walked in silence.
es.c: 罗莎娜与福布斯默默地走着。

es.e: We walked into the foyer.
es.c: 我们走进前厅。

d: v 搜寻；调查；探求 to try to find someone or something by looking very carefully；n 搜寻；探究，查究 an attempt to find someone or something

es.e: It was too dark to search further.
es.c: 天太暗，无法继续寻找。

es.e: The area was thoroughly searched .
es.c: 这一地区已被彻底搜查过。

es.e: I’ve searched high and low (= everywhere ) for my glasses.
es.c: 我到处找我的眼镜。

d: n 棉花；棉布；棉线 cloth or thread made from the white hair of the cotton plant；v 一致；理解；和谐；亲近；adj 棉的；棉制的

es.e: a white cotton shirt
es.c: 白色棉布衬衫

es.e: Made from 100% cotton.
es.c: 百分之百纯棉制作。

d: n 胃；腹部；胃口 the organ inside your body where food begins to be  digested；v 忍受；吃下 to be able to accept something, especially something unpleasant

es.e: I was so hungry my stomach hurt.
es.c: 我饿得胃都痛了。

es.e: His stomach was full of food.
es.c: 他的胃里塞满了食物。

d: adj 共同的；普通的；一般的；通常的 happening often and to many people or in many places；n 普通；平民；公有地 a large area of open land in a town or village that people walk or play sport on

es.e: Heart disease is one of the commonest causes of death.
es.c: 心脏病是最常见的死因之一。

d: v 叫喊；哭出；大声说 to shout or say something loudly；n 叫喊；叫声；口号；呼叫 a loud sound expressing a strong emotion such as pain, fear, or pleasure

es.e: ‘Stop!’ she cried.
es.c: “停下！”她喊道。

es.e: It was painful, and made me cry aloud .
es.c: 这很痛，痛得我大叫起来。

d: adv 有时，间或 on some occasions but not always

es.e: I sometimes have to work late.
es.c: 我有时得工作到很晚。

es.e: Sometimes, Grandma would tell us stories about her childhood in Italy.
es.c: 有时候，祖母会跟我们讲讲她儿时在意大利的经历。

es.e: ‘Do you ever wish you were back in Japan?’ ‘Sometimes. Not very often.’
es.c: “你有没有想过希望回到日本？”“有时候吧，但不经常这么想。”

d: n 家乡；故乡 Someone's hometown is the town where they live or the town that they come from

es.e: Do you like your hometown?
es.c: 你喜欢你的家乡吗？

es.e: She expressed the wish to be interred in the graveyard of hometown.
es.c: 她表达了死后葬在故乡的墓地上的愿望。

d: n 标准；水准；旗；度量衡标准 the level that is considered to be acceptable, or the level that someone or something has achieved；adj 标准的；合规格的；公认为优秀的 accepted as normal or usual

es.e: Students have to reach a certain standard or they won’t pass.
es.c: 学生必须达到某一标准，否则无法通过。

es.e: The airline has rigorous safety standards.
es.c: 这家航空公司有严格的安全标准。

d: adj 下雪的，多雪的；被雪覆盖的；洁白无瑕的 with a lot of snow

es.e: the snowy fields
es.c: 被雪覆盖的田野

es.e: one snowy January day
es.c: 1月里大雪纷飞的一天

d: n 座位；所在地；职位 a place where you can sit, especially one in a vehicle or one from which you watch a performance, sports event etc；v 使…坐下；可容纳…的；使就职 If you seat yourself somewhere, you sit down

es.e: I was in the back seat and Jo was driving.
es.c: 我在后座，乔开车。

es.e: a 10,000-seat stadium
es.c: 万人体育场

es.e: People were shifting in their seats, looking uncomfortable.
es.c: 人们在座位上动来动去，看上去不大自在。

d: v 击鼓；大力争取 to play a drum；n 鼓；鼓声 a musical instrument made of skin stretched over a circular frame, played by hitting it with your hand or a stick

es.e: I could hear the rain drumming against the windows.
es.c: 我听到雨滴有节奏地打在窗上的声音。

es.c: 这里的犯人只是短期服刑。

es.c: 该组织正在争取释放政治犯。

d: n 叔叔；伯父；伯伯；舅父；姨丈；姑父 the brother of your mother or father, or the husband of your aunt

es.e: I went to stay with my uncle and aunt for a few days.
es.c: 我去和叔叔婶婶住了几天。

es.e: Uncle Philip
es.c: 菲利普叔叔

es.e: I was very excited about becoming an uncle(= your sister or your brother’s wife has a child ).
es.c: 要做舅舅了，我很激动。

d: n 笑；引人发笑的事或人 the act of laughing or the sound you make when you laugh；v 笑 to make sounds with your voice, usually while you are smiling, because you think something is funny

es.e: He gave a short laugh.
es.c: 他笑了一声。

d: adj 英国人的；英国的；英文的 relating to England or its people；n 英语；英国人；英文；英格兰人 the language used in Britain, the US, Australia, and some other countries；vt 把…译成英语

es.e: the English countryside
es.c: 英格兰乡村

es.e: under English law
es.c: 按照英格兰法律

d: n 农村，乡下；乡下的全体居民 land that is outside cities and towns

es.e: The house had lovely views over open countryside .
es.c: 这房子望出去是开阔的乡村美景。

d: adj 伟大的，重大的；极好的，好的；主要的 very large in amount or degree；n 大师；大人物；伟人们 a very successful and famous person in a particular sport, profession etc

es.e: The movie was a great success.
es.c: 这部影片大获成功。

es.e: The news came as possibly the greatest shock of my life.
es.c: 这个消息可能是我一生中最大的打击。

es.e: The paintings cost a great deal (= a lot ) of money.
es.c: 这些画价值不菲。

d: abbr 视频高密光盘（Video Compact Disc）；可变电容二极管（Variable Capacitance Diode）

adj 凉爽的；冷静的；出色的 low in temperature, but not cold, often in a way that feels pleasant；v 使…冷却；使…平静下来 to make something slightly colder, or to become slightly colder；n 凉爽；凉爽的空气 a temperature that is pleasantly cold；adv 冷静地

es.e: She swam out into the cool water.
es.c: 她往外游向清凉的水里。

es.e: The evening air was cool.
es.c: 夜晚的空气很凉爽。

es.e: Relax in the sun with a cool drink.
es.c: 在阳光下喝杯清凉饮料放松一下。

d: v 夹入；挤进；把做成三明治 If you sandwich two things together with something else, you put that other thing between them. If you sandwich one thing between two other things, you put it between them.；n 三明治；夹心面包 two pieces of bread w

es.e: Carefully split the sponge ring, then sandwich the two halves together with whipped cream.
es.c: 小心地切开海绵蛋糕圈，然后在两半中间夹上生奶油。

d: v 出现；显得；似乎；出庭；登场 used to say how something seems, especially from what you know about it or from what you can see

es.e: Police have found what appear to be human remains.
es.c: 警方发现了疑似人体遗骸的东西。

es.e: He tried to make it appear that she had committed suicide.
es.c: 他试图制造她自杀的假象。

es.e: It may be less useful than it appears at first.
es.c: 这可能没有一开始显得那么有用。

d: v 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养 to rest or do something that is enjoyable, especially after you have been working

es.e: I just want to sit down and relax.
es.c: 我只想坐下来休息一下。

es.e: What Robyn needed was a drink to relax her.
es.c: 萝宾需要的是喝一杯放松放松。

es.e: A hot bath should help to relax you.
es.c: 洗个热水澡可以帮助你放松下来。

d: n 大小；尺寸 how big or small something is；adj 一定尺寸的；v 依大小排列 to sort according to size

es.e: He’s a small boy, about John’s size.
es.c: 他是个小男孩，个子和约翰差不多。

es.e: Jensens’ house is about the same size as ours.
es.c: 詹森的房子和我们的差不多大。

es.e: He’s quite a big dog, but he’s still not full size yet.
es.c: 这条狗体型很大，但还没有长足。

d: n 椅子；讲座；（会议的）主席位；大学教授的职位 a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, which has a back, a seat, and four legs；v 担任（会议的）主席；使…入座；使就任要职 to be the  chairperson  of a meeting or committee

es.e: a kitchen chair
es.c: 厨房椅

es.e: They bought a new table and chairs.
es.c: 他们买了一套新的桌椅。

es.e: One of the chair legs was broken.
es.c: 椅子有一条腿断了。

d: n 英格兰
n 明信片 a card that can be sent in the post without an envelope, especially one with a picture on it

es.e: Don’t forget to send us a postcard!
es.c: 别忘了给我们寄张明信片！

d: n 结束；目标；尽头；末端；死亡 a situation in which something is finished or no longer exists；v 结束，终止；终结 to finish what you are doing

es.e: At last it seemed the war might be coming to an end.
es.c: 终于战争似乎即将结束。

es.e: The spacecraft is nearing the end of its useful life.
es.c: 该航天器的使用寿命快要终结。

es.e: Well, I hope that’s the end of the matter.
es.c: 好啦，我希望事情就到此为止。

d: v 躺；说谎；位于；展现 if a town, village, etc lies in a particular place, it is in that place；n 谎言；位置 something that you say or write that you know is untrue

es.e: The town lies in a small wooded valley.
es.c: 该城镇坐落于一个林木茂盛的山谷中。

es.e: The Tasman Sea lies between Tasmania and Australia.
es.c: 塔斯曼海位于塔斯马尼亚和澳大利亚之间。

d: adj 第八的；八分之一的 coming after seven other things in a series；num 第八；八分之一 one of eight equal parts of something

es.e: in the eighth century
es.c: 在8世纪

es.e: her eighth birthday
es.c: 她的8岁生日

d: adj 多风的，有风的；腹胀的；吹牛的 if it is windy, there is a lot of wind

es.e: It’s too windy for a picnic.
es.c: 风太大，不适合野餐。

es.e: a cold, windy day
es.c: 一个寒冷的大风天

es.e: a windy hillside
es.c: 当风的山坡

d: n 注意力；关心；立正！（口令） when you carefully listen to, look at, or think about someone or something

es.e: My attention wasn’t really on the game.
es.c: 我的注意力其实不在比赛上。

es.e: She tried to pay attention to what he was saying.
es.c: 她尽量注意听他说话。

es.e: If you paid more attention in class, you might actually learn something!
es.c: 要是你上课更认真些，也许能实实在在地学到些东西！

d: v 信任；料想；笃信宗教 to be sure that something is true or that someone is telling the truth

es.e: You shouldn’t believe everything you read.
es.c: 你不应尽信书上看来的东西。

es.e: I believed him, even though his story sounded unlikely.
es.c: 我相信了他，尽管他的话听上去难以置信。

es.e: I don’t believe a word of it (=  I think it is completely untrue  ) .
es.c: 我一句话也不相信。

d: n 邮件；邮政，邮递；盔甲 the letters and packages that are delivered to you；v 邮寄；给…穿盔甲 to send a letter or package to someone

es.e: You shouldn’t read other people’s mail.
es.c: 你不应该看别人的信件。

es.e: He found a mountain of mail waiting for him.
es.c: 他发现有堆积如山的邮件等着他处理。

es.e: She promised to forward my mail to my new address (= send it from your old home or office to your new one ) .
es.c: 她答应把我的邮件转寄到我的新地址。

d: n 信；字母，文字；证书；文学，学问；字面意义 a written or printed message that is usually put in an envelope and sent by mail；v 写字母于 to write, draw, paint etc letters or words on something

es.e: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
es.c: 英语字母表有26个字母。

d: n 大衣，外套 a long thick warm coat

es.e: I sprang 400 pounds for  her overcoat.
es.c: 给她买那件大衣，我花了400镑。

es.e: He placed his cap and overcoat on a chair.
es.c: 他把帽子和大衣搁在一张椅子上。

es.e: She removed all the grease stains from her overcoat.
es.c: 她把她大衣上所有油渍都去掉了。

d: n 乐趣；玩笑；有趣的人或事 an experience or activity that is very enjoyable and exciting；adj 供娱乐用的；vi 开玩笑

es.e: There’s plenty of fun for all the family.
es.c: 可以让全家人玩得很开心。

es.e: The children were having so much fun, I hated to call them inside.
es.c: 小孩子玩得很开心，我不忍心把他们叫进来。

d: adj 突然的，意外的；快速的 happening, coming, or done quickly or when you do not expect it；n 突然发生的事

es.e: a sudden change in the weather
es.c: 天气的突然变化

es.e: Life is cruel, she thought, with a sudden rush of anger.
es.c: 生活真残酷，她想，心头突然涌上一股怒气。

es.e: a sudden movement
es.c: 突然的一动

d: n 金，黄金；金色；金币 coins, jewellery etc made of gold；adj 金的，金制的；金色的 made of gold

es.e: She came to the party dripping with gold (= wearing a lot of gold ) .
es.c: 她披金戴银地来参加派对。

d: n 工程师；工兵；火车司机 someone whose job is to design or build roads, bridges, machines etc；v 设计；策划；精明地处理 to make something happen by skilful secret planning

es.e: He trained as a civil engineer (= one who designs and builds roads, bridges etc ).
es.c: 他接受过土木工程师培训。

d: n 键盘 a board with buttons marked with letters or numbers that are pressed to put information into a computer or other machine；v 键入；用键盘式排字机排字 to put information into a computer, using a keyboard

es.e: a computer keyboard
es.c: 计算机键盘

d: adv 太；也；很；还；非常；过度 more than is acceptable or possible

es.e: Do you think the music’s too loud?
es.c: 你觉得音乐太响了吗？

es.e: You’ve put too much salt in the soup.
es.c: 你往汤里放盐太多。

es.e: There are too many cars on the road.
es.c: 路上车辆太多。

d: n 怀疑；疑问；疑惑 a feeling of being not sure whether something is true or right；v 怀疑；不信；恐怕；拿不准 to think that something may not be true or that it is unlikely

es.e: There was still one little nagging doubt at the back of his mind.
es.c: 他的心头仍有一丝挥之不去的疑虑。

d: adj 外面的，外部的；外来的 not inside a building；n 外部；外观 the part or surface of something that is furthest from the centre；adv 在外面，向外面；在室外 not inside a building；prep 在…范围之外

es.e: We turned off the outside lights and went to bed.
es.c: 我们关掉外头的电灯，上床睡觉了。

es.e: The house will need a lot of outside repairs before we can sell it.
es.c: 房子的外部需要好好修一修，之后我们才能把它卖出去。

d: adj 基本的；基础的 forming the most important or most necessary part of something；n 基础；要素

es.e: the basic principles of chemistry
es.c: 化学的基本原理

es.e: The basic idea is simple.
es.c: 基本思想很简单。

es.e: {"COLLOINEXA":["basic research"]}
es.c: 基础研究

d: n 呼吸，气息；一口气，（呼吸的）一次；瞬间，瞬息；微风；迹象；无声音，气音 to start breathing normally again after running or making a lot of effort

es.e: Slow down, I need to catch my breath.
es.c: 慢一点，我要喘口气。

d: n 抽屉；开票人；出票人；起草者；酒馆侍 part of a piece of furniture, such as a desk, that you pull out and push in and use to keep things in

es.e: She took a file from her desk drawer .
es.c: 她从书桌的抽屉里拿出了一个文件夹。

es.e: The scissors are in the kitchen drawer (= drawer in a piece of kitchen furniture ) .
es.c: 剪刀在厨房的抽屉里。

d: conj 在…以前；直到…时；prep 在…以前；到…为止 if something happens until a particular time, it continues and then stops at that time

es.e: The ticket is valid until March.
es.c: 这张票的有效期一直到 3 月份。

es.e: He waited until she had finished speaking.
es.c: 他一直等到她讲完。

es.e: Until recently, Anna worked as a teacher in Japan.
es.c: 直到最近，安娜一直在日本当老师。

d: n 旅客；乘客；过路人；碍手碍脚的人 someone who is travelling in a vehicle, plane, boat etc, but is not driving it or working on it

es.e: Neither the driver nor the passengers were hurt.
es.c: 司机和乘客均未受伤。

d: n （打字机等的）键；关键；钥匙 a small specially shaped piece of metal that you put into a lock and turn in order to lock or unlock a door, start a car etc；v 键入；锁上；调节…的音调；提供线索；adj 关键的 very important or necessary

es.e: A bunch of keys hung from his belt.
es.c: 他的皮带上挂着一串钥匙。

d: v 记得；牢记；纪念；代…问好 to have a picture or idea in your mind of people, events, places etc from the past

es.e: Do you remember Rosa Davies?
es.c: 你记得罗莎·戴维斯吗？

es.e: I can’t remember her exact words.
es.c: 我记不得她的原话了。

es.e: I remember it well ; I’d never seen my mother so angry.
es.c: 这件事我记得很清楚；我从未见过母亲这么生气。

d: v 滑行；沿岸航行 if a car or bicycle coasts, it moves without any effort from you or any power from the engine；n 海岸；滑坡 the area where the land meets the sea

es.e: He pushed in the clutch and coasted to a halt.
es.c: 他踩下离合器，滑行了一会儿便停下来了。

d: n 舌头；语言 the soft part inside your mouth that you can move about and use for eating and speaking；v 舔；斥责；用舌吹 to use your tongue to make separate sounds when playing a musical instrument

es.e: Joe ran his tongue over his dry lips.
es.c: 乔舔了舔干燥的嘴唇。

es.e: The taste of the chocolate was still on her tongue.
es.c: 巧克力的余味依然留在她的舌尖。

es.e: The girl scowled at me, then stuck out her tongue .
es.c: 女孩怒视着我，然后吐了一下舌头。

d: n 篮球；篮球运动 a game played indoors between two teams of five players, in which each team tries to win points by throwing a ball through a net
n [畜牧][脊椎] 骆驼；打捞浮筒；工作作风官僚 a large desert animal with a long neck and either one or two  hump s (= large raised parts )  on its back；adj 驼色的；暗棕色的；vi 工作刻板平庸
n 中文，汉语；中国人 the language used in China；adj 中国的，中国人的；中国话的 relating to China, its people, or its language

es.e: Do you fancy going out for a Chinese?
es.c: 你想不想出去吃顿中餐？

d: v 超速，加速；加速，迅速前行；兴隆 to be driving faster than the legal limit；n 速度，速率；迅速，快速；昌盛，繁荣 the rate at which something moves or travels

es.e: I got caught speeding on the A40 yesterday.
es.c: 昨天我在 A40 号干线公路上超速行驶被逮到。

d: n 书包 A schoolbag is a bag that children use to carry books and other things to and from school

es.e: She ran back to the classroom to get her schoolbag.
es.c: 她跑回教室去取书包。

es.e: I was straightening my schoolbag when you phoned me.
es.c: 你给我打电话时，我正在整理书包。

es.e: Mom, could you buy me a new green leather schoolbag?
es.c: 妈妈，你能为我买一个新的绿色皮书包吗？

d: n 步，脚步；步骤；步伐；梯级 the movement you make when you put one foot in front of or behind the other when walking；v 踏，踩；走 to bring your foot down on something

es.e: a video of baby’s first steps
es.c: 一盒婴儿学步的录像带

es.e: He took one step and fell.
es.c: 他走了一步就跌倒了。

es.e: I had to retrace my steps (= go back the way I came ) several times before I found the shop.
es.c: 我来回走了几次才找到那家商店。

d: n 雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构 an object that you use to protect yourself against rain or hot sun. It consists of a circular folding frame covered in cloth.

es.e: It started to rain, so Tricia stopped to put up her umbrella.
es.c: 开始下雨了，所以特里西娅停下来撑起雨伞。

es.e: I spent the day on the beach, lying under a beach umbrella, reading.
es.c: 那天我就在海滩上度过，躺在海滩遮阳伞下面看书。

d: n 大学；学院；学会 a school for advanced education, especially in a particular profession or skill

es.e: a teacher training college
es.c: 师范学院

es.e: Donna left school and went to art college.
es.c: 唐娜中学毕业后进了艺术学院。

d: v 显示；说明；演出；展出 to explain to someone how to do something, by doing it yourself or using actions to help them learn；n 显示；表演；炫耀 a performance for the public, especially one that includes singing, dancing, or jokes

es.e: The man grinned, showing bad teeth.
es.c: 那男人咧着嘴笑，露出一口坏牙。

d: n 时钟；计时器 an instrument that shows what time it is, in a room or outside on a building；v 记录；记时 to measure or record the time or speed that someone or something is travelling at

es.e: I heard the clock strike six (= make six loud sounds ) .
es.c: 我听到钟敲了六下。

es.e: The station clock was ten minutes slow (= showed a time ten minutes earlier than the real time ) .
es.c: 车站的钟慢了十分钟。

d: n 排球 a game in which two teams use their hands to hit a ball over a high net

es.e: I like playing beach volleyball.
es.c: 我喜欢打沙滩排球。

es.e: Every sunday, they played volleyball in the park.
es.c: 每个周日他们在公园打排球。

es.e: Balloon, baseball, basketball, football and volleyball all dance  ballet on the  volcano.
es.c: 气球、棒球、篮球、足球和排球都在火山上跳芭蕾舞。

d: n 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能 a useful machine, tool, instrument etc that has been invented

es.e: The dishwasher is a wonderful invention.
es.c: 洗碗机是一项奇妙的发明。

d: conj 尽管；虽然；但是；然而 used to introduce a statement that makes your main statement seem surprising or unlikely

es.e: Although in poor health, she continued to carry out her duties.
es.c: 尽管身体不好，她仍继续执行任务。

es.e: We decided to take rooms in Longwood House, although we knew we could not really afford the rent.
es.c: 虽然我们知道自己其实付不起租金，但还是决定住朗伍德庄园的房间。

es.e: Although I can’t help admiring the man’s courage, I do not approve of his methods.
es.c: 尽管我不得不佩服那个男子的勇气，却并不赞成他的方法。

d: n 咖啡；咖啡豆；咖啡色 a hot dark brown drink that has a slightly bitter taste

es.e: Do you want a cup of coffee?
es.c: 你要来杯咖啡吗？

es.e: Do you like your coffee white (= with milk ) or black (= without milk ) ?
es.c: 你的咖啡要加奶还是不加奶？

d: n 分；一分的硬币；森特（等于半音程的百分之一） 1/100th of the standard unit of money in some countries. For example, there are 100 cents in one dollar or in one  euro  : symbol ¢.

es.e: A cup of rice which cost thirty cents a few weeks ago is now being sold for up to one dollar.
es.c: 几周前价值30美分的1杯米如今卖到了1美元。

d: adj 紫色的；帝王的；华而不实的 having a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue；n 紫色；紫袍 a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue；v 变成紫色

es.e: His face turned purple with rage.
es.c: 他气得脸色发紫。

d: n 电影；薄膜；胶卷；轻烟 a story that is told using sound and moving pictures, shown at a cinema or on television；v 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影 to use a camera to record a story or real events so that it can be shown in the cinema or on televis

es.e: Have you seen any good films recently?
es.c: 你最近看过什么好的影片吗？

d: n 学校；学院；学派；鱼群 a place where children are taught；v 教育 to train or teach someone to have a certain skill, type of behaviour, or way of thinking

es.e: His mother always used to pick him up from school.
es.c: 他母亲以前一直去学校接他。

d: adj 有用的，有益的；有帮助的 helping you to do or get what you want

es.e: useful information
es.c: 有用的信息

es.e: A little Japanese can be really useful.
es.c: 懂一点日语非常有用。

es.e: Can you come and make yourself useful(= help people to do something )?
es.c: 你能不能过来帮点忙？

d: n 盘；餐具；一盘食物；外貌有吸引力的人 a flat container with low sides, for serving food from or cooking food in；v 盛于碟盘中；分发；使某人的希望破灭；说（某人）的闲话 to give a lot of information about something or someone, especially something that would usually

es.e: a serving dish
es.c: 上菜用的盘子

es.e: an ovenproof dish
es.c: 耐热盘

d: adv 到处 in or to every place；n 每个地方

es.e: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
es.c: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

es.e: He’s travelled everywhere in Europe.
es.c: 他走遍了欧洲各地。

es.e: The south should remain dry, but everywhere else will have heavy rain.
es.c: 南部持续干旱，但其他地区会下暴雨。

d: adj 高兴的；乐意的；令人高兴的；灿烂美丽的 pleased and happy about something；vt 使高兴；n (Glad)人名；(塞、瑞典)格拉德；(英)格莱德；(法、挪)格拉

es.e: We’re so glad you came.
es.c: 你来了我们真高兴。

es.e: ‘I’ve decided to accept the job.’ ‘I’m glad.’
es.c: “我决定接受这份工作。”“我很高兴。”

d: n 九十 the number 90；adj 九十的；九十岁的；num 九十 the number 90

es.e: America was far richer in the nineties.
es.c: 90年代的美国要富裕得多。

d: n 作文，作曲，作品；[材] 构成；合成物；成分 the way in which something is made up of different parts, things, or members

es.e: Some minerals have complex chemical compositions.
es.c: 有些矿物的化学构成很复杂。

d: n 翼；翅膀；飞翔；派别；侧厅，耳房，厢房 one of the large flat parts that stick out from the side of a plane and help to keep it in the air；v 使飞；飞过；空运；增加…速度；装以翼 to fly somewhere

es.e: The bird flapped its wings furiously.
es.c: 那只鸟使劲地拍打着翅膀。

d: n 数；（杂志等的）期；号码；数字；算术 a word or sign that represents an amount or a quantity；v 计入；总数达到 to count something

es.e: They wrote various numbers on a large sheet of paper.
es.c: 他们在一张大纸上写下了很多不同的数字。

es.e: Add all the numbers together.
es.c: 把所有数字加起来。

d: adj 有礼貌的，客气的；文雅的；上流的；优雅的 behaving or speaking in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people’s needs and feelings

es.e: She’s always very polite.
es.c: 她总是很有礼貌。

es.e: polite, well-behaved children
es.c: 懂礼貌、守规矩的孩子

es.e: a clear but polite request
es.c: 明确但客气的请求

d: v 解散；解雇；开除；让离开；不予理会、不予考虑 to remove someone from their job

es.e: The government has dismissed criticisms that the country’s health policy is a mess.
es.c: 有人认为国家医疗政策一塌糊涂，政府对这种批评持否认态度。

d: v 修理；篡改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位 to dishonestly change something in order to gain an advantage；n 医生；博士 someone who is trained to treat people who are ill

es.e: He had doctored his passport to pass her off as his daughter.
es.c: 他窜改了护照，谎称她是他的女儿。

es.e: There are concerns that some players have been doctoring the ball.
es.c: 有人担心说一些选手在球上做手脚。

d: adj 疲倦的；厌倦的，厌烦的 feeling that you want to sleep or rest；v 疲倦；对…腻烦（tire的过去分词形式）

es.e: He looks tired out (= very tired ) .
es.c: 他看起来累坏了。

es.e: ‘No,’ Frank said in a tired voice.
es.c: “不。”弗兰克语带疲倦地说。

d: n 蜡笔，有色粉笔 a stick of coloured  wax  or  chalk  that children use to draw pictures；v 以蜡笔作画，用颜色粉笔画 to draw something with a crayon

es.e: He coloured the picture with crayon.
es.c: 他用蜡笔给画上色。

es.e: They send letters — one time in crayon — detailing their rights and how I am violating some maritime treaty from the 1700s.
es.c: 他们寄信，有一次甚至是蜡笔写的，详细的描述了他们的权利和我如何违反了某些1700年代的海上条约。

d: n 兴趣，爱好；利息；趣味；同行 if you have an interest in something or someone, you want to know or learn more about them；v 使……感兴趣；引起……的关心；使……参与 to make someone want to pay attention to something and find out more about it

es.e: I watched the first few episodes, but soon lost interest.
es.c: 我看了前几集，但很快就失去了兴趣。

es.e: The last round of bidding aroused considerable interest.
es.c: 最后一轮竞价引起人们相当大的兴趣。

es.e: Our survey reveals a disturbing lack of interest in teacher training.
es.c: 我们的调查显示人们对教师培训失去了兴趣，这很令人不安。

d: adj 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；奇妙的；美妙；胜；神妙 making you admire someone or something very much

es.e: It’s wonderful what doctors can do nowadays.
es.c: 如今医生的本领着实令人称奇。

d: n 矿，矿藏；矿山，矿井；地雷，水雷；v 开采，采掘；在…布雷 to dig large holes in the ground in order to remove coal, gold etc；pron 我的 used by the person speaking or writing to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with himself or hers

es.e: They learnt how to lay mines (= put them in place ) .
es.c: 他们学习了如何布雷。

d: n 风；呼吸；气味；卷绕 moving air, especially when it moves strongly or quickly in a current；v 缠绕；上发条；使弯曲；吹号角；绕住或缠住某人 to turn or twist something several times around something else

es.e: The wind blew from the northeast.
es.c: 风从东北方向吹来。

es.e: Planes were unable to take off because of high winds.
es.c: 飞机因大风无法起飞。

d: pron 一个人；任何人 used to mean someone or something of a type that has already been mentioned or is known about；adj 一的；唯一的 only；n 一 the number 1；num 一；一个 the number 1

es.e: ‘Have you got a camera?’ ‘No.’ ‘You should buy one’ (= buy a camera ).
es.c: “你有照相机吗？”“没有。”“你应该买一架。”

es.e: The train was crowded so we decided to catch a later one (= catch a later train ).
es.c: 火车很挤，于是我们决定乘坐下一班。

d: n 手臂；武器；袖子；装备；部门 one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulders and your hands；v 武装起来 to provide weapons for yourself, an army, a country etc in order to prepare for a fight or a war

es.e: Dave has a broken arm .
es.c: 戴夫手臂断了。

es.e: Tim’s mother put her arms around him.
es.c: 蒂姆的母亲伸出双臂搂着他。

es.e: Pat was carrying a box under his arm .
es.c: 帕特腋下挟着一个盒子。

d: v 不计；把…除外 to not include something；prep 除…之外；conj 除了；要不是 used to give the reason why something was not done or did not happen

es.e: They were all there except me.
es.c: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

es.e: We all went except him.
es.c: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

es.e: They all howled with laughter except me.
es.c: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

d: n 信任，信赖；责任；托拉斯 a strong belief in the honesty, goodness etc of someone or something；v 信任，信赖；盼望；赊卖给 to believe that someone is honest or will not do anything bad or wrong

es.e: At first there was a lack of trust between them.
es.c: 起初，他们之间缺乏信任。

es.e: an agreement made on the basis of mutual trust
es.c: 在相互信任的基础上达成的一项协议

es.e: You betrayed your father’s trust (= did something bad even though he trusted you ) .
es.c: 你辜负了你父亲对你的信任。

d: n 长时间；[语] 长音节；（服装的）长尺寸；长裤；adj 长的；过长的；做多头的；长时间的；冗长的，长音 measuring a great length from one end to the other；v 渴望；热望 used to ask and talk about particular amounts of time；adv 长期地；始终 for a long time

es.e: a long table
es.c: 一张长桌子

es.e: the longest tunnel in the world
es.c: 世界上最长的隧道

es.e: He stretched out hislong legs.
es.c: 他伸开两条长腿。

d: adj 其他的，另外的 You use other to refer to an additional thing or person of the same type as one that has been mentioned or is known about；pron 另外一个

es.e: They were just like any other young couple.
es.c: 他们那时就和其他任何年轻夫妇一样。

d: n 十二个，一打 twelve；adj 一打的

es.e: a dozen eggs
es.c: 一打鸡蛋

es.e: Chris, Helen, and half a dozen others went on holiday together.
es.c: 克里斯、海伦和其他六个人一起去度假了。

es.e: (= about 12 ) cars were parked near the entrance.
es.c: 入口附近停了大约十二辆汽车。

d: n 害怕；恐惧；敬畏；担心 the feeling you get when you are afraid or worried that something bad is going to happen；v 害怕；敬畏；为…担心 to feel afraid or worried that something bad may happen

es.e: She finally ran away for fear that he would kill her.
es.c: 她最后逃走了，唯恐他会杀她。

d: conj 因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时 while or when；prep 如同；当作；以…的身份 used when you are comparing two people, things, situations etc；adv 同样地；和…一样的

es.e: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
es.c: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。

es.e: As time passed, things seemed to get worse.
es.c: 随着时间的推移，情况似乎变得更加糟糕了。

es.e: Just as the two men were leaving, a message arrived.
es.c: 那两个男子刚要离开，消息就传来了。

d: prep 在…之前，先于 earlier than something or someone；adv 以前；在前 at an earlier time；conj 在…以前；在…之前 earlier than a particular event or action

es.e: The new road should be completed before the end of the year.
es.c: 这条新公路应该在年底前完工。

es.e: Let’s meet at our house before the show.
es.c: 看演出前在我们家碰头吧。

es.e: Larry arrived home before me.
es.c: 拉里在我之前到家。

d: n 溪流；流动；潮流；光线 a flow of water, air, smoke etc, or the direction in which it is flowing；v 流；涌进；飘扬 to flow quickly and in great amounts

es.e: A stream of cold air rushed through the open door.
es.c: 一股冷气穿过敞开的门直冲进来。

d: adv 后来，以后 After is also an adverb；prep 在……之后 when a particular event or time has happened, or when someone has done something；conj 在……之后；adj 以后的 in the years after the time that has been mentioned

es.e: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
es.c: 明天。或者后天。

d: v 使固定；修理；安装；准备 to repair something that is broken or not working properly；n 困境；方位；贿赂 to have a problem that is difficult to solve

es.e: He’s outside fixing the brakes on the car.
es.c: 他在外面修理汽车的刹车。

es.e: Ellis was able to quickly find and fix the problem.
es.c: 埃利斯马上就找到并解决了问题。

d: n 行为；习性；运行状况（=behavior） the things that a person or animal does

es.e: It is important to reward good behaviour.
es.c: 表现好要给予奖励，这是很重要的。

d: n 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人 a part of the inside of a building that has its own walls, floor, and ceiling；v 为…提供住处；租房，合住；投宿，住宿；留…住宿 to rent and live in a room somewhere

es.e: I looked around the room.
es.c: 我四下看了看房间。

es.e: She nodded toward a man who was standing across the room (= on the other side of the room ) .
es.c: 她朝站在屋子另一头的一个男人点点头。

es.e: Someone was laughing in the next room (= the one beside the one you are in ) .
es.c: 隔壁房间有人在笑。

d: v 打扰；妨碍；使不安；弄乱；使恼怒 to interrupt someone so that they cannot continue what they are doing

es.e: Sorry to disturb you, but I have an urgent message.
es.c: 对不起打扰一下，我有个紧急消息。

es.e: The thieves fled when they were disturbed by a neighbour.
es.c: 窃贼们被一名邻居惊动后逃跑了。

es.e: (= a sign you put on a door so that people will not interrupt you ) .
es.c: 请勿打扰。

d: adj 俄国的；俄语的 relating to Russia, its people, or its language；n 俄语；俄国人 someone from Russia

es.e: ...the Russian parliament.
es.c: ...俄罗斯国会。

d: v 微笑 to make your mouth curve upwards, in order to be friendly or because you are happy or amused；n 微笑；笑容；喜色 an expression in which your mouth curves upwards, when you are being friendly or are happy or amused

es.e: her smiling face
es.c: 她的笑脸

d: adj 严格的；绝对的；精确的；详细的 expecting people to obey rules or to do what you say

es.e: a strict teacher
es.c: 严格的老师

d: n 国王；最有势力者；王棋 a man who rules a country because he is from a royal family；vi 统治；做国王；vt 立…为王；adj 主要的，最重要的，最大的

es.e: On 2 December Henry VI was crowned king (= made the king at an official ceremony ).
es.c: 12月2日，亨利六世加冕为王。

d: n 通讯，[通信] 通信；交流；信函 the process by which people exchange information or express their thoughts and feelings

es.e: Good communication is vital in a large organization.
es.c: 在大机构里良好的沟通是极为重要的。

es.e: Radio was the pilot’s only means of communication .
es.c: 无线电是飞行员唯一的通信手段。

d: n 牙膏 a thick substance that you use to clean your teeth

es.e: Shaving supplies, toothpaste, and soap were found inside.
es.c: 在里面找到了剃须用品、牙膏和肥皂。

d: pron 他的；n (His)人名；(法)伊斯

es.e: That should be his mother.
es.c: 那大概是他的母亲。

es.e: He stated his views to me.
es.c: 他向我说明了他的观点。

d: n 值；价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义 the amount of money that something is worth；v 评价；重视；估价 to think that someone or something is important

es.e: the nutritional value of cereal
es.c: 谷类食物的营养价值

d: v 成功；继承；继任；兴旺 to do what you tried or wanted to do

es.e: She wanted to be the first woman to climb Mount Qomolangma, and she almost succeeded.
es.c: 她本想成为第一位登上珠穆朗玛峰的女性，而且差一点就成功了。

d: n 餐馆；[经] 饭店 a place where you can buy and eat a meal

es.e: He took her out for a five-course dinner in a fancy restaurant.
es.c: 他带她到一家豪华餐厅吃了一顿有五道菜的晚餐。

es.e: The company runs a chain of restaurants.
es.c: 公司经营连锁饭店。

es.e: A new restaurant has just opened across the road.
es.c: 马路对面刚开了一家新饭馆。

d: n 能力，能耐；才能 the state of being able to do something

es.e: The test measures your mathematical ability.
es.c: 这种测试考查的是数学能力。

d: n 匙，勺子；一杓的量 an object that you use for eating, cooking, or serving food. It has a small bowl-shaped part and a long handle.；v 用匙舀；使成匙状 to move food with a spoon

es.e: He spooned instant coffee into two of the mugs.
es.c: 他用勺把速溶咖啡舀进了两个杯子里。

d: n 脸；表面；面子；面容；外观；威信 the front part of your head, where your eyes, nose, and mouth are；v 向；朝 to be opposite someone or something, or to be looking or pointing in a particular direction

es.e: She had a beautiful face.
es.c: 她面容秀美。

es.e: Her face was white with fear.
es.c: 她吓得脸煞白。

es.e: A big smile spread across his face.
es.c: 他的脸上绽开了灿烂笑容。

d: n 鞋；蹄铁；外胎 something that you wear to cover your feet, made of leather or some other strong material；v 给……穿上鞋；穿……鞋

es.e: I sat down and took off my shoes and socks.
es.c: 我坐下来脱掉鞋子和袜子。

es.e: What size shoes do you take?
es.c: 你穿几号的鞋子？

d: adj 大的；重要的；量大的 of more than average size or amount；adv 大量地；顺利；夸大地；n (Big)人名；(土)比格

es.e: a big house
es.c: 大房子

es.e: I need a bigger desk.
es.c: 我需要一张大一点的桌子。

es.e: She had a big grin on her face.
es.c: 她脸上挂着大大的笑容。

d: v 生产；引起；创作；生育，繁殖 to cause a particular result or effect；n 农产品，产品 food or other things that have been grown or produced on a farm to be sold

es.e: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
es.c: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

es.e: a rise in sea level produced by climatic change
es.c: 由气候变化引起的海平面升高

es.e: As a policy, it did not produce the desired effect .
es.c: 作为一项政策，它并未产生预期的效果。

d: n 岛；岛屿；安全岛；岛状物 a piece of land completely surrounded by water；adj 岛的；vt 孤立；使成岛状

es.e: The Cayman Islands
es.c: 开曼群岛

es.e: the Greek island of Crete
es.c: 希腊克里特岛

d: adj 沉重的；繁重的，巨大的；拥挤的；阴沉的 weighing a lot；n 重物；严肃角色；adv 大量地；笨重地

es.e: The wardrobe was too heavy for me to move on my own.
es.c: 衣橱太重，我一个人移不动。

es.e: a heavy suitcase
es.c: 沉重的手提箱

es.e: The males are seven times heavier than the females.
es.c: 雄性的重量是雌性的七倍。

d: adj 电的；电动的；发电的；导电的；令人震惊的 needing electricity to work, produced by electricity, or used for carrying electricity；n 电；电气车辆；带电体

es.e: an electric blanket
es.c: 电热毯

d: n 行星 A planet is a large, round object in space that moves around a star. The Earth is a planet.

es.e: The picture shows six of the nine planets in the solar system.
es.c: 这张图片展示太阳系9个行星中的6个行星。

d: n 天气；气象；气候；处境 the temperature and other conditions such as sun, rain, and wind；v 经受住；使风化；侵蚀；使受风吹雨打 if rock, wood, or someone’s face is weathered by the wind, sun, rain etc, or if it weathers, it changes colour or shape o

es.e: What’s the weather like today?
es.c: 今天天气如何？

es.e: The weather turned bitterly cold.
es.c: 天气变得很冷了。

d: n 客人，宾客；顾客 someone who is invited to an event or special occasion；v 款待，招待；adj 客人的；特邀的，客座的 for guests to use

es.e: a banquet for 250 distinguished guests
es.c: 250位贵宾出席的宴会

es.e: Among the invited guests were Jerry Brown and Elihu Harris.
es.c: 受邀的嘉宾中有杰里·布朗和伊莱休·哈里斯。

es.e: The actress was guest of honour (= the most important guest ) at the launch.
es.c: 这位女演员是首发式上的贵宾。

d: pron 谁（who的宾格）

es.e: From whom shall I get comfort?
es.c: 我从谁那儿能得到安慰呢?

es.e: The dispute at the moment revolved about the question of whom to send.
es.c: 当时的争论是围绕着派谁去好这一问题而进行的。

d: adj 努力的；硬的；困难的；辛苦的；确实的；严厉的；猛烈的；冷酷无情的 firm, stiff, and difficult to press down, break, or cut；adv 努力地；困难地；辛苦地；接近地；猛烈地；牢固地 using a lot of effort, energy, or attention；n (Hard)人名；(英、芬、瑞典)哈德

es.e: a hard wooden chair
es.c: 一把硬木椅

es.e: the hardest substance known to man
es.c: 已知的最硬物质

es.e: After months without rain, the ground was too hard to plough.
es.c: 数月无雨，土地坚硬难犁。

d: v 鼓掌，拍手；啪地关上 to hit your hands against each other many times to make a sound that shows your approval, agreement, or enjoyment；n 鼓掌；拍手声 the loud sound that you make when you hit your hands together many times to show tha

es.e: One man began to clap, and others joined in.
es.c: 一个人鼓起了掌，其他人也跟着鼓掌。

es.e: The couple were cheered and clapped on their arrival.
es.c: 这对夫妇抵达时人群为他们欢呼鼓掌。

es.e: The audience clapped politely but without much enthusiasm.
es.c: 观众礼貌地鼓了掌，但并不热烈。

d: v 取来；接来；到达；吸引 to make people react in a particular way；n 取得；诡计

es.e: This announcement fetched a huge cheer from the audience.
es.c: 这一宣告博得听众极其热烈的欢呼声。

d: adj 每；各自的；adv 每个；各自 Each is also an adverb；pron 每个；各自

es.e: They reviewed each aspect of the plan bit by bit.
es.c: 他们对计划的各个方面逐一地进行了审核。

es.e: The children were given one each, handed to them or placed on their plates.
es.c: 孩子们每人给一个，递给他们或者放在他们的盘子里。

d: n 希望；祝福；心愿 a desire to do something, to have something, or to have something happen；v 祝愿；渴望；向…致问候语 to want something to be true although you know it is either impossible or unlikely

es.e: Close your eyes and make a wish.
es.c: 闭上眼睛许个愿。

d: n 环境，外界 the air, water, and land on Earth, which is affected by man’s activities

es.e: Some of these chemicals are very damaging to the environment.
es.c: 这些化学品中有些对环境非常有害。

es.e: legislation to protect the environment
es.c: 保护环境的法规

es.e: the effects of acid rain on the environment
es.c: 酸雨对环境的影响

d: adj 害羞的；畏缩的，胆怯的 nervous and embarrassed about meeting and speaking to other people, especially people you do not know；v 投；畏缩；惊退；厌恶 if a horse shies, it makes a sudden movement away from something because it is frightened

es.e: He was a quiet shy man.
es.c: 他是个话不多、害羞的男人。

es.e: a shy smile
es.c: 羞怯的微笑

es.e: As a teenager, I was painfully shy (= extremely shy ) .
es.c: 我十几岁时害羞得很。

d: v 谋杀，凶杀 to kill someone deliberately and illegally；n 谋杀，凶杀 the crime of deliberately killing someone

es.e: He was convicted of murdering a policeman.
es.c: 他被判谋杀一名警察的罪名成立。

es.e: Thousands of civilians were brutally murdered during the civil war.
es.c: 成千上万的平民在内战中遭到残杀。

es.e: the murdered man
es.c: 被害男子

d: v 给予，提供；买得起 to provide something or allow something to happen；n (Afford)人名；(英)阿福德

es.e: The room affords a beautiful view over the city.
es.c: 这房间可以俯瞰城市美景。

es.e: The new law will afford protection to employees.
es.c: 新法律将为雇员提供保障。

d: adv 表示否定，不 used to make a word, statement, or question negative；n “非”（计算机中逻辑运算的一种）

es.e: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
es.c: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。

es.e: She’s not a very nice person.
es.c: 她为人不太好。

es.e: You were wrong not to inform the police.
es.c: 你没有通知警方是错误的。

d: aux 必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能；n 绝对必要的事物；未发酵葡萄汁 the newly pressed juice of grapes or other fruit ready for fermentation

es.e: Warm clothes are a must in the mountains.
es.c: 御寒衣物在山里是必不可少的。

d: n 敌人，仇敌；敌军 someone who hates you and wants to harm you；adj 敌人的，敌方的

es.e: She’s a dangerous enemy to have.
es.c: 与她为敌很危险。

es.e: Cats and dogs have always been natural enemies.
es.c: 猫和狗向来是天敌。

es.e: an old enemy of her father
es.c: 她父亲的一个宿敌

d: n 自豪；骄傲；自尊心 a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved；v 使得意，以…自豪 to be especially proud of something that you do well, or of a good quality that you have

es.e: He wore his medals with pride.
es.c: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

es.e: The people have a sense of pride in their community.
es.c: 人们对自己的社区有一种自豪感。

es.e: His heart swelled with pride when his daughter came in.
es.c: 女儿进来时他的内心充满了自豪感。

d: n 烟；抽烟；无常的事物 white, grey or black gas that is produced by something burning；v 冒烟，吸烟；抽烟；弥漫 to suck or breathe in smoke from a cigarette, pipe etc or to do this regularly as a habit

es.e: cigarette smoke
es.c: 香烟的烟雾

es.e: Smoke from burning fields drifted across nearby roads.
es.c: 地里燃烧产生的烟雾飘到了附近的公路上。

es.e: the pall of smoke (= thick cloud of smoke ) that hung over the city
es.c: 笼罩在城市上空的浓烟

d: v 扮演；装作，举动像 to perform in a play or film；n 行为，行动；法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势 one thing that you do

es.e: I first started acting when I was 12 years old.
es.c: 我12岁开始演戏。

es.e: The movie is very well acted.
es.c: 这部影片演得非常好。

d: adv 在地下；秘密地 under the earth’s surface；adj 地下的；秘密的；先锋派的 below the surface of the earth；n 地下；地铁；地道；地下组织；秘密活动；先锋派团体 a railway system under the ground

es.e: This animal spends most of its life underground.
es.c: 这种动物一生中的大部分时间都待在地下。

es.e: nuclear waste buried deep underground
es.c: 深埋在地下的核废物

d: v 露营；扎营 to set up a tent or shelter and stay there for a short time；n 露营 a place where people stay in tents, shelters etc for a short time, usually in the mountains, a forest etc

es.e: We’ll camp by the river for the night, and move on tomorrow.
es.c: 我们今晚在河边露营，明天继续前进。

d: adj 全部的；完全的；整个的 complete, or as great as is possible；v 总数达 to reach a particular total；n 总数，合计 the final number or amount of things, people etc when everything has been counted

es.e: a total ban on cigarette advertising
es.c: 香烟广告的全面禁止

es.e: He looked at her with a total lack of comprehension.
es.c: 他一头雾水地望着她。

es.e: a sport that demands total commitment
es.c: 需要全身心投入的体育运动

d: n 羽绒滑雪衫；西装短外套；短上衣，夹克；土豆皮；书籍的护封；文件套，公文夹 a short light coat；v 给…穿夹克；给…装护套；给…包上护封；〈口〉打

es.e: Gene has to wear a jacket and tie to work.
es.c: 吉恩上班得穿西装打领带。

d: v 演说；从事；忙于；写姓名地址；向…致辞；与…说话；提出；处理 if you address an envelope, package etc, you write on it the name and address of the person you are sending it to；n 地址；演讲；致辞；说话的技巧；称呼 a formal speech that someone makes to a group of peop

es.e: Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope (=  with your address on it so it can be sent back to you  ) .
es.c: 寄上一个贴好邮票的、写有回邮地址的信封。

d: n 北，北方 the direction that is at the top of a map of the world, above the Equator. It is on the left if you are facing the rising sun；adj 北方的；朝北的 in the north or facing the north；adv 在北方，向北方 towards the north

es.e: Which way is north?
es.c: 哪边是北？

d: v 观察；注视；看守；警戒 to look at someone or something for a period of time, paying attention to what is happening；n 手表；监视；守护；值班人 a small clock that you wear on your wrist or keep in your pocket

es.e: Do you mind if I watch?
es.c: 你介意我看着吗？

es.e: We sat and watched the sunset.
es.c: 我们坐下来看日落。

es.e: Ruth could not bear to watch her parents arguing.
es.c: 露丝看不得父母争吵。

d: n 书籍；卷；帐簿；名册；工作簿 a set of printed pages that are held together in a cover so that you can read them；v 预订；登记 to make arrangements to stay in a place, eat in a restaurant, go to a theatre etc at a particular time in the fu

es.e: I’ve just started reading a book by Graham Greene.
es.c: 我刚开始看格雷厄姆·格林写的一本书。

es.e: a cookery book
es.c: 烹饪书

d: adj 习惯的；二手的，使用过的；v 用（use的过去式）；（used to）过去常做

es.e: I do the dishes every day, so I’m used to it.
es.c: 我每天洗盘子，所以习惯了。

d: n 新闻，消息；新闻报导 information about something that has happened recently

es.e: I hope to have some good news for you soon.
es.c: 我希望很快就能给你好消息。

d: vt 筑成池塘；vi 筑成池塘；n 池塘 a small area of fresh water that is smaller than a lake, that is either natural or artificially made

es.e: The path descends to  the pond.
es.c: 小路下斜通到池塘。

es.e: This pond often catches in winter.
es.c: 这个池塘在冬天常常结冰。

es.e: Wild flowers and grasses rimmed the little pond.
es.c: 各种野花和野草环绕着这个小池塘。

d: n 朋友；助手；赞助者 someone who you know and like very much and enjoy spending time with

es.e: Jerry, this is my friend Sue.
es.c: 杰里，这是我的朋友休。

es.e: She’s always out with her friends.
es.c: 她常同朋友们一起出去。

es.e: One of her closest friends died at the weekend.
es.c: 她的一位密友周末过世了。

d: n [车辆] 车辆；工具；交通工具；运载工具；传播媒介；媒介物 a machine with an engine that is used to take people or things from one place to another, such as a car, bus, or truck

es.e: a description of the stolen vehicle
es.c: 对被盗车辆的描述

es.e: Have you locked your vehicle?
es.c: 你锁车了吗？

d: n 重量，重力；负担；砝码；重要性 how heavy something is when you measure it；v 加重量于，使变重 If you weight something, you make it heavier by adding something to it, for example, in order to stop it from moving easily

es.e: The average weight of a baby at birth is just over seven pounds.
es.c: 婴儿的平均出生体重是七磅多一点。

es.e: It can be sewn into curtain hems to weight the curtain and so allow it to hang better.
es.c: 可以把它缝在窗帘的摺边里以增加窗帘的重量，使之更有下垂感。

d: n 香肠；腊肠；装香肠的碎肉 a small tube of skin filled with a mixture of meat, spices etc, eaten hot or cold after it has been cooked

es.e: pork sausages
es.c: 猪肉香肠

d: n 过道，门厅，走廊；会堂；食堂；学生宿舍；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所 the area just inside the door of a house or other building, that leads to other rooms

es.e: a huge tiled entrance hall
es.c: 铺着地砖的大门厅

d: prep 用；随着；支持；和…在一起 used to say that two or more people or things are together in the same place；n (With)人名；(德、芬、丹、瑞典)维特

es.e: I saw Bob in town with his girlfriend.
es.c: 我看到鲍勃与他的女朋友一起在镇上。

es.e: Put this bag with the others.
es.c: 把这个包和其他的包放在一起。

es.e: I always wear these shoes with this dress.
es.c: 这双鞋子我总是和这条裙子一起穿。

d: v 标记；衰退；枯萎 If you flag or if your spirits flag, you begin to lose enthusiasm or energy；n 标志；旗子 an expression meaning a country or organization and its beliefs, values, and people

es.e: His enthusiasm was in no way flagging.
es.c: 他的热情丝毫没有减退。

d: adj 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的 if something is interesting, you give it your attention because it seems unusual or exciting or provides information that you did not know about

es.e: That’s an interesting question.
es.c: 那是一个有趣的问题。

es.e: a really interesting TV programme
es.c: 十分有趣的电视节目

es.e: Did you meet any interesting people?
es.c: 你见过什么有意思的人吗？

d: n 总统；董事长；校长；主席 the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen

es.e: President Bush
es.c: 布什总统

d: n 二月 the second month of the year, between January and March

es.e: He joined the Army in February 1943.
es.c: 他1943年2月参军。

d: n 未来；前途；期货；将来时 what someone or something will do or what will happen to them in the future；adj 将来的，未来的 likely to happen or exist at a time after the present

es.e: The islands should have the right to decide their own future.
es.c: 这些岛屿应当有权决定自己的未来。

es.e: a leader who will shape the organization’s future
es.c: 将决定该组织未来的一位领导者

d: n 衣服 the things that people wear to cover their body or keep warm

es.e: What sort of clothes was he wearing?
es.c: 他穿着什么样的衣服？

es.e: I showered and put on clean clothes.
es.c: 我淋浴后穿上干净的衣服。

es.e: He was still in his work clothes.
es.c: 他仍然穿着工作服。

d: n 注意；尊重；问候；凝视 good wishes - used when sending your good wishes to someone or when ending a short letter or message；v 注重，考虑；看待；尊敬；把…看作；与…有关 to think about someone or something in a particular way

es.e: My husband sends his regards .
es.c: 我丈夫向你问好。

es.e: Hope to see you soon. Regards, Chris
es.c: 希望很快见到你。 祝安，克里斯

d: adj 积极的；活跃的；主动的；有效的；现役的 always busy doing things, especially physical or mental activities；n 主动语态；积极分子 the active form of a verb, for example ‘destroyed’ in the sentence ‘Enemy planes destroyed the village.’

es.e: games for active youngsters
es.c: 活跃好动的年轻人玩的游戏

es.e: She’s over 80, but is still very active.
es.c: 她80多岁了，但仍旧很活跃。

d: n 女士，小姐，年轻未婚女子 used in front of the family name of a woman who is not married to address her politely, to write to her, or to talk about her

es.e: I’d like to make an appointment with Miss Taylor.
es.c: 我想约一下泰勒小姐。

d: adj 南的；南方的 in or from the south of a country or area；n 南方人

es.e: a southern accent
es.c: 南部口音

es.e: Southern Italy
es.c: 意大利南部

d: adv 在今晚 during the night of this day；n 今晚 the night of this day

es.e: I think I’ll go to bed early tonight.
es.c: 我想今晚我会早点上床睡觉。

es.e: We’re meeting him at 9 o’clock tonight.
es.c: 我们今晚9点和他见面。

d: v 参加；结合；连接 to begin to take part in an activity that other people are involved in；n 结合；连接；接合点 a place where two parts of an object are connected or fastened together

es.e: Many sacrificed their weekend to join the hunt for the missing girl.
es.c: 许多人牺牲周末时间，加入了寻找失踪女孩的行动。

es.e: the benefits of joining our pension scheme
es.c: 参加我们的退休金计划的好处

es.e: Church leaders have joined the campaign to end foxhunting.
es.c: 教会领袖参与了禁止猎狐的运动。

d: adv 无论如何；不管怎样（接副词或形容词）；然而；可是 used when you are adding a fact or piece of information that seems surprising, or seems very different from what you have just said；conj 无论以何种方式; 不管怎样 in whatever way

es.e: This is a cheap and simple process. However, there are dangers.
es.c: 这是个花钱少而又简单的方法，不过有危险。

es.e: an extremely unpleasant disease that is, however, easy to treat
es.c: 一种让人极其难受却容易治疗的病

d: n 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席 the flat surface that you stand on inside a building；v 铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒 to hit someone so hard that they fall down

es.e: a polished wooden floor
es.c: 上过蜡的木地板

es.e: a puddle of water on the kitchen floor
es.c: 厨房地面上的一摊水

es.e: a warehouse that has 410,000 square feet of floor space
es.c: 楼面面积为41万平方英尺的仓库

d: n 四分之一；地区；季度；一刻钟；两角五分；节 one of four equal parts into which something can be divided；v 住宿；驻扎；num 四分之一 one of four equal parts into which something can be divided

es.e: It’s about a page and a quarter.
es.c: 大概是一又四分之一页。

es.e: Cut the cake into quarters.
es.c: 把蛋糕切成四等份。

d: n 杯子；奖杯；酒杯 a small round container, usually with a handle, that you use to drink tea, coffee etc；v 使成杯状；为…拔火罐 If you cup your hands, you make them into a curved shape like a cup

es.e: Mathew picked up the cup and sipped his coffee.
es.c: 马修拿起杯子抿了口咖啡。

es.e: She put her cup and saucer down on the table.
es.c: 她把杯碟放到桌上。

es.e: He cupped his hands around his mouth and called out for Diane.
es.c: 他两手窝成杯状围在嘴边，大声地呼唤黛安。

d: n 机械，机器；机构；机械般工作的人 a piece of equipment with moving parts that uses power such as electricity to do a particular job；v 用机器制造 to make or shape something using a machine

es.e: Could you get me a coffee from the drinks machine ?
es.c: 给我从自动饮料机里买一罐咖啡好吗？

es.e: The fax machine is broken.
es.c: 传真机坏了。

es.e: Did you put my dirty shirts in the machine (= washing machine ) ?
es.c: 你把我的脏衬衫放进洗衣机里了吗？

d: adj 下雨的；多雨的 a rainy period of time is one when it rains a lot；n (Rainy)人名；(英)雷尼

es.e: a cold rainy day in October
es.c: 十月里一个寒冷的雨天

es.e: I hate rainy weather .
es.c: 我讨厌雨天。

es.e: the rainy season
es.c: 雨季

d: n 蜡烛；烛光；烛形物 a stick of  wax  with a string through the middle, which you burn to give light；v 对着光检查

es.e: When the candle was only half an inch high it flickered out and the room became dark.
es.c: 蜡烛只有半英寸长时，烛光忽闪忽闪地熄灭了，于是房间一片漆黑。

d: adj 完整的；完全的；彻底的 used to emphasize that a quality or situation is as great as it could possibly be；v 完成 to finish doing or making something, especially when it has taken a long time

es.e: The police were in complete control of the situation.
es.c: 警方已完全控制了局势。

es.e: Their engagement came as a complete surprise to me.
es.c: 他们的订婚让我感到非常意外。

es.e: This is a complete waste of time .
es.c: 这完全是在浪费时间。

d: n 鸡肉；小鸡；胆小鬼，懦夫 a common farm bird that is kept for its meat and eggs；adj 鸡肉的；胆怯的；幼小的 not brave enough to do something

es.e: roast chicken
es.c: 烤鸡

d: v 拿，扛；携带；支持；搬运 to hold something in your hand or arms, or support it as you take it somewhere；n 运载；[计] 进位；射程 the distance a ball or bullet travels after it has been thrown, hit, or fired

es.e: Gina was carrying a small bunch of flowers.
es.c: 吉娜拿着一小束花。

es.e: Angela carried the child in her arms.
es.c: 安杰拉把小孩抱在怀里。

es.e: Let me carry that for you.
es.c: 让我帮你拿吧。

d: n 沙；沙地；沙洲；沙滩；沙子 a substance consisting of very small pieces of rocks and minerals, that forms beaches and deserts；v 撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子 to make a surface smooth by rubbing it with  sandpaper  or using a sp

es.e: a mixture of sand and cement
es.c: 沙和水泥的混合物

es.e: I have sand in my shoe.
es.c: 我的鞋里有沙子。

d: n 树；木料；树状物 a very tall plant that has branches and leaves, and lives for many years；v 把赶上树

es.e: As a kid, I loved to climb trees.
es.c: 小时候，我喜欢爬树。

es.e: the trunk of an old oak tree (= the main central part, from which the branches grow )
es.c: 一棵老橡树的树干

d: n 一餐，一顿饭；膳食 an occasion when you eat food, for example breakfast or dinner, or the food that you eat on that occasion；vi 进餐

es.e: We must have a meal together some time.
es.c: 我们一定要找个时间一起吃顿饭。

es.e: Dinner is the main meal of the day for most people.
es.c: 晚饭是大多数人一天中的主餐。

d: n 狮子；名人；勇猛的人；社交场合的名流 a large animal of the cat family that lives in Africa and parts of southern Asia. Lions have gold-coloured fur and the male has a mane(= long hair around its neck ).

v 记录，记载；标明；将录音 to write information down or store it in a computer or on film so that it can be looked at in the future；n 档案，履历；唱片；最高纪录 information about something that is written down or stored on computer, film etc so

es.e: Her husband made her record every penny she spent.
es.c: 她丈夫要她把花的每分钱都记下来。

es.e: The coroner recorded a verdict of accidental death.
es.c: 验尸官作出了意外死亡的结论。

es.e: Profits were at record levels.
es.c: 利润水平是创纪录的。

d: n 叉；餐叉；耙 a tool you use for picking up and eating food, with a handle and three or four points；v 叉起；使成叉状 to put food into your mouth or onto a plate using a fork

es.e: Put the knives and forks on the table.
es.c: 把刀叉摆放在桌子上。

d: v 完成；结束；用完 to complete the last part of something that you are doing；n 结束；完美；回味（葡萄酒）

es.e: You can’t go anywhere until you’ve finished your homework.
es.c: 没完成家庭作业前你哪儿也不能去。

es.e: Have you finished that book yet?
es.c: 那本书你看完了吗？

es.e: ‘How’s the decorating going?’ ‘We’ve nearly finished.’
es.c: “装修进行得怎么样了？”“差不多快完成了。”

d: v 开始；启动 to do something that you were not doing before, and continue doing it；n 开始；起点 the first part of an activity or event, or the point at which it begins to develop

es.e: There’s so much to do. I don’t know where to start.
es.c: 有那么多的事情要做，我都不知道从哪里开始。

es.e: Have you started your homework?
es.c: 你开始做家庭作业了吗？

es.e: I’d better get started (= start doing something ) soon.
es.c: 我最好马上就开始。

d: n 执照，许可证；特许；v 许可；特许；发许可证给 to give official permission for someone to do or produce something, or for an activity to take place

es.e: No special license will be regranted to anyone from now on.
es.c: 特殊许可证今后不得向任何人再行发放。

d: n 钢笔；作家；围栏 an instrument for writing or drawing with ink；v 写；关入栏中 to write something such as a letter, a book etc, especially using a pen

es.e: a ballpoint pen
es.c: 圆珠笔

es.e: a felt-tip pen
es.c: 毡头笔

es.e: a pen and ink drawing
es.c: 钢笔画

d: adj 低的，浅的；卑贱的；粗俗的；消沉的 bad, or below an acceptable or usual level or quality；adv 低声地；谦卑地，低下地 in or to a low position or level；n 低；低价；低点；牛叫声 a low price, level, or value；v 牛叫

es.e: Their safety standards seem to be pretty low.
es.c: 他们的安全标准似乎相当低。

es.e: Cost-cutting has led to a lower quality of service.
es.c: 削减成本导致服务质量降低。

es.e: the children’s low achievement in school
es.c: 孩子们在学校里不好的成绩

d: pron 谁的（疑问代词）

es.e: The word “dentist”denotes a doctor whose work is the care of teeth.
es.c: “牙科医生”一词意谓其工作是医治牙齿的医生。

d: n 同班同学 a member of the same class in a school, college or – in the US – a university

es.e: He acquainted his classmate with my sister.
es.c: 他把我妹妹介绍给他的同班同学。

es.e: He acquainted his classmate with my younger brother.
es.c: 他把我的弟弟介绍给他的同班同学。

es.e: I, who am your classmate, can understand you.
es.c: 我是你的同班同学,能了解你。

d: n 动物园 a place, usually in a city, where animals of many kinds are kept so that people can go to look at them

es.e: The road to the zoo turns off here.
es.c: 通向动物园的路由这儿拐弯。

es.e: The parrots in the zoo are popping all the time.
es.c: 动物园里的鹦鹉一直在生小鹦鹉。

es.e: Lionesses bearing cubs in the zoo is nothing new now.
es.c: 狮子在动物园繁殖早已屡见不鲜了。

d: n 岗位；邮件；标杆 letters, packages etc that are sent and delivered；v 张贴；公布；邮递；布置 to put up a public notice about something on a wall or notice board

es.e: Was there any post for me today?
es.c: 今天有我的邮件吗？

es.e: Emma was opening her post .
es.c: 埃玛正在拆邮件。

d: n 队；组 a group of people who play a game or sport together against another group；v 使合作 to put two things or people together, because they will look good or work well together

es.e: Which team do you support?
es.c: 你支持哪个队？

es.e: Our team are winning.
es.c: 现在是我们队赢。

d: adj 相同的；同一的；上述的（通常与the连用）；无变化的 used to say that a particular person or thing does not change；pron 同样的事物或人（通常与the连用） used to say that two or more people or things are exactly like each other；adv 同样地（通常与the连用） in the same

es.e: Her perfume has always had the same effect on me.
es.c: 她身上的香水给我的感觉一如既往。

es.e: He’s the same old Peter – moody and irritable.
es.c: 他还是以前那个彼得——喜怒无常且爱发火。

d: aux 能够；v 能（can的过去式） used as the past tense of ‘can’ to say what someone was able to do or was allowed to do in the past

es.e: I could do it, he mused.
es.c: 我能做这件事，他沉思着。

d: n 秘书；书记；部长；大臣 someone who works in an office  typing  letters, keeping records, answering telephone calls, arranging meetings etc

es.e: My secretary will fax you all the details.
es.c: 我的秘书会把所有的细节发传真给你。

d: n 地方；住所；座位 a space or area, for example a particular point on a surface or in a room, building, town, city etc；v 放置；任命；寄予 to put something somewhere, especially with care

es.e: Make sure you keep the key in a safe place.
es.c: 一定要把钥匙放在安全的地方。

es.e: I’ve spent the day dashing about from place to place.
es.c: 我这一天尽是在东奔西跑。

es.e: The place was full of screaming children.
es.c: 那地方全是大叫大嚷的孩子们。

d: n 超级市场；自助售货商店 a very large shop that sells food, drinks, and things that people need regularly in their homes

es.e: Most of us do our food shopping in the supermarket.
es.c: 我们大多数人在这家超市采购食品。

d: n [环境] 噪音；响声；杂音 a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or frightening；v 谣传 if news or information is noised abroad, people are talking about it

es.e: What’s that noise?
es.c: 那是什么声音？

es.e: Try not to make a noise when you go upstairs.
es.c: 上楼时尽量不要弄出声。

es.e: There was a lot of noise outside.
es.c: 外面很吵闹。

d: n 楼梯；梯级（stair的复数）

es.e: The  boy thumped down the stairs.
es.c: 小男孩咚咚地跑下楼梯。

es.e: The suitcase bounced down the stairs.
es.c: 衣箱一路颠跳着滚下楼梯。

es.e: The children pattered down the stairs.
es.c: 孩子们啪嗒啪嗒地跑下楼梯。

d: adj 北部的；北方的 in or from the north of a country or area；n 北部方言

es.e: a man with a northern accent
es.c: 带有北方口音的男子

es.e: Northern Europe
es.c: 北欧

d: n 领域；牧场；旷野；战场；运动场 a subject that people study or an area of activity that they are involved in as part of their work；v 担任场外队员 the team that is fielding in a game of  cricket  or baseball is the one that is throwing and c

es.e: Peter’s an expert in his field .
es.c: 彼得是他那个行业里的专家。

es.e: He’s the best-known American outside the field of (= not connected with ) politics.
es.c: 他是政治领域之外最出名的美国人。

es.e: I also conducted a field study among the boys about their attitude to relationships.
es.c: 我也在男生中进行了一项有关他们对人际关系态度的实地调查。

d: n 教室 a room that you have lessons in at a school or college

es.e: The boy bounced out of the classroom.
es.c: 那男孩突然从教室里奔出去。

es.e: The students swarmed out of the classroom.
es.c: 学生们蜂拥着跑出了教室。

es.e: She fainted in the classroom and was carried out.
es.c: 她在教室中昏过去了，并被抬了出来。

d: n 年级；等级；成绩；级别；阶段 a particular level of quality that a product, material etc has；v 评分；把…分等级 to say what level of a quality something has, or what standard it is

es.e: The best grades of tea are expensive.
es.c: 最上等的茶叶价格很贵。

es.e: industrial grade diamonds
es.c: 工业等级钻石

d: v 烹调，煮 to prepare food for eating by using heat；n 厨师，厨子 someone who prepares and cooks food as their job

es.e: Where did you learn to cook?
es.c: 你在哪里学烹调的？

es.e: Cook the sauce over a low heat for ten minutes.
es.c: 把这调味汁用低火烧十分钟。

es.e: slices of cooked ham
es.c: 熟的火腿片

d: pron 他（宾格） used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about；n (Him)人名；(东南亚国家华语)欣；(柬)亨；(中)谦(广东话·威妥玛)

es.e: Are you in love with him?
es.c: 你爱上他了吗？

es.e: Why don’t you ask him yourself?
es.c: 你为什么不自己问他？

es.e: He repeated what she had told him.
es.c: 他把她告诉他的话重复了一遍。

d: n 移动；步骤；迁居；策略 when someone moves for a short time in a particular direction；v 移动；搬家，迁移；离开 to change from one place or position to another, or to make something do this

es.e: Good gymnasts rehearse their moves mentally before a competition.
es.c: 优秀的体操运动员赛前都会在心中默默地把动作过一遍。

es.e: He made no move to come any nearer.
es.c: 他没有再靠近。

es.e: Martin made a move towards the door.
es.c: 马丁朝门口挪了挪。

d: n 洗涤；洗的衣服；化妆水；冲积物 an act of cleaning something using soap and water；v 洗涤；洗刷；冲走；拍打 to clean something using water and a type of soap

es.e: Those jeans need a good wash (= a thorough wash ).
es.c: 那条牛仔裤要好好洗一洗了。

es.e: I’ll just have a quick wash before we go out.
es.c: 我很快洗个澡，然后我们就出门。

d: adj 阳光充足的，和煦的；快活的；性情开朗的 having a lot of light from the sun

es.e: a warm sunny day
es.c: 温暖晴朗的一天

es.e: a sunny morning
es.c: 艳阳高照的上午

es.e: a nice sunny room
es.c: 阳光充足的房间

d: n 玫瑰；粉红色；蔷薇（花）；粉红色的葡萄酒 a flower that often has a pleasant smell, and is usually red, pink, white, or yellow, or the bush that this flower grows on；adj 玫瑰花的；玫瑰色的；粉红色的；带有玫瑰香味的 pink in colour；vt 使成玫瑰色，使（面颊）发红；使有玫瑰香味 to make

es.e: a dozen red roses
es.c: 一打红玫瑰

es.e: A large bouquet of roses arrived on her desk.
es.c: 一大束玫瑰送到了她的桌子上。

d: n 第七；七分之一 one of seven equal parts of something；adj 第七的；七分之一的 coming after six other things in a series；adv 居第七位地

es.e: Both will meet in your seventh house of partnerships, so to unlock your good fortune, you need to collaborate with a partner.
es.c: 它们将在你表合作关系的第七宫会面，如果你有一个合作伙伴的话，它们将合作释放出你的好运气。

d: n 地面；土地；范围；战场;根据 a good reason for doing, believing, or saying something；v 使接触地面；打基础；使搁浅 if you ground a boat or if it grounds, it hits the bottom of the sea so that it cannot move；adj 土地的；地面上的；磨碎的；磨过的 ground coffee or n

es.e: There are strong grounds for believing his statement.
es.c: 有充分的理由可以相信他的话。

es.e: ‘You’re under arrest.’ ‘On what grounds?’
es.c: “你被捕了。”“理由是什么？”

d: n 一百；许多 a very large number of things or people；adj 一百的；许多的；num 百；百个 completely

es.e: Plank down your one hundred dollars.
es.c: 立即支付一百美元。

d: n 领导者；首领；指挥者 the person who directs or controls a group, organization, country etc

es.e: the largest ever gathering of world leaders
es.c: 全世界领导人史无前例的大聚会

d: n 故事；小说；新闻报道；来历；假话 a description of how something happened, that is intended to entertain people, and may be true or imaginary；vt 用历史故事画装饰 to decorate (a pot, wall, etc) with scenes from history or legends；vi 说谎

es.e: a book of short stories
es.c: 短篇小说集

es.e: We cuddled together over a bedtime story .
es.c: 我们依偎在一起看睡前故事。

es.e: The film was based on a true story .
es.c: 这部影片是根据真实故事改编的。

d: n 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问 the part of a person’s or animal’s face used for smelling or breathing；v 嗅；用鼻子触

es.e: Someone punched him on the nose.
es.c: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。

d: n 教堂；礼拜；教派 a building where Christians go to worship；adj 教会的；礼拜的；v 领…到教堂接受宗教仪式

es.e: a short church service
es.c: 简短的教堂礼拜仪式

es.e: church bells
es.c: 教堂的钟

d: adv 也；而且；同样 in addition to something else that you have mentioned；conj 并且；另外；n (Also)人名；(罗)阿尔索

es.e: Information is also available on women’s health care.
es.c: 还可以获得有关女性保健方面的资料。

es.e: She sings beautifully and also plays the flute and piano.
es.c: 她歌唱得好，而且还会吹长笛和弹钢琴。

es.e: The system was not only complicated but also ineffective.
es.c: 这套系统不仅复杂而且效率低。

d: v 装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职 if a container or place fills, or if you fill it, enough of something goes into it to make it full；n 满足；填满的量；装填物

es.e: He poured her a drink, then filled his own glass.
es.c: 他给她倒了一杯，然后将自己的杯子斟满。

es.e: My job was filling the flour sacks.
es.c: 我的工作是装面粉袋。

es.e: Take a deep breath and allow your lungs to fill.
es.c: 深吸一口气，让肺部涨满。

d: n 沙发；长椅 a comfortable seat with raised arms and a back, that is wide enough for two or three people to sit on

es.e: He sprang up from the sofa.
es.c: 他从沙发上猛然跳了起来。

es.e: She spread a sheet on the sofa for me.
es.c: 她为我在沙发上铺了一条单子。

es.e: There's enough space to have a sofa there.
es.c: 那里还有足够的地方放下一个沙发。

d: num 第九 one of nine equal parts of something；adj 第九的；九分之一的 coming after eight other things in a series；n 九分之一 one of nine equal parts of something

es.e: In that region, Chile went from ninth to first, overall, as Chilean mobile web use increased by 3200% over the past year.
es.c: 智利从这一地区的第九跃升到第一位，因为智利的移动网络用户在过去一年增长了 3200% 。

es.e: Then, in eighth or ninth grade, I studied astronomy, cosmology, and the origins of the universe.
es.c: 后来，在八、九年级的时候，我在学习天文学，宇宙学和宇宙的起源。

d: n 公共汽车 a large vehicle that people pay to travel on

es.e: I took a bus to San Francisco.
es.c: 我乘公共汽车去旧金山。

es.e: Buses run at 15 and 30 minutes past the hour.
es.c: 公共汽车在每小时的15分和30分时发车。

d: n 英寸；身高；少许 a unit for measuring length, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.；v 使缓慢地移动 to move very slowly in a particular direction, or to make something do this

es.e: The curtains were an inch too short.
es.c: 窗帘短了一英寸。

es.e: Rainfall here is under 15 inches a year.
es.c: 本地的年降雨量不到15英寸。

d: adj 热的；辣的；热情的；激动的；紧迫的 food that tastes hot has a burning taste because it contains strong spices；adv 热；紧迫地；v 变热；n (Hot)人名；(塞)霍特；(法)奥特

es.e: a hot curry
es.c: 一种辛辣的咖喱

d: v 游戏；扮演；演奏；播放；同…比赛 to perform a piece of music on a musical instrument；n 游戏；比赛；剧本 a story that is written to be performed by actors, especially in a theatre

es.e: He’s learning to play the piano.
es.c: 他在学习弹钢琴。

es.e: She played a Bach prelude.
es.c: 她演奏了一首巴赫的前奏曲。

es.e: Haden has played with many jazz greats.
es.c: 黑登和许多著名的爵士乐手合作过。

d: n 邮递员；邮差 someone whose job is to collect and deliver letters

es.e: That postman is in charge of this route.
es.c: 那个邮递员负责这条投递线路。

es.e: The old man often stands here to watch out for the postman.
es.c: 老人常常站在这儿等邮递员。

es.e: At the door he met an intelligent postman coming out with letters for the morning delivery.
es.c: 他在邮政总局门口碰见一个伶俐的邮差，拿着信从邮局走出来，去送早班信。

d: v 接触；触动；使轻度受害 if two things touch, or one thing touches another thing, they reach each other so that there is no space between them；n 接触；触觉；格调；少许 the sense that you use to discover what something feels like, by putting y

es.e: As our glasses touched, he said ‘Cheers!’
es.c: 我们的酒杯相碰时，他说了声:“干杯！”

es.e: Her dress was so long that it was touching the ground.
es.c: 她的裙子很长，都拖到地上了。

d: adj 白色的；白种的；纯洁的 having the colour of milk, salt, or snow；n 白色；洁白；白种人 the colour of milk, salt, and snow

es.e: a white dress
es.c: 白色连衣裙

d: n 早餐；早饭 the meal you have in the morning；v 吃早餐 When you breakfast, you have breakfast

es.e: We had bacon and eggs for breakfast .
es.c: 我们早餐吃了熏肉鸡蛋。

es.e: I never eat breakfast .
es.c: 我从来不吃早饭。

es.e: After a hearty breakfast (=  large breakfast  ) , we set out for a hike.
es.c: 我们吃了一顿丰盛的早餐，然后出发去远足了。

d: n 目标；物体；客体；宾语 a solid thing that you can hold, touch, or see but that is not alive；v 提出…作为反对的理由 to state a fact or opinion as a reason for opposing or disapproving of something

es.e: an everyday object such as a spoon
es.c: 调羹之类的日常用品

es.e: a small metal object
es.c: 一个小金属物件

es.e: scientists studying plants, animals, or inanimate objects
es.c: 研究植物、动物或无生命物体的科学家

d: n 丝绸；蚕丝；丝织物 a thin smooth soft cloth made from very thin thread which is produced by a silkworm；adj 丝的；丝绸的；丝制的；vi （玉米）处于长须的阶段中

es.e: pure silk stockings
es.c: 生丝面料的漂亮连衣裙

d: aux 应该；就；可能；将要
adj 便宜的；小气的；不值钱的 not at all expensive, or lower in price than you expected；adv 便宜地 at a low price

es.e: cheap rail fares
es.c: 便宜的火车票

es.e: the cheapest TV on the market
es.c: 市场上最便宜的电视机

es.e: Property is cheaper in Spain than here.
es.c: 西班牙的房地产比这里便宜。

es.c: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

es.e: full public access to information
