es.c: “你有多少张CD？”“多着呢。”

es.e: Matthew's out quite a lot doing his research.
es.c: 马修经常出去做研究。

d: conj 或，或者；还是 used between two words or phrases to show that either of two things is possible, or used before the last in a list of possibilities or choices；n (Or)人名；(中)柯(广东话·威妥玛)；(柬)奥；(土、匈、土库、阿塞、瑞典)奥尔

es.e: Shall we go out to the cinema or stay at home?
es.c: 我们是出去看电影还是待在家里？

es.e: You can have ham, cheese, or tuna.
es.c: 你可以选择火腿、干酪或者金枪鱼。

es.e: She wasn’t involved in drugs or anything like that.
es.c: 她没有涉毒之类的行为。

d: adv 也许；可能；大概 used to say that something may happen or may be true but you are not certain；n 可能性；不确定性

es.e: Maybe it’s all just a big misunderstanding.
es.c: 也许这只是一个很大的误会。

es.e: ‘Do you think he’ll come back?’ ‘Maybe.’
es.c: “你认为他会回来吗？”“也许会吧。”

es.e: Maybe they’re right, but maybe not .
es.c: 也许他们是对的，但也许不是。

d: n 责任；[税收] 关税；职务 something that you have to do because it is morally or legally right

es.e: I promise I will do my duty .
es.c: 我保证会尽到我的责任。

es.e: We feel it is our duty to help her.
es.c: 我们感到帮助她是我们的责任。

es.e: Local authorities have a duty to keep the streets clean.
es.c: 地方当局有责任保持街道整洁。

d: v 计算；认为 to include someone or something in a total；n 计数；计算；伯爵 the process of counting, or the total that you get when you count things

es.e: There are more than two thousand of us, not counting the crew.
es.c: 我们有两千多人，不包括工作人员在内。

d: n 三十年代 the number 30；num 三十 the number 30；adj 三十个的

es.e: In the thirties, air travel really began to take off.
es.c: 在30年代，乘飞机旅行迅速流行了起来。

d: n 目标；球门，得分数；终点 something that you hope to achieve in the future；vi 攻门，射门得分

es.e: Your goal as a parent is to help your child become an independent adult.
es.c: 身为父母，你的目标就是要培养孩子成为独立的成年人。

d: n 字典；词典 a book that gives a list of words in alphabetical order and explains their meanings in the same language, or another language

es.e: a German-English dictionary
es.c: 一本德英词典

d: n 衬衫；汗衫，内衣 a piece of clothing that covers the upper part of your body and your arms, usually has a collar, and is fastened at the front by buttons

es.e: I have to wear a shirt and tie to work.
es.c: 我上班要穿衬衫打领带。

es.e: a check shirt
es.c: 格子衬衫

d: n 会议；会见；集会；汇合点 an event at which people meet to discuss and decide things；v 会面；会合（meet的ing形式）

es.e: We’re having a meeting next week to discuss the matter.
es.c: 我们下周将开会讨论此事。

d: n 一半；半场；半学年 exactly or about 50% (1/2) of an amount, time, distance, number etc；adv 一半地；部分地 partly, but not completely；adj 一半的；不完全的；半途的 Half is also an adjective

es.e: Only half the guests had arrived by seven o’clock.
es.c: 7点钟前只来了一半客人。

es.e: If you look at our members, at least half are women.
es.c: 看看我们的会员，至少有一半是女性。

es.e: ...a half measure of fresh lemon juice.
es.c: …半量杯的新鲜柠檬汁。

d: adj 短的；不足的；矮的，低的 happening or continuing for only a little time or for less time than usual；n 短；缺乏；短路；短裤 a short film shown in the cinema；adv 不足；突然；唐突地 to almost do something but then decide not to do it

es.e: a short meeting
es.c: 一个短会

es.e: Morris gave a short laugh.
es.c: 莫里斯笑了一声。

es.e: a short course on business English
es.c: 商业英语短期课程

d: v 系；约束；打结；与…成平局 if two players, teams etc tie or are tied in a game or competition, they finish it with an equal number of points；n 领带；平局；鞋带；领结；不分胜负 a long narrow piece of cloth tied in a knot around the neck, worn by me

es.e: He tied the ends of the plastic bag together.
es.c: 他把塑料袋的两头系在一起。

d: n 希望；期望；信心 a feeling of wanting something to happen or be true and believing that it is possible or likely；v 希望；期望 to want something to happen or be true and to believe that it is possible or likely

es.e: When I first arrived in New York, I was full of hope for the future.
es.c: 我初到纽约时，对未来充满希望。

d: n 八十；八十岁；八十年代 the number 80；adj 八十的，八十个的；八十岁的；num 八十 the number 80

es.e: The band was incredibly successful in the eighties.
es.c: 这支乐队在80年代红透半边天。

d: adj 私人的；私有的；私下的 for use by one person or group, not for everyone；n 列兵；二等兵 a soldier of the lowest rank

es.e: Morris has a private jet.
es.c: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

es.e: He made some notes for his private use.
es.c: 他记了些笔记供自己所用。

es.e: They objected to any form of private property .
es.c: 他们反对任何形式的私有财产。

d: n 奖品；奖赏；战利品 something that is given to someone who is successful in a competition, race, game of chance etc；v 珍视；捕获；估价 to think that someone or something is very important or valuable；adj 获奖的 good enough to win a prize o

es.e: In this month’s competition you could win a prize worth £3,000.
es.c: 在本月的竞赛中您可以赢得价值3,000英镑的奖品。

es.e: The first prize has gone to Dr John Gentle.
es.c: 获得一等奖的是约翰·金特尔博士。

es.e: The prizes are awarded (= given ) every year to students who have shown original thinking in their work.
es.c: 这些奖项每年颁发给在学习中表现出创造性思维的学生。

d: n 妻子，已婚妇女；夫人 the woman that a man is married to

es.e: Have you met my wife?
es.c: 你见过我的妻子吗？

es.e: a refuge for battered wives
es.c: 受虐待妻子庇护所

es.e: his second wife
es.c: 他的第二任妻子

d: adj 第十二的，第十二个的；十二分之一的；n 第十二；月的第十二日

es.e: He poled his twelfth home run in the sixth inning.
es.c: 在第六回合他打出了他的第十二次本垒打。

d: n 短裤 trousers reaching the top of the thigh or partway to the knee, worn by both sexes for sport, relaxing in summer, etc

es.e: I like your shorts, Jake.
es.c: 杰克， 我喜欢你的短裤。

es.e: Where are my shorts?
es.c: 我的短裤在哪里？

es.e: Now I have a cool pair of shorts for riding.
es.c: 现在我就有了一条骑车时的酷酷短裤啦！

d: v 写，写字；写作，作曲；写信 to put words in a letter to someone

es.e: I wrote her several letters , but she didn’t reply.
es.c: 我给她写了几封信，可是她没有回复。

d: n [物] 能量；精力；活力；精神 power that is used to provide heat, operate machines etc

es.e: The water is heated using energy from the sun.
es.c: 水是利用太阳能加热的。

es.e: The problem with nuclear energy is dealing with the waste.
es.c: 核能的问题就是要处理核废料。

d: n 先生；（用于姓名前）爵士；阁下；（中小学生对男教师的称呼）先生；老师 used when speaking to a man in order to be polite or show respect

es.e: ‘Report back to me in an hour, sergeant.’ ‘Yes, sir.’
es.c: “一小时后向我报告，中士。”“是，长官。”

es.e: Can I help you, sir?
es.c: 我能为您效劳吗，先生？

es.e: Sir! You dropped your wallet.
es.c: 先生！ 您的钱包掉了。

d: n 商店；储备，贮藏；仓库 a place where goods are sold to the public. In British English, a store is large and sells many different things, but in American English, a store can be large or small, and sell many things or only one typ

es.e: At Christmas the stores stay open late.
es.c: 在圣诞节期间，商店营业到很晚。

d: n 草；草地，草坪 an area of grass, especially an area where the grass is kept cut short；v 放牧；使……长满草；使……吃草

es.e: I walked across the grass.
es.c: 我走在草地上。

es.e: Keep off the grass.
es.c: 请勿践踏草地。

d: n 汤，羹；马力 cooked liquid food, often containing small pieces of meat, fish, or vegetables；v 加速；增加马力

es.e: homemade tomato soup
es.c: 自制的番茄汤

d: n 街道 a public road in a city or town that has houses, shops etc on one or both sides；adj 街道的

es.e: We moved to Center Street when I was young.
es.c: 在我小时候，我们搬到了中心大街。

es.e: She lives just a few streets away.
es.c: 她的住处就在几条街外。

es.e: I walked on further down the street .
es.c: 我继续沿着马路走。

d: n 事实；实际；真相 a piece of information that is known to be true

es.e: Our decision to build the museum in Hartlepool was influenced by the fact that there were no national museums in the North East.
es.c: 我们之所以决定在哈特尔浦建造博物馆，是因为东北地区没有国家级的博物馆。

d: v 帮助；促进；治疗；补救 to make it possible or easier for someone to do something by doing part of their work or by giving them something they need；n 帮助；补救办法；帮忙者；有益的东西 things you do to make it easier or possible for someone to do

es.e: If there’s anything I can do to help, just give me a call.
es.c: 如果需要我帮忙，就给我打个电话。

d: n [地理][水文] 冰碛；放钱的抽屉；备用现金 money in the till is money that a company or organization has；prep 直到 until；conj 直到为止；v 耕种；犁 to prepare land for growing crops

es.e: You keep as much money as you need in the till to run your operations.
es.c: 你做业务要储备足够的钱。

d: n 故事；传说；叙述；流言蜚语 a story about exciting imaginary events

es.e: a book of old Japanese folk tales
es.c: 日本古老民间故事书

es.e: a fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen
es.c: 安徒生的一则童话

es.e: a cautionary tale
es.c: 警示故事

d: adj 活着的；活泼的；有生气的 still living and not dead

es.e: It was a bad accident – they’re lucky to be alive.
es.c: 这是一宗严重事故——他们能活着实属幸运。

es.e: My grandparents are still alive .
es.c: 我的祖父母和外祖父母都还健在。

es.e: We stayed alive by eating berries.
es.c: 我们靠吃浆果活命。

d: n 油；石油；油画颜料 the thick dark liquid from under the ground from which petrol is produced；v 加油；涂油；使融化 to put oil onto part of a machine or part of something that moves, to help it to move or work more smoothly

es.e: a rise in the price of oil
es.c: 石油价格的上涨

es.e: the importance of protecting our oil supplies
es.c: 保护我们石油供应的重要性

es.e: an oil refinery
es.c: 炼油厂

d: adj 可爱的；令人愉快的；爱恋的；秀丽的，优美的 beautiful or attractive；n 美女；可爱的东西

es.e: She had a lovely face.
es.c: 她有一张漂亮的脸蛋。

es.e: What a lovely house!
es.c: 多么漂亮的房子啊！

es.e: You look lovely in that dress.
es.c: 你穿那条连衣裙很漂亮。

d: n 角色；任务 the character played by an actor in a play or film

es.e: She has just landed the lead role in their latest production.
es.c: 她刚在他们最新的作品中取得了主角。

d: adj 安静的；安定的；不动的；温顺的 not making much noise, or making no noise at all；n 安静；和平 the state of being quiet, calm, and peaceful；v 使平息；安慰

es.e: We’ll have to be quiet so as not to wake the baby.
es.c: 我们得安静点，免得吵醒宝宝。

es.e: It’s a nice car. The engine’s really quiet.
es.c: 这车真好，发动机声音很小。

es.e: I’ll be as quiet as a mouse (= very quiet ).
es.c: 我会像老鼠一样悄无声息的。

d: n 试验；检验 a set of questions, exercises, or practical activities to measure someone’s skill, ability, or knowledge；v 试验；测试 to examine a substance or thing in order to find out its qualities or what it contains

es.e: Did you get a good mark in the test?
es.c: 你这次测验成绩好吗？

d: v 包含，包括 if one thing includes another, the second thing is part of the first

es.e: Does the price include postage?
es.c: 这个价格包含邮费吗？

es.e: His job includes looking after under-21 teams.
es.c: 他的职责包括照管21岁以下球队。

es.e: The curriculum includes courses in computing.
es.c: 课程内容包括计算机技术。

d: adj 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的 in clear and simple words, without using technical language；n 平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西 a large area of flat dry land；adv 清楚地；平易地

es.e: The document, written in plain English, tells you about your new policy.
es.c: 这份文件用简明的英语写成，解释了你们的新政策。

d: adv 在某处；到某处 in or to a place, but you do not say or know exactly where；n 某个地方

es.e: My wallet must be around here somewhere.
es.c: 我的钱包肯定是在这里的什么地方。

es.e: We could meet for dinner at Giorgio’s or somewhere (= or a similar place ) .
es.c: 我们可以在乔治家或别的什么地方一起吃饭。

d: n 精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒 the qualities that make someone live the way they do, and make them different from other people；v 鼓励；鼓舞；诱拐

es.e: His spirits were so low (= he was so sad ) that he refused to answer his phone.
es.c: 他情绪非常低落，连电话也不愿接。

d: n 办公室；政府机关；官职；营业处 a room where someone has a desk and works, on their own or with other people

es.e: the manager’s office
es.c: 经理办公室

es.e: Sorry, Ann’s not in her office right now.
es.c: 很抱歉，安现在不在办公室里。

es.e: Dan shares an office with Lisa.
es.c: 丹和莉萨共用一间办公室。

d: adj 健康的，健全的；有益于健康的 physically strong and not likely to become ill or weak

es.e: a healthy baby boy
es.c: 健康的男婴

es.e: I’ve always been perfectly healthy until now.
es.c: 直到现在，我的身体一直非常健康。

d: n 二十分之一；adj 第二十的；二十分之一的；num 第二十

es.e: One twentieth of the total output was exported.
es.c: 产量中有二十分之一出口。

d: n [园艺] 梨树；梨子 a sweet juicy fruit that has a round base and is thinner near the top, or the tree that produces this fruit

es.e: I took this apple for a pear until I tasted it.
es.c: 我误将这个苹果当作梨子，直到我尝了才知道。

d: adj 聪明的；巧妙的；敏捷的；厉害的；潇洒的；剧烈的；时髦的 intelligent or sensible；n (Smart)人名；(法)斯马尔；(英、德)斯马特

es.e: The smart kids get good grades and go off to college.
es.c: 聪明的孩子成绩好，可以去上大学。

es.e: I was smart enough to wait for a week.
es.c: 我很明智，等了一个星期。

es.e: His decision to become a director was a smart move (= sensible thing to do ) .
es.c: 他决定要做导演，这是明智之举。

d: n 熊猫；猫熊 a large black and white animal that looks like a bear and lives in the mountains of China

es.e: The caged panda chafed against the bars.
es.c: 笼子里的大熊猫贴在栅栏上蹭它的身体。

es.e: No. If the panda  has not quit by morning .
es.c: 不，如果明天早上那熊猫还不走

d: n 火车；行列；长队；裙裾 a set of several carriages that are connected to each other and pulled along a railway line by an engine；v 培养；训练；瞄准 to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills

es.e: We went all the way to Inverness by train.
es.c: 我们一路坐火车到因弗内斯。

d: n 公园；[交] 停车场 a large open area with grass and trees, especially in a town, where people can walk, play games etc；v 停放；放置；寄存 to put a car or other vehicle in a particular place for a period of time

es.e: Let’s go for a walk in the park.
es.c: 我们去公园散步吧。

es.e: a park bench
es.c: 公园长椅

es.e: a flat overlooking Hyde Park
es.c: 一套可以俯瞰海德公园的公寓

d: v 出世（bear的过去分词） when a person or animal is born, they come out of their mother’s body or out of an egg；adj 天生的 someone who has a strong natural ability to lead, play music etc；n (Born)人名；(柬)邦；(英、西、俄、捷、德、瑞典、匈)博恩

es.e: Forty lambs were born this spring.
es.c: 今年春天有40头小羊羔出生。

es.e: I was born and raised (=  was born and grew up  ) in Alabama.
es.c: 我是土生土长的亚拉巴马人。

es.e: a newly-born baby
es.c: 新生儿，初生婴儿

d: n 进步，发展；前进 the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something；v 前进，进步；进行 to improve, develop, or achieve things so that you are then at a more advanced stage

es.e: We made good progress despite the snow.
es.c: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

d: n [脊椎] 斑马 an animal that looks like a horse but has black and white lines all over its body；adj 有斑纹的

es.e: The neck of the zebra was nipped by a lion.
es.c: 狮子咬断了那头斑马的脖子。

es.e: But what if your horse suddenly grows zebra stripes?
es.c: 可是如果那匹马突然长出了斑马的条纹呢？

es.e: Sixty acres of woods and ponds are home to camels, zebra, bison, water buffalo, ostrich and antelope.
es.c: 六十英亩的森林和池塘是骆驼，斑马，野牛，水牛，鸵鸟和羚羊的家园。

d: v 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶 to rest when you have an illness or injury so that it will get better；n 护士；奶妈，保姆 someone whose job is to look after people who are ill or injured, usually in a hospital

es.e: Shaw has been nursing an injury, and will not play on Sunday.
es.c: 肖一直在养伤，星期天将不参加比赛。

d: n 许诺，允诺；希望 A promise is a statement that you make to a person in which you say that you will definitely do something or give them something；v 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望 If you promise that you will do something, you say to someone

es.e: If you make a promise, you should keep it.
es.c: 如果你许下一个诺言，你就应该遵守它。

es.e: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday.
es.c: 邮局已承诺在星期五恢复该地区第一类邮件的递送。

es.e: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment.
es.c: 他已承诺富人和特权阶层将不会再得到优待。

d: n 女孩；姑娘，未婚女子；女职员，女演员；（男人的）女朋友 a female child

es.e: Both boys and girls can apply to join the choir.
es.c: 男孩和女孩均可申请加入合唱团。

es.e: Girls! Please be quiet.
es.c: 姑娘们！请安静。

es.e: a teenage girl
es.c: 十几岁的女孩

d: n 交通；运输；贸易；[通信] 通信量 the vehicles moving along a road or street；v 用…作交换；在…通行

es.e: There wasn’t much traffic on the roads.
es.c: 路上车辆不多。

es.e: The sound of the traffic kept me awake.
es.c: 车辆来往的嘈杂声令我无法入睡。

d: v 翻译；转化；解释；转变为；调动 to change written or spoken words into another language

es.e: Poetry doesn’t usually translate well.
es.c: 诗歌通常都译不好。

d: n 风险；危险；冒险 the possibility that something bad, unpleasant, or dangerous may happen；v 冒…的危险 to put something in a situation in which it could be lost, destroyed, or harmed

es.e: It was a risk, sending a letter to my house.
es.c: 将信寄到我家是冒险。

d: n 顶部，顶端；上部；首席；陀螺 the highest part of something；v 高出，超越；结束；达到顶点 to be higher than a particular amount；adj 最高的，顶上的；头等的 nearest to the top of something

es.e: a low wooden table with a glass top
es.c: 玻璃桌面的矮木桌

d: v 用糖煮；使结晶为砂糖；美化；n 糖果（等于sweets）；冰糖（等于sugar candy，rock candy）；毒品 Candy is sweet foods such as chocolate or toffees；adj 新潮的（服饰）；甜言蜜语的

es.e: ...a piece of candy.
es.c: …一块糖果。

d: n 西；西方；西部 the direction towards which the sun goes down, and which is on the left if you are facing north；adj 西方的；朝西的 in the west or facing the west；adv 在西方；向西方；自西方 towards the west

es.e: There’s a slight chance of some sunshine in the west.
es.c: 西部地区见晴的可能性不大。

d: n 肩，肩膀；肩部 one of the two parts of the body at each side of the neck where the arm is connected；v 肩负，承担 to accept a difficult or unpleasant responsibility, duty etc

es.e: She tapped the driver on the shoulder.
es.c: 她拍拍司机的肩。

es.e: He put his arm around her shoulders.
es.c: 他用手臂搂住她的肩。

es.e: His shoulders were broad and powerful.
es.c: 他的肩膀宽阔强壮。

d: adj 成功的；一帆风顺的 achieving what you wanted, or having the effect or result you intended

es.e: The operation was successful.
es.c: 手术成功了。

es.e: a highly successful (= very successful ) meeting
es.c: 十分成功的会议

d: n 晚餐，晚宴；宴会；正餐 the main meal of the day, eaten in the middle of the day or the evening

es.e: What time do you usually have dinner?
es.c: 你通常什么时候吃饭？

es.e: We’re having fish for dinner tonight.
es.c: 我们今天晚饭吃鱼。

es.e: What’s for dinner?
es.c: 晚饭吃什么？

d: n 陌生人；外地人；局外人 someone that you do not know

es.e: Children must not talk to strangers.
es.c: 小孩子千万不要同陌生人说话。

d: n 教育；培养；教育学 the process of teaching and learning, usually at school, college, or university

es.e: She also hopes her children will get a good education.
es.c: 她也希望她的孩子可以受到良好的教育。

es.e: efforts to improve girls’ access to education
es.c: 为增加女孩受教育机会所作的努力

d: n 战争，斗争；军事，战术；冲突，对抗，竞争 when there is fighting between two or more countries or between opposing groups within a country, involving large numbers of soldiers and weapons；v 打仗，作战；对抗

es.e: the Vietnam War
es.c: 越南战争

es.e: He served as a pilot during the war.
es.c: 他在战时担任飞行员。

d: n 深处；深渊；adj 深的；低沉的；深奥的 going far in from the outside or from the front edge of something；adv 深入地；深深地；迟 a long way into or below the surface of something

es.e: a deep wound
es.c: 很深的伤口

es.e: She was sitting in a deep leather chair.
es.c: 她坐在一张很深的皮椅子里。

d: n 西瓜 a large round fruit with hard green skin, red flesh, and black seeds

es.e: Oh, what a big watermelon!
es.c: 喔唷， 这么大的西瓜!

es.e: A watermelon is red inside and green outside.
es.c: 西瓜内红外绿。

es.e: This kind of watermelon is remarkable for its size.
es.c: 这种西瓜个头儿大。

d: n 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分 a very common water bird with short legs and a wide beak, used for its meat, eggs, and soft feathers；v 闪避；没入水中 to push someone under water for a short time as a joke

es.e: roast duck with orange sauce
es.c: 烤鸭配橘子酱

d: adj 向前的；早的；迅速的 closer to a person, place, or position that is in front of you；adv 向前地；向将来 towards a place or position that is in front of you；v 促进；转寄；运送 to successfully complete one stage of a competition so that you are

es.e: Army roadblocks prevented any further forward movement .
es.c: 有军队的路障，不能继续前行了。

es.e: Always enter or leave a helicopter from a forward direction.
es.c: 一定要从正侧方上下直升机。

d: v 爬；攀登；上升 to move up, down, or across something using your feet and hands, especially when this is difficult to do；n 爬；攀登 a process in which you move up towards a place, especially while using a lot of effort

es.e: Harry climbed the stairs.
es.c: 哈里爬上楼梯。

es.e: Boys were climbing trees along the river bank.
es.c: 男孩们在河边爬树。

d: adv 立即，立刻；直接地 without delay；conj 一…就 as soon as

es.e: Mix in the remaining ingredients and serve immediately.
es.c: 拌入余下的食材，立即上桌。

es.e: The telephone rang, and he answered it immediately.
es.c: 电话铃响了，他马上去接。

d: n 国际象棋，西洋棋 a game for two players, who move their playing pieces according to particular rules across a special board to try to trap their opponent’s  king (= most important piece )

es.e: They meet fairly often to play chess .
es.c: 他们经常在一起下国际象棋。

d: n 讨论，议论 when you discuss something

es.e: class discussions
es.c: 课堂讨论

es.e: the topics suggested for discussion
es.c: 建议讨论的话题

es.e: We have had discussions about her legal situation.
es.c: 我们就她的法律状况已进行了讨论。

d: n 羔羊，小羊；羔羊肉 a young sheep；v 生小羊，产羔羊 to give birth to lambs

es.e: roast lamb
es.c: 烤羊肉

d: n 丰富，大量；充足 a situation in which there is a lot of food and goods available for people；adj 足够的，很多的；adv 足够 used to emphasize that something is more than big enough, fast enough etc

es.e: a land of plenty
es.c: 一片富饶的土地

d: n 汽车；车厢 a vehicle with four wheels and an engine, that can carry a small number of passengers

es.e: Dan got out of the car and locked the door.
es.c: 丹下了车，锁上车门。

es.e: He isn’t old enough to drive a car.
es.c: 他还未到可以开车的年龄。

es.e: Coughlan was killed in a car accident.
es.c: 科赫兰死于一场车祸。

d: adj 整齐的；相当大的 a room, house, desk etc that is tidy is neatly arranged with everything in the right place；v 整理；收拾；弄整齐 to make a place look tidy；n 椅子的背罩

es.e: a tidy desk
es.c: 整洁的书桌

es.e: I try to keep the garden tidy .
es.c: 我尽量保持花园整洁。

es.e: Ellen’s room is always neat and tidy .
es.c: 埃伦的房间总是非常整洁。

d: n 粉红色；化身，典范；石竹花；头面人物 a pale red colour；v 扎，刺，戳；使…变粉红色；使…面红耳赤 to prick lightly with a sword or rapier；adj 粉红的；比较激进的；石竹科的；脸色发红的 pale red

es.e: Her room was decorated in bright pinks and purples.
es.c: 她的房间装饰成明亮的粉红色和紫色。

es.e: She had arrived dressed in pink.
es.c: 她穿着粉色的衣服来了。

d: adj 某一；必然的；确信；无疑的；有把握的 confident and sure, without any doubts；pron 某些；某几个 particular people or things in a group；n (Certain)人名；(葡)塞尔塔因；(法)塞尔坦

es.e: I felt certain that I’d passed the test.
es.c: 我感觉自己肯定通过这次测验了。

d: adj 必要的；必需的；必然的 something that is necessary is what you need to have or need to do；n 必需品 things such as food or basic clothes that you need in order to live

es.e: The booklet provides all the necessary information about the college.
es.c: 这本小册子提供了关于那所学院的所有必需信息。

es.e: No further changes were considered necessary.
es.c: 没有必要作出进一步改变。

es.e: The doctor says it may be necessary for me to have an operation.
es.c: 医生说我可能需要做手术。

d: n 桥；桥牌；桥接器；船桥 a structure built over a river, road etc that allows people or vehicles to cross from one side to the other；v 架桥；渡过 to build or form a bridge over something

es.e: He walked back over the railway bridge.
es.c: 他从铁路桥上走了回去。

d: n 水平；标准；水平面 the amount or degree of something, compared to another amount or degree；adj 水平的；平坦的；同高的 flat and not sloping in any direction；v 瞄准；拉平；变得平坦 to make the score in a game or competition equal

es.e: Inflation fell to its lowest level in 30 years.
es.c: 通货膨胀降至30年来最低点。

d: n 儿子；孩子（对年轻人的称呼）；男性后裔 someone’s male child

es.e: Her son Sean was born in 1983.
es.c: 她的儿子肖恩出生于 1983 年。

es.e: They have three sons and a daughter.
es.c: 他们有三个儿子和一个女儿。

es.e: In those days, the property went to the oldest son.
es.c: 那时候，财产由长子继承。

d: adj 可获得的；可购得的；可找到的；有空的 something that is available is able to be used or can easily be bought or found

es.e: Tickets are available from the box office.
es.c: 售票处有票出售。

es.e: Meetings were held to update employees as soon as new information became available .
es.c: 一有新的信息就开会告诉员工。

es.e: Further building can continue when money is made available .
es.c: 有了资金就可以继续进一步的施工。

d: n 馅饼；饼图；爱说话的人 fruit baked inside a  pastry  covering；vt 使杂乱

es.e: I had a steak and kidney pie with chips.
es.c: 我吃了一份牛肉腰子馅饼加薯条。

d: n 人口；[生物] 种群，[生物] 群体；全体居民 the number of people living in a particular area, country etc

es.e: Nearly 70 percent of the population still live in the countryside.
es.c: 人口中差不多有70%仍住在乡村。

d: n 关怀；照料；谨慎；忧虑 the process of looking after someone, especially because they are ill, old, or very young；v 照顾；关心；喜爱；顾虑 to be concerned about what happens to someone, because you like or love them

es.e: high standards of medical care
es.c: 高水平的医疗护理

es.e: They shared the care of the children.
es.c: 他们共同照顾孩子。

es.e: Care facilities for the elderly are inadequate.
es.c: 老年人的护理设施很缺乏。

d: adj 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的 extremely unattractive and unpleasant to look at

es.e: a very ugly man
es.c: 非常丑陋的男子

es.e: the ugliest building in town
es.c: 城里最难看的建筑

es.e: Nick’s dog is as ugly as sin (= very ugly ).
es.c: 尼克的狗难看得要命。

d: n 运气；幸运；带来好运的东西 good things that happen to you by chance；v 靠运气，走运；凑巧碰上

es.e: You’re not having much luck today, are you?
es.c: 你今天运气不太好，是不是？

es.e: He’s had good luck with his roses this year.
es.c: 今年他种玫瑰的运气不错。

es.e: It was an incredible piece of luck.
es.c: 真是令人难以置信的好运气。

d: adj 紧密的；亲密的；亲近的 not far from someone or something；v 关；结束；使靠近 to shut something in order to cover an opening, or to become shut in this way；adv 紧密地；n 结束 the end of an activity or of a period of time

es.e: If you need to buy bread or milk, the closest shop is about a mile away.
es.c: 如果你需要买面包或牛奶，最近的商店大概有一英里远。

es.e: His eyes were small and close together .
es.c: 他眼睛很小，而且挨得很近。

es.e: There are several accounts of dolphins living in close proximity to humans (= close to humans ) .
es.c: 几次有人报告说有海豚与人类比邻而居。

d: n 大学；综合性大学；大学校舍 an educational institution at the highest level, where you study for a degree
adj 漂亮的；可爱的；优美的 a woman or child who is pretty has a nice attractive face；adv 相当地；颇 fairly or more than a little；n 有吸引力的事物（尤指饰品）；漂亮的人

es.e: a pretty little girl
es.c: 漂亮的小姑娘

es.e: Maria looks much prettier with her hair cut short.
es.c: 玛丽亚把头发剪短好看多了。

d: v 死亡；凋零；熄灭 to stop living and become dead；n 冲模，钢模；骰子 a  dice

es.e: He died in 1985 at the age of 76.
es.c: 他1985年去世，终年76岁。

es.e: Her father died suddenly in an accident when she was only ten.
es.c: 她年仅10岁时父亲突然死于一场意外事故。

es.e: She died peacefully in her sleep at the age of 98.
es.c: 她在睡眠中安然辞世，享年98岁。

d: n 圆；循环；一回合；圆形物 a complete game of golf；adj 圆的；完全的；大概的；肥胖的 shaped like a circle；adv 在周围；迂回地；朝反方向；挨个 surrounding or on all sides of something or someone；v 完成；围捕；绕行；弄圆

es.e: I played a round of golf on Sunday morning.
es.c: 星期天早上我打了一场高尔夫球。

d: adj 口渴的，口干的；渴望的，热望的 feeling that you want or need a drink

es.e: Can I have a glass of water? I’m really thirsty.
es.c: 我能喝一杯水吗？ 我太渴了。

es.e: He’d been working in the garden and was very hot and thirsty.
es.c: 他一直在花园里干活，又热又渴。

es.e: All this digging is thirsty work (= work that makes you want a drink ) .
es.c: 这种挖地的活干了让人口渴。

d: adj 免费的；自由的，不受约束的；[化学] 游离的 something that is free does not cost you any money；v 使自由，解放；释放 to allow someone to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept as a prisoner；adv 自由地；免费；n (Free)人名；(英)弗里

es.e: Admission is free for children under 9.
es.c: 九岁以下儿童免费入场。

es.e: All students are offered free accommodation.
es.c: 所有学生都免费住宿。

es.e: Send for our free information pack for more details.
es.c: 欲知详情，请来函索取我们的免费信息包。

d: n 大西洋；adj 大西洋的

es.e: They underlaid the Atlantic with a cable.
es.c: 他们在大西洋海底铺设了一条电缆。

es.e: The Straits of Gibraltar are the strategic passage between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
es.c: 直布罗陀海峡是地中海通向大西洋的咽喉。

es.e: I wrote about this as early as 2005 in the Atlantic Monthly.
es.c: 我早在2005年就曾在《大西洋月刊》上撰文写过此事。

d: n 火腿；业余无线电爱好者；蹩脚演员 the upper part of a pig’s leg, or the meat from this that has been preserved with salt or smoke；v 表演过火 to perform with too much false emotion when acting；adj 过火的；做作的 (as modifier)

es.e: a ham sandwich
es.c: 火腿三明治

es.e: a seven-pound ham
es.c: 七磅重的火腿

es.e: a ham actor

d: adj 舒适的，舒服的 making you feel physically relaxed, without any pain or without being too hot, cold etc；n 盖被

es.e: I was so comfortable and warm in bed I didn’t want to get up.
es.c: 床上又舒服又暖和，我都不想起来。

d: n 沉默；寂静；缄默；不谈；无声状态 complete absence of sound or noise；v 使沉默；使安静；压制；消除噪音 to make someone stop talking, or stop something making a noise；int 安静！；别作声！ complete absence of sound or noise

es.e: There was a brief silence before anyone answered.
es.c: 沉默了片刻才有人回答。

d: adj 聋的 physically unable to hear anything or unable to hear well

es.e: communication between deaf and hearing people
es.c: 失聪者和听力正常者之间的交流

es.e: I think Mum’s going a bit deaf .
es.c: 我觉得妈妈有点耳聋了。

es.e: She’s deaf and dumb (= unable to hear or speak ) and communicates using sign language.
es.c: 她又聋又哑，用手语交流。

d: n 父亲，爸爸；神父；祖先；前辈 a male parent；v 发明，创立；当…的父亲 to become the father of a child by making a woman  pregnant

es.e: Ask your father to help you.
es.c: 叫你父亲帮你。

es.e: Andrew was very excited about becoming a father.
es.c: 安德鲁初为人父，非常激动。

es.e: He’s been like a father to me.
es.c: 对我来说，他就像父亲一样。

d: n 循环，周期；圆；圈子；圆形物 a completely round shape, like the letter O；v 盘旋，旋转；环行 to move in the shape of a circle around something, especially in the air

es.e: Draw a circle 10cm in diameter.
es.c: 画一个直径10厘米的圆形。

es.e: Cut the pastry into circles.
es.c: 将油酥面团切成圆形。

d: n 财富；大量；富有 a large amount of money, property etc that a person or country owns

es.e: The country’s wealth comes from its oil.
es.c: 这个国家的财富来自石油。

es.e: the distribution of wealth
es.c: 财富的分配

es.e: The purpose of industry is to create wealth.
es.c: 工业的目的就是创造财富。

d: adv 然后；那么；于是；当时；此外 at a particular time in the past or future；n 那时；conj 然后，当时

es.e: I wish I had known then what I know now.
es.c: 我真希望那时我就知道现在所知道的一切。

es.e: It was then that I realised she’d tricked me.
es.c: 直到那时我才知道她骗了我。

es.e: He started his career in St Petersburg – or Leningrad as it then was.
es.c: 他在圣彼得堡——当时叫列宁格勒——开始他的事业。

d: n 银行；岸；浅滩；储库 land along the side of a river or lake；v 将…存入银行；倾斜转弯 if a plane banks, it slopes to one side when turning

es.e: the river bank
es.c: 河岸

d: n 狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；(俚)朋友 a common animal with four legs, fur, and a tail. Dogs are kept as pets or trained to guard places, find drugs etc.；v 跟踪；尾随 to follow close behind someone

es.e: I could hear a dog barking .
es.c: 我听到了狗吠声。

es.e: He’s taken the dog for a walk .
es.c: 他去遛狗了。

es.e: We used to have a dog when I was young.
es.c: 我小时候我们养过狗。

d: n 困难，困境 if you have difficulty doing something, it is difficult for you to do

es.e: If you have any difficulties, give me a call.
es.c: 如果你遇到困难，就给我打电话。

d: n 耳朵；穗；听觉；倾听 one of the organs on either side of your head that you hear with；vi （美俚）听见；抽穗

es.e: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
es.c: 她把头发拢到耳朵背后。

d: v 踢；反冲，朝后座 If you kick someone or something, you hit them forcefully with your foot；n 踢；反冲，后座力 Kick is also a noun

es.e: He kicked the door hard.
es.c: 他用力踢门。

es.e: He threw me to the ground and started to kick.
es.c: 他把我摔在地上开始踢我。

es.e: He suffered a kick to the knee.
es.c: 他的膝盖被踢了一脚。

d: adj 独自的；单独的；孤独的 if you are alone in a place, there is no one with you；adv 独自地；单独地 Alone is also an adverb

es.e: She lives alone .
es.c: 她一个人生活。

es.e: You shouldn’t leave a child alone in the house.
es.c: 你不应该把小孩独自留在家里。

es.e: My wife and I like to spend time alone together away from the kids.
es.c: 我和妻子喜欢没有孩子打扰，过二人世界。

d: adj 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的 right, suitable, or correct；adv 完全地 completely；n (Proper)人名；(英、德)普罗珀

es.e: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
es.c: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

es.e: the proper way to clean your teeth
es.c: 正确的刷牙方法

es.e: The proper name for Matthew’s condition is hyperkinetic syndrome.
es.c: 马修的病的恰当名称是多动症。

d: adj 快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的 moving or able to move quickly；adv 迅速地；紧紧地；彻底地 moving quickly；v 禁食，斋戒 If you fast, you eat no food for a period of time, usually for either religious or medical reasons, or as a protest；n 斋戒；绝食 a perio

es.e: a fast car
es.c: 速度很快的汽车

es.e: He’s one of the fastest runners in the world.

es.c: 我无需向你们强调此事的急迫性，因为我知道，你们自己对此完全了解。

es.e: But what is ultimately most important here is that you are asking the question —not just of me but of yourselves.
es.c: 但是我在这儿说的最重要的是：你们在问那些问题——不仅是问我，而是在问你们自己。

d: pron 无人，没有人；没有任何人 no one；n 无名小卒；小人物 If someone says that a person is a nobody, they are saying in an unkind way that the person is not at all important

es.e: I knocked on the door but nobody answered.
es.c: 我敲了敲门，但没人应门。

es.e: A man in my position has nothing to fear from a nobody like you.
es.c: 在我这样职位的一个男人没什么好怕像你这样一个无名之辈的。

d: n 马；骑兵；脚架；海洛因 a large strong animal that people ride and use for pulling heavy things；v 使骑马；系马于；捉弄

es.e: a horse and cart
es.c: 一辆马车

es.e: Lee had never ridden a horse before.
es.c: 李以前从未骑过马。

d: adj 令人愉快的，舒适的；讨人喜欢的，和蔼可亲的 enjoyable or attractive and making you feel happy；n (Pleasant)人名；(英)普莱曾特

es.e: It had been a pleasant evening.
es.c: 那是个愉快的夜晚。

es.e: the pleasant climate of Southern California
es.c: 南加利福尼亚的宜人气候

es.e: The restaurant was large and pleasant.
es.c: 那家餐厅宽敞舒适。

d: v 锁，锁上；隐藏 to fasten something, usually with a key, so that other people cannot open it, or to be fastened like this （；n 锁；水闸；刹车 a thing that keeps a door, drawer etc fastened and is usually opened with a key or by moving

es.e: Did you lock the car?
es.c: 你把汽车锁好了吗？

es.e: I can’t get this drawer to lock.
es.c: 我没法把这个抽屉锁上。

d: n 橡皮；擦除器；[计] 清除器 a small piece of rubber that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper
n 淋浴；（倾泻般出现的）一阵，一大批；阵雨 a piece of equipment that you stand under to wash your whole body；v 大量地给予；把……弄湿 to give someone a lot of things

es.e: Why does the phone always ring when I’m in the shower?
es.c: 为什么电话铃总是在我洗澡的时候响？

es.e: I’d like to use the shower if that’s all right.
es.c: 如果可以的话，我想用一下这里的淋浴。

es.e: The bathroom has a separate shower cubicle (= a shower in a separate part of the room ) .
es.c: 卫生间里有一个独立的淋浴间。

d: v 回答；[法] 答辩；回击 to answer someone by saying or writing something；n 回答；[法] 答辩 something that is said, written, or done as a way of replying

es.e: I asked Clive where he was going, but he didn’t reply.
es.c: 我问克莱夫到哪儿去，但他没有回答。

es.e: Sorry it took me so long to reply.
es.c: 抱歉，我过了这么久才回复。

es.e: ‘Did you see Simon today?’ ‘Of course,’ Nathalie replied with a smile.
es.c: “你今天见到西蒙了吗？”“当然啦。”纳萨莉笑着答道。

d: n （美）雨衣 a coat that you wear to protect yourself from rain

es.e: He dipped in his raincoat pocket.
es.c: 他把手深深地伸进雨衣口袋里。

es.e: The dark clouds remembered me to take my raincoat along.
es.c: 乌云提醒我带上雨衣。

es.e: If I had taken my raincoat with me this morning, I would not be wet now.
es.c: (从句指过去,主句指现在)。如果我今天早上带了雨衣，现在就不会被淋湿了。

d: n 月的第六日，（与the连用的）第六个；六分之一 one of six equal parts of something；adj （与 the 连用）第六的，第六个的；六分之一的 coming after five other things in a series

es.e: About one sixth of the children admitted to taking drugs.
es.c: 大约六分之一的儿童承认吸毒。

d: n 遗憾；抱歉；悲叹 sadness that you feel about something, especially because you wish it had not happened；v 后悔；惋惜；哀悼 to feel sorry about something you have done and wish you had not done it

es.e: It is with great regret that I must decline your offer.
es.c: 很遗憾，我不得不谢绝你的好意。

d: v 给…穿衣 to put clothes on yourself or someone else；n 连衣裙；女装 a piece of clothing worn by a woman or girl that covers the top of her body and part or all of her legs

es.e: Can you wait a minute? I’m just getting dressed .
es.c: 稍等一会儿，我穿下衣服就好。

es.e: She dressed quickly and went out of the house.
es.c: 她很快穿好衣服，走到房子外面。

es.e: I usually have to dress the kids in the mornings.
es.c: 早上我通常得给孩子们穿衣服。

d: adj 疯狂的；狂热的，着迷的 very strange or not sensible

es.e: The neighbours must think we’re crazy.
es.c: 邻居一定会认为我们疯了。

es.e: It’s an absolutely crazy idea .
es.c: 那绝对是个荒唐的想法。

es.e: I know this idea sounds crazy , but it may be worth a try.
es.c: 我知道这个主意听起来很荒唐，但也许值得一试。

d: v 学习；得知；认识到 to gain knowledge of a subject or skill, by experience, by studying it, or by being taught

es.e: What’s the best way to learn a language?
es.c: 学习语言的最佳方法是什么？

es.e: The teacher’s task is to help the pupil learn.
es.c: 老师的任务是帮助学生学习。

es.e: The student will learn from experience about the importance of planning.
es.c: 学生将从经验中学到制订计划的重要性。

d: n 冰；冰淇淋；矜持；（俚）钻石 water that has frozen into a solid state；v 冰镇；结冰；adj 冰的

es.e: Would you like some ice in your drink?
es.c: 你饮料中要放点冰块吗？

es.e: Her hands were as cold as ice.
es.c: 她双手冰冷。

es.e: The city spent $7 million to remove snow and ice from the roads.
es.c: 市政府花费了700万美元用于清除路上的冰雪。

d: n 财富，财产；财宝；珍品 a group of valuable things such as gold, silver, jewels etc；v 珍爱；珍藏 to keep and care for something that is very special, important, or valuable to you

es.e: The Book of Kells is Trinity College’s greatest treasure.
es.c: 《凯尔经》是三一学院的镇院之宝。

d: n 页；记录；大事件，时期；男侍者 one side of a piece of paper in a book, newspaper, document etc, or the sheet of paper itself；v 给…标页码

es.e: The full address is given on page 15.
es.c: 详细地址见第15页。

es.e: You will find the answers over the page .
es.c: 答案见下页。

es.e: a 400﹣page novel
es.c: 一本400页的小说

d: adj 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的 made of plastic；n 塑料制品；整形；可塑体 a light strong material that is produced by a chemical process, and which can be made into different shapes when it is soft

es.e: a plastic spoon
es.c: 塑料汤匙

es.e: plastic bags
es.c: 塑料袋

d: n 雨；下雨；雨天；雨季 water that falls in small drops from clouds in the sky；v 下雨；降雨 if it rains, drops of water fall from clouds in the sky

es.e: a night of wind and rain
es.c: 风雨交加的夜晚

es.e: There will be heavy rain in most parts of the country.
es.c: 全国大部分地区将有大雨。

d: n 旅馆，饭店；客栈 a building where people pay to stay and eat meals；vt 使…在饭店下榻；vi 进行旅馆式办公

es.e: I’ve booked the flights and the hotel.
es.c: 我已订好机票和酒店。

es.e: We’ll be staying at the Hotel Ibis.
es.c: 我们将住在宜必思酒店。

d: n 面条；笨蛋 a long thin piece of food made from a mixture of flour, water, and eggs, usually cooked in soup or boiling water

es.e: Serve the meat with rice or noodles.
es.c: 肉配米饭或面条一起上。

d: v 解谜；给出谜；充满于 to solve, explain, or interpret (a riddle or riddles)；n 谜语；粗筛；谜一般的人、东西、事情等 a question that is deliberately very confusing and has a humorous or clever answer

es.e: See if you can solve this riddle .
es.c: 看看你能不能猜出这个谜语。

d: n 十三；十三岁；十三个 the number 13；num 十三 the number 13；adj 十三的；十三个的

es.e: They’ve only sold thirteen tickets so far.
es.c: 到目前为止他们仅仅售出13张票。

es.e: When it happened, I was thirteen (= 13 years old ) .
es.c: 那事发生时，我13岁。

d: adj 最小的；最少的（little的最高级） You use the least to mean a smaller amount than anyone or anything else, or the smallest amount possible；adv 最小；最少 less than anything or anyone else；n 最小；最少 even if something better is not true or

es.e: I try to offend the least amount of people possible.
es.c: 我尽可能少得罪人。

d: n 守卫；警戒；护卫队；防护装置 the act or duty of protecting places or people, or of preventing prisoners from escaping；v 警惕

es.e: The prisoners overpowered their guards and locked them in a cell.
es.c: 囚犯们制服了卫兵，并把他们锁在一个牢房里。

d: n 对；夫妇；数个 two people who are married or having a sexual or romantic relationship；v 结合；成婚 to join or fasten two things together

es.e: a newly married couple
es.c: 一对新婚夫妇

es.e: the couple next door
es.c: 隔壁的那对夫妇

d: v 描述，形容；描绘 to say what something or someone is like by giving details about them

es.e: The police asked her to describe the man.
es.c: 警察叫她描述一下那名男子。

es.e: Another approach to the problem is described in Chapter 3.
es.c: 这个问题的另一种解决方法在第三章有所阐述。

d: n 空气，大气；天空；样子；曲调 the mixture of gases around the Earth, that we breathe；v 使通风，晾干；夸耀 to let fresh air into a room, especially one that has been closed for a long time

es.e: Let’s go outside and get some fresh air.
es.c: 我们出去呼吸些新鲜空气吧。

es.e: You need to put some air in the tyres.
es.c: 你得给轮胎充气了。

d: v 憎恨；厌恶；遗憾 to dislike someone very much and feel angry towards them；n 憎恨；反感 an angry unpleasant feeling that someone has when they hate someone and want to harm them

es.e: Why do you hate me so much?
es.c: 你为什么那么恨我？

d: adj 少的，小的；微弱的；几乎没有的；不重要的；幼小的 not large in size or amount；adv 小小地；卑鄙地；n 小件物品；矮小的人

es.e: a small piece of paper
es.c: 一小片纸

es.e: a small car
es.c: 一辆小汽车

es.e: a small town
es.c: 小镇

d: n 视力；景象；眼界；见解 the physical ability to see；v 看见；瞄准 to see something from a long distance away, or see something you have been looking for；adj 见票即付的；即席的

es.e: Anne’s sight is very good for someone of her age.
es.c: 安妮的视力对于她这个年龄的人来说算是非常好的。

es.e: He began to lose his sight six years ago.
es.c: 六年前他开始视力衰退。

es.e: an emergency operation to save his sight
es.c: 挽救他视力的紧急手术

d: v 避免；避开，躲避；消除 to prevent something bad from happening

es.e: Road safety is taught to young children to avoid road accidents.
es.c: 小孩子受到道路安全知识的教育，以避免交通事故。

es.e: It is important to take measures to avoid the risk of fire.
es.c: 采取措施避免火灾风险很重要。

es.e: Alan narrowly avoided an accident.
es.c: 艾伦险出事故。

d: n 科学；技术；学科；理科 knowledge about the world, especially based on examining, testing, and proving facts

es.e: Many leading scientists do not consider that science can give absolutely reliable knowledge.
es.c: 许多杰出科学家都不认为科学能够提供绝对可靠的知识。

es.e: the founder of modern science, Isaac Newton
es.c: 现代科学创始人艾萨克·牛顿

es.e: developments in science and technology
es.c: 科学技术的发展

d: adj 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的 wanting to eat something

es.e: I was cold, tired, and hungry.
es.c: 我又冷，又累，又饿。

es.e: If you get hungry , there’s some cold chicken in the fridge.
es.c: 你要是饿了，冰箱里有些冷鸡肉。

es.e: Do you still feel hungry?
es.c: 你还觉得饿吗？

d: v 提出；介绍；呈现；赠送 to give something to someone, for example at a formal or official occasion；adj 现在的；出席的 in a particular place；n 现在；礼物；瞄准 something you give someone on a special occasion or to thank them for something

es.e: She was presented with an award .
es.c: 她被授予一个奖项。

d: n 夫人；女士；鸨母 used to address a woman in a polite way, especially a customer in a shop

es.e: Are you being served, Madam?
es.c: 有人接待您吗，夫人？

d: n 浴室；厕所；盥洗室 a room where there is a bath or  shower  , a  basin  , and sometimes a toilet

es.e: Where’s the bathroom?
es.c: 洗手间在哪里？

d: n 山羊；替罪羊（美俚）；色鬼（美俚） an animal that has horns on top of its head and long hair under its chin, and can climb steep hills and rocks. Goats live wild in the mountains or are kept as farm animals.
n 及格；经过；护照；途径；传球 a successful result in an examination；v 经过；传递；变化；终止 to come up to a particular place, person, or object and go past them

es.e: You will need at least three passes to get onto the course.
es.c: 你至少需要三门及格才能上这门课。

es.e: The pass mark (= the mark you need to be successful ) is 55%.
es.c: 及格分数是55分。

d: n 男孩；男人 a male child, or a male person in general

es.e: The boys wanted to play football.
es.c: 男孩子们想踢足球。

es.e: boys and girls aged 11–18
es.c: 11到18岁之间的男孩和女孩

es.e: What a polite little boy (=  young male child  ) you are.
es.c: 你真是个有礼貌的小男孩。

d: adj 年轻的；初期的；没有经验的 a young person, plant, or animal has not lived for very long；n 年轻人；（动物的）崽，仔 young people

es.e: a young child
es.c: 幼儿

es.e: He’s younger than me.
es.c: 他比我小。

es.e: You’re too young to get married.
es.c: 你还太小，不能结婚。

d: n 牛仔裤；工装裤 trousers made of denim(= a strong, usually blue, cotton cloth )

es.e: ...a young man in jeans and a worn T-shirt.
es.c: …一个穿着牛仔裤和破旧T恤衫的年轻人。

d: n 模型；典型；模范；模特儿；样式 a small copy of a building, vehicle, machine etc, especially one that can be put together from separate parts；v 模拟；塑造；模仿 to be designed in a way that copies another system or way of doing something；adj

es.e: a working model (= one with parts which move ) of a steam engine
es.c: 蒸汽机车的活动模型

es.e: ...a model railway.
es.c: …一个铁路模型。

d: v 喜欢；想；愿意 to enjoy something or think that it is nice or good；prep 像；如同 similar to something else, or happening in the same way；adj 同样的；相似的 similar in some way；n 爱好；同样的人或物 the things that someone likes and does not like

es.e: I like your jacket.
es.c: 我喜欢你这件上衣。

es.e: I don’t really like classical music.
es.c: 我不是很喜欢古典音乐。

es.e: Do you like this colour?
es.c: 你喜欢这种颜色吗？

d: v 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服 to make someone or something move by pressing them with your hands, arms etc；n 推，决心；大规模攻势；矢志的追求 when someone pushes something

es.e: It didn’t move, so she pushed harder.
es.c: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

es.e: I promised to push him on the swings for as long as he wanted.
es.c: 我答应他想在秋千上荡多久我就推多久。

es.e: shoppers pushing their grocery carts
es.c: 推着购物车的购物者

d: adj 幸福的；高兴的；巧妙的 having feelings of pleasure, for example because something good has happened to you or you are very satisfied with your life；n (Happy)人名；(英、瑞典、喀)哈皮

es.e: It’s a lovely house and we’ve been very happy here.
es.c: 房子很漂亮，我们住在这里非常开心。

es.e: I’ve never felt happier in my life.
es.c: 我一生从未感到如此快乐。

es.e: He was a happy child who rarely cried.
es.c: 他是一个快乐的孩子，很少哭鼻子。

d: n 发音；读法 the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced

es.e: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
es.c: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

d: adv 两次；两倍 two times

es.e: He was questioned by police twice yesterday.
es.c: 他昨天被警察审问了两次。

es.e: None of our dinner menus are exactly the same twice over .
es.c: 我们的晚餐菜单从没有完全重样的。

d: n 厕所，盥洗室；梳妆，打扮 a room or building containing a toilet；vi 梳妆，打扮；vt 给…梳妆打扮

es.e: public toilets
es.c: 公共厕所

d: v 节约地使用（或管理） to be very careful in the way you use your money, supplies etc and not waste any；n 丈夫 the man that a woman is married to

es.e: Have you met my husband Roy?
es.c: 你见过我的丈夫罗伊吗？

d: pron 她自己（she的反身代词）；她亲自 used to show that the woman or girl who does something is affected by her own action

es.e: She cut herself on some broken glass.
es.c: 碎玻璃把她割伤了。

es.e: She made herself a cup of coffee.
es.c: 她给自己煮了杯咖啡。

d: n 地球；地表，陆地；土地，土壤；尘事，俗事；兽穴 the planet that we live on；v 把（电线）[电] 接地；盖（土）；追赶入洞穴 to make electrical equipment safe by connecting it to the ground with a wire

es.e: the planet Earth
es.c: 地球

d: n 老人；长辈；年长者；父辈 to be older than someone else；adj 年长的；年龄较大的；资格老的 Theelderof two people is the one who was born first

es.e: a meeting of the village elders
es.c: 村里长辈们的集会

es.e: ...his elder brother.
es.c: …他的哥哥。

d: n 流感 a common illness that makes you feel very tired and weak, gives you a sore throat, and makes you cough and have to clear your nose a lot

es.e: Steven’s still in bed with flu .
es.c: 史蒂文患了流感，仍卧病在床。

es.e: She’s got the flu .
es.c: 她得了流感。

es.e: I couldn’t go because I had flu .
es.c: 我得了流感，去不了。

d: n 卡片；纸牌；明信片 a small piece of plastic or paper containing information about a person or showing, for example, that they belong to a particular organization, club etc；v 记于卡片上

es.e: Employees must show their identity cards at the gate.
es.c: 雇员在大门口必须出示自己的身份卡。

es.e: I haven’t got my membership card yet.
es.c: 我还没拿到会员卡。

d: v 鼓励，怂恿；激励；支持 to give someone the courage or confidence to do something

es.e: I want to thank everyone who has encouraged and supported me.
es.c: 我要感谢每一位鼓励和支持过我的人。

d: n 酒，葡萄酒；紫红色 an alcoholic drink made from grapes, or a type of this drink；v 喝酒 to entertain someone well with a meal, wine etc

es.e: a glass of wine
es.c: 一杯葡萄酒

d: n 午后，下午 the part of the day after the morning and before the evening

es.e: There’s a meeting on Thursday afternoon .
es.c: 星期四下午有个会议。

es.e: It was very hot in the afternoon .
es.c: 下午很热。

es.e: See you tomorrow afternoon .
es.c: 明天下午见。

d: n 力量；武力；军队；魄力 military action used as a way of achieving your aims；v 促使，推动；强迫；强加 to make someone do something they do not want to do

es.e: Peace cannot be imposed by force .
es.c: 和平不能通过武力来实现。

es.e: The UN will allow the use of force against aircraft violating the zone.
es.c: 联合国将允许对侵犯这一地区的飞机采取军事行动。

d: n 东方；东风；东方国家 the direction from which the sun rises, and which is on the right if you are facing north；adj 东方的；向东的；从东方来的 in the east or facing the east；adv 向东方，在东方 towards the east

es.e: Which way is east?
es.c: 哪边是东？

d: adj 日常的；每日的 happening or done every day；n 日报；朝来夜去的女佣 a newspaper that is printed and sold every day, or every day except Sunday；adv 日常地；每日；天天 happening or done every day

es.e: daily flights to Miami
es.c: 每日飞往迈阿密的航班

d: n 枪支；枪状物；持枪歹徒 a metal weapon which shoots bullets or  shells；v 用枪射击；加大油门快速前进

es.e: I’ve never fired a gun in my life.
es.c: 我这辈子从来没开过枪。

es.e: Jake was pointing a gun at the door.
es.c: 杰克用枪对着门口。

es.e: Two policemen were killed in a gun battle .
es.c: 两名警察在一次枪战中丧生。

d: v 保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存 to continue to be in the same state or condition；n 遗迹；剩余物，残骸 Theremainsof something are the parts of it that are left after most of it has been taken away or destroyed

es.e: Please remain seated until all the lights are on.
es.c: 请留在座位上，直到灯全都亮起。

es.e: We remained friends.
es.c: 我们依然是朋友。

es.e: The boy remained silent .
es.c: 男孩依然默不作声。

d: n 语言；语言文字；表达能力 a system of communication by written or spoken words, which is used by the people of a particular country or area

es.e: How many languages do you speak?
es.c: 你能说几种语言？

es.e: one of the best-known poems in the English language
es.c: 最著名的英语诗歌之一

d: adv 在任何地方；无论何处 in or to any place；n 任何地方

es.e: Sit anywhere you like.
es.c: 你随便坐吧。

es.e: You can buy clothes like these anywhere.
es.c: 这样的衣服到处都可以买到。

es.e: I don’t want to live in London, but I’d be happy living anywhere else .
es.c: 我不想住在伦敦，但是住在其他什么地方我都很乐意。

d: n 教训；课 a period of time in which someone is taught a particular skill, for example how to play a musical instrument or drive a car；vt 教训；上课

es.e: piano lessons
es.c: 钢琴课

d: v 节省；保存；储蓄；解救 to keep money in a bank so that you can use it later, especially when you gradually add more money over a period of time；prep 除之外 except；n 救援 an action in which a player in a game such as football prevents

es.e: He managed to save enough to buy a small house.
es.c: 他想办法攒够钱买了一幢小房子。

es.e: So far, I’ve saved about £500.
es.c: 到目前为止，我已存了大约500英镑。

d: n 堂兄弟姊妹；表兄弟姊妹 the child of your  uncle  or  aunt

es.e: My cousin Mark helped me to bring in the bags.
es.c: 我表弟马克帮我把包提了进来。

d: n 孙女；外孙女 the daughter of your son or daughter

es.e: ...a drawing of my granddaughter Amelia.
es.c: …一幅我孙女阿梅莉亚的画像。

d: n 阶级；班级；种类；班；等级 a group of people, animals, or things that are considered together because they are similar in some way；v 分类；把…分等级；把…归入某等级，把…看作（或分类、归类）；把…编入某一班级 to consider people, things etc as belonging to a particular

es.e: He had to spend about six months in a class with younger students.
es.c: 他不得不在一个比他小的学生的班上呆了大约六个月。

d: n 小提琴；小提琴手 a small wooden musical instrument that you hold under your chin and play by pulling a bow(= special stick ) across the strings
pron 我（宾格） used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself；n 自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分 used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself

es.e: Stop, you’re hurting me.
es.c: 住手，你弄疼我了。

es.e: He bought me a drink.
es.c: 他给我买了一杯酒。

es.e: Give that book to me.
es.c: 把那本书给我。

d: v 听（诊）；测量，测…深；使发声；试探；宣告 to publicly give a warning or tell people to be careful；n 声音，语音；噪音；海峡；吵闹；听力范围；[医] 探条 something that you hear, or what can be heard；adj 健全的，健康的；合理的；可靠的；有效彻底的 sensible and likely to produce the righ

es.e: Several earlier studies had sounded similar warnings .
es.c: 早先的几次研究也提出过类似的警告。

es.e: Now it is an American economist who is sounding the alarm .
es.c: 现在是一位美国的经济学家在提出警告。

d: n 牛肉；肌肉；食用牛；牢骚 the meat from a cow；v 抱怨，告发；发牢骚 to complain a lot

es.e: roast beef
es.c: 烤牛肉

es.e: We have both dairy and beef cattle on the farm.
es.c: 我们农场里奶牛和菜牛都有。

d: n 市场；行情；股票市场；市面；集市；销路；商店 a particular country or area where a company sells its goods or where a particular type of goods is sold；v 在市场上出售 to make a product available in shops

es.e: Our main overseas market is Japan.
es.c: 我们的主要海外市场是日本。

d: n 机场；航空站 a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in

es.e: The plane landed at Heathrow Airport.
es.c: 飞机降落在希思罗机场。

es.e: Her family went to see her off at the airport.
es.c: 她的家人去机场送她。

d: v 嫁；娶；与……结婚 if you marry someone, you become their husband or wife；n (Marry)人名；(阿拉伯)马雷；(法)马里

es.e: He married Bea in 1925.
es.c: 他在1925年娶了贝亚。

es.e: I’m going to ask her to marry me on St Valentine’s Day.
es.c: 我打算在情人节向她求婚。

es.e: She married young (= at a young age ) .
es.c: 她结婚早。

d: n 铅笔；笔状物 an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a wooden stick with a thin piece of a black or coloured substance in the middle；v 用铅笔写；用眉笔涂 to write something or make a mark with a pencil

es.e: a sharp pencil
es.c: 尖尖的铅笔

es.e: a blue pencil
es.c: 蓝色铅笔

es.e: a pencil sketch
es.c: 铅笔速写

d: adv 第一；首先；优先；宁愿 before doing anything else, or before anything else happens；n 第一；开始；冠军 something that has never happened or been done before；adj 第一的；基本的；最早的 coming before all the other things or people in a series；num 第一

es.e: I’ll join you in a minute but I need to make a phone call first.
es.c: 我一会儿就来，但是我得先打个电话。

d: n 一千；一千个；许许多多 the number 1,000；adj 成千的；无数的

es.e: a journey of almost a thousand miles
es.c: 将近1,000英里的旅程

d: adv 然后；下次；其次 the next time；adj 下一个的；其次的；贴近的 Next is also an adjective；n 下一个 the next person or thing in a list, series etc comes after the one that you are dealing with now；prep 靠近；居于…之后

es.e: When I next saw her she completely ignored me.
es.c: 我再次见到她时，她压根儿没有理我。

es.e: I'll be 26 years old next Friday.
es.c: 我下周五就26岁了。

d: adj 奇怪的；陌生的；外行的 unusual or surprising, especially in a way that is difficult to explain or understand；adv 奇怪地；陌生地，冷淡地 in a way that is unusual or surprising；n (Strange)人名；(英)斯特兰奇；(瑞典、塞)斯特朗格

es.e: strange noises
es.c: 奇怪的噪声

es.e: Does Geoff’s behaviour seem strange to you?
es.c: 你觉得杰夫的行为反常吗？

es.e: She felt there was something strange about Dexter’s voice.
es.c: 她觉得德克斯特的声音有点奇怪。

d: pron 他们；它们；她们 used to refer to two or more people or things that have already been mentioned or are already known about；n (Them)人名；(老)探 used when talking about someone who may be male or female, to avoid saying ‘him or h

es.e: Has anyone seen my keys? I can’t find them anywhere.
es.c: 有人见到我的钥匙吗？我哪儿都找不到。

es.e: The police were very helpful when I spoke to them.
es.c: 我和警察说了，他们很帮忙。

es.e: I lent him several books, but he hasn’t read any of them.
es.c: 我借给他几本书，但他一本还没看过。

d: n 十二；十二个 the number 12；num 十二；十二个 the number 12；adj 十二的；十二个的

es.e: He received a twelve-month jail sentence.
es.c: 他获刑12个月。

es.e: Come at twelve (= 12 o’clock ) .
es.c: 12点来。

es.e: Their son Dylan is twelve (= 12 years old ) .
es.c: 他们的儿子迪伦12岁。

d: n 零点，零度 the number 0；num 零 the number 0

es.e: Make x greater than or equal to zero.
es.c: 设x大于或等于零。

d: adj 生病的；坏的；邪恶的；不吉利的 suffering from a disease or not feeling well；adv 不利地；恶劣地；几乎不 Ill means the same as "badly."；n 疾病；不幸

es.e: Bridget can’t come – she’s ill.
es.c: 布里奇特不能来了，她生病了。

es.e: I was feeling ill that day and decided to stay at home.
es.c: 我那天不太舒服，决定留在家里。

es.e: a hospice for the terminally ill
es.c: 晚期病人的安养院

d: n 表面；表层；外观 the top layer of an area of water or land；adj 表面的，肤浅的 relating to the part of the army, navy etc that travels by land or on the sea, rather than by air or under the sea；v 浮出水面 if someone or something surfaces,

es.e: Nearly 10% of the Earth’s surface is covered by ice.
es.c: 地球表面将近 10% 被冰层覆盖。

es.e: Gas bubbles in any liquid tend to rise to the surface .
es.c: 在任何液体中气泡往往都会浮到表面。

d: n 化学；化学过程 the science that is concerned with studying the structure of substances and the way that they change or combine with each other

es.e: a person’s body chemistry
es.c: 人体的化学组成

d: n 二十；二十年代 the number 20；num 二十 the number 20；adj 二十的

es.e: a small village twenty miles from Nairobi
es.c: 距内罗毕20英里的一个小村庄

es.e: I’m nearly twenty (= 20 years old ) .
es.c: 我快20岁了。

d: n 建议；示意；微量，细微的迹象 an idea, plan, or possibility that someone mentions, or the act of mentioning it

es.e: Any suggestions would be welcome.
es.c: 任何建议都欢迎。

d: v 航行；启航，开船 to travel on or across an area of water in a boat or ship；n 帆，篷；航行 a large piece of strong cloth fixed onto a boat, so that the wind will push the boat along

es.e: Three tall ships sailed past.
es.c: 三艘大船驶了过去。

es.e: She always wanted to sail around the world .
es.c: 她一直想要乘船环游世界。

d: conj 是否；不论 used when talking about a choice you have to make or about something that is not certain；pron 两个中的哪一个

es.c: 莫里斯问我是否需要帮助。

es.e: There were times when I wondered whether or not we would get there.
es.c: 有时候我也想知道我们能不能做得到。

es.e: I didn’t know whether to believe him or not.
es.c: 我不知道该不该相信他。

d: adj 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的 last in a series of actions, events, parts of a story etc；n 决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版 the last and most important game, race, or set of games in a competition

es.e: The final episode will be shown tonight.
es.c: 最后一集将于今晚播出。

es.e: students preparing for their final examinations
es.c: 正在准备期末考试的学生

es.e: Stone is filming the final instalment of his Vietnam trilogy.
es.c: 斯通正在拍摄越战三部曲的最后一部。

d: v 停留；坚持；暂住；停下 to remain in a place rather than leave；n 逗留；停止；支柱 a limited time of living in a place

es.e: They stayed all afternoon chatting.
es.c: 他们待了整个下午聊天。

es.e: She stayed late to finish the report.
es.c: 为了完成报告，她工作到很晚。

d: conj 因为 used when you are giving the reason for something

es.e: We didn’t enjoy the day because the weather was so awful.
es.c: 那天我们很不尽兴，因为天气实在太糟。

es.e: ‘Why can’t I go?’ ‘Because you’re not old enough.’
es.c: “我为什么不能去？”“因为你年纪太小。”

es.e: Hubert never experienced any fear, and this was partly because he was not particularly intelligent.
es.c: 休伯特从来都没有害怕的感觉，部分原因是他这人不大聪明。

d: n 接见，采访；面试，面谈 a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out whether they are suitable for a job, course of study etc；v 采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试 to ask someone questions during an interview

es.e: a portfolio of work presented at interview
es.c: 在面试时呈递的工作成果样本

d: n 国家；州；情形 the physical or mental condition that someone or something is in；v 规定；声明；陈述 to formally say or write a piece of information or your opinion；adj 国家的；州的；正式的 State industries or organizations are financed and orga

es.e: She was in an extremely confused state of mind .
es.c: 她思绪纷乱。

es.e: She can’t go home now. Look at the state of her!
es.c: 她现在不能回家。看看她这副样子！

es.e: The country was in a state of war (= officially fighting a war ) .
es.c: 这个国家正处于战争状态。

d: n 车轮；方向盘；转动 The wheels of a vehicle are the circular objects that are attached underneath it and that enable it to move along the ground；v 转动；使变换方向；给…装轮子

es.e: The car wheels spun and slipped on some oil on the road.
es.c: 小汽车的车轮在路面的油迹上空转打了滑。

es.e: I still haven’t finished painting the spare room.
es.c: 我还没粉刷完那间空房间。

es.e: Do you still have Julie’s phone number?
es.c: 你还留着朱莉的电话号码吗？

d: v 创造，创作；造成 to make something exist that did not exist before

es.e: Some people believe the universe was created by a big explosion.
es.c: 有些人认为宇宙是通过一次大爆炸创造出来的。

es.c: 她的行为引起了很多问题。

es.e: The new factory is expected to create more than 400 new jobs.
es.c: 这家新工厂预计能创造400多个新的就业机会。

es.e: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
es.c: 碗橱里有一些糖。

es.e: My mother was in the kitchen.
es.c: 我母亲在厨房里。

es.e: He took us for a drive in his new car.
es.c: 他开着他的新车载我们去兜风。

d: n 工人；劳动者；职蚁 the members of the  working class

es.e: the workers’ revolution
es.c: 工人阶级革命

d: pron 这些；adj 这些的

es.e: We all defer to her in these matters.
es.c: 在这些事情上我们都听她的。

es.e: Are these all yours?
es.c: 这些都是你的吗?

es.e: Bear these thoughts with you as you go out into the world.
es.c: 当你出去走入社会时你把这些思想牢记在心。

d: adj 固体的；可靠的；立体的；结实的；一致的 hard or firm, with a fixed shape, and not a liquid or gas；n 固体；立方体 a firm object or substance that has a fixed shape, not a gas or liquid

es.e: The lake was frozen solid .
es.c: 湖水冻得结结实实。

es.e: It was good to be back on solid ground again.
es.c: 又能踏上坚实的土地感觉真好。

es.e: Is the baby eating solid food (= bread, meat etc ) yet?
es.c: 宝宝吃固体食物了吗？

d: n 形状；模型；身材；具体化 the form that something has, for example round, square,  triangular  etc；v 形成；塑造，使成形；使符合 to influence something such as a belief, opinion etc and make it develop in a particular way

es.e: What shape is the table?
es.c: 那张桌子是什么形状的？

es.e: You can recognize a tree by the shape of its leaves.
es.c: 可以根据树叶的形状辨认出是什么树。

es.e: His battered old hat had completely lost its shape.
es.c: 他那顶破旧的帽子已经完全变形了。

d: n 家庭作业，课外作业 work that a student at school is asked to do at home

es.e: For homework, finish the exercise on page 14.
es.c: 家庭作业是完成第14页的练习。

d: n 圣歌；赞美诗 a regularly repeated tune, often with many words sung on one note, especially used for religious prayers；v 唱；诵扬 to repeat a word or phrase again and again

es.e: ...a Gregorian chant.
es.c: …一首格列高利圣歌。

d: n 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系 a connection between two or more things

es.e: The price the meat is sold for bears no relation to (= is not connected to ) the price the farmer receives.
es.c: 肉的售价和农民拿到的价格无关。

d: n 日期；约会；年代；枣椰子 a particular day of the month or year, especially shown by a number；v 过时；注明日期；始于（某一历史时期） if clothing, art etc dates, it begins to look old-fashioned

es.e: The date on the letter was 30th August 1962.
es.c: 信上的日期是1962年8月30日。

es.e: What’s today’s date?
es.c: 今天几号？

d: n 药；毒品；麻醉药；滞销货 an illegal substance such as  marijuana  or  cocaine  , which some people take in order to feel happy, relaxed, or excited；v 使服麻醉药；使服毒品；掺麻醉药于 to give a person or animal a drug, especially in order to make

es.e: A lot of young people start taking drugs at school.
es.c: 许多年轻人上学时开始吸毒。

es.e: She always looks as though she’s on drugs (= taking drugs ) .
es.c: 她总是看上去一副吸过毒的样子。

es.e: Jimi Hendrix died of a drug overdose.
es.c: 吉米·亨德里克斯死于吸毒过量。

d: n 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片 a flat piece of metal with words or numbers on it, for example on a door or a car；v 电镀；给…装甲

es.e: The brass plate on the door said ‘Dr Rackman’.
es.c: 黄铜门牌上写着“雷克曼博士”。

d: n 政策，方针；保险单 a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization

es.e: an insurance policy
es.c: 保险单

d: n 海；海洋；许多；大量 the large area of salty water that covers much of the Earth’s surface

es.e: Jay stripped his clothes off and ran into the sea.
es.c: 杰伊脱光衣服奔入海里。

es.e: Most exports went by sea .
es.c: 大部分出口商品都走海路。

es.e: a little cottage by the sea
es.c: 一座海滨小屋

d: adj 正确的；直接的；右方的 a statement or piece of information that is right is correct and based on true facts；v 复正；恢复平稳 exactly in a particular position or place；n 正确；右边；正义 used to check if what you have said is correct；adv 正确地；恰

es.e: Yes, that’s the right answer .
es.c: 对，回答正确。

es.e: Is that the right time ?
es.c: 那个时间对吗？

es.e: I got most of the questions right .
es.c: 大部分问题我都答对了。

d: n 百分比，百分率；部分；百分数；adj 百分之…的 completely；adv 以百分之…地

es.e: But there are billions more people out there who are not in the top one percent, and they’re not in the top two or three either.
es.c: 但是还有十亿多的人不在其中，他们不在其中的百分之一，也不再其中的两百分之一或者三百分之一的其中。

d: n 角落，拐角处；地区，偏僻处；困境，窘境 the point at which two lines or edges meet；v 囤积；相交成角

es.e: He pulled a dirty handkerchief out by its corner and waved it at me.
es.c: 他拽出一块脏手帕，捏着一角向我挥动。

d: n 形式，形状；形态，外形；方式；表格 the way something is or appears to be；v 构成，组成；排列，组织；产生，塑造 to establish an organization, committee, government etc

es.e: We oppose racism in all its forms.
es.c: 我们反对各种形式的种族主义。

es.e: Vitamin C can be taken in capsule or tablet form .
es.c: 补充维生素C可以服用胶囊，也可以服用片剂。

es.e: A typical training programme takes the form of a series of workshops.
es.c: 一般的培训计划都采用一系列研习班的形式。

d: n 怜悯，同情；遗憾 used to show that you are disappointed about something and you wish things could happen differently；v 对……表示怜悯；对……感到同情 to feel sorry for someone because they are in a very bad situation

es.c: 乔伊斯没有受到邀请太遗憾了。

es.e: I like Charlie. Pity he had to marry that awful woman.
es.c: 我喜欢查利，遗憾的是他得和那个糟糕的女人结婚。

es.e: A pity we can’t find the guy who did it.
es.c: 真遗憾我们找不到那个干了这件事的家伙。

d: n 午餐 a meal eaten in the middle of the day；v 吃午餐；供给午餐 to eat lunch

es.c: 午饭吃什么？

d: n 毛巾，手巾；[纸] 纸巾 a piece of cloth that you use for drying your skin or for drying things such as dishes；v 用毛巾擦 to dry yourself using a towel

es.c: 你有没有干净毛巾给我用？

d: adj [数] 偶数的；平坦的；相等的 flat and level, with no parts that are higher than other parts；adv 甚至；即使；还；实际上 used to emphasize something that is unexpected or surprising in what you are saying；v 使平坦；使相等；n (Even)人名；(法)埃旺；(德)埃文；(英)埃

es.c: 地面必须完全平整后才能铺地砖。

es.c: 你需要在一个平整的台面上干活。

es.c: 他有一副洁白整齐的牙齿。

d: n 圣诞节；圣诞节期间 the period of time around December 25th, the day when Christians celebrate the birth of Christ

es.c: 你回家过圣诞节吗？

es.e: a Christmas present
es.c: 圣诞礼物

es.e: the Christmas holidays
es.c: 圣诞节假期

d: n 平日，普通日；工作日 any day of the week except Saturday and Sunday

es.e: If you want to avoid the crowds, it's best to come on a weekday.
es.c: 如果你想避开人流，最好在工作日来。

d: adv 如此，这么；确是如此 used to refer back to an idea, action, quality, situation etc that has just been mentioned；conj 所以；因此 used to say that someone does something because of the reason just stated；pron 这样；n (So)人名；(柬)索

es.c: 在接到命令之前，部队不会前进。

es.c: 卢克把它们卖了吗？如果是这样的话，那钱到哪里去了？

es.c: “他输掉了一大笔钱吗？”“他们是这么说的。”

d: adj 难过的；悲哀的，令人悲痛的；凄惨的，阴郁的（形容颜色） not happy, especially because something unpleasant has happened

es.e: Sorry to hear the sad news .
es.c: 听到这令人伤心的消息我很难过。

d: adj 干的；口渴的；枯燥无味的；禁酒的 without water or liquid inside or on the surface；v 把…弄干 to make something dry, or to become dry；n 干涸

es.e: I need to change into some dry clothes .
es.c: 我要换上干衣服。

es.e: Make sure that the surface is clean and dry before you start to paint.
es.c: 油漆之前一定先要确保表面清洁干燥。

es.e: You should store disks in a cool, dry place.
es.c: 你应该把磁盘存放在阴凉干燥的地方。

d: n 花园；菜园 the area of land next to a house, where there are flowers, grass, and other plants, and often a place for people to sit；v 栽培花木

es.e: He’s outside in the garden.
es.c: 他在外面花园里。

es.c: 格雷丝给我们送来一些她花园里的花。

d: adj 微小的；很少的 extremely small；n (Tiny)人名；(葡、印)蒂尼

es.c: 中西部地区一个极小的社区

es.c: 耳环很小。

es.e: a tiny little baby
es.c: 丁点大的婴儿

es.c: 他们来了——我看到他们的汽车了。

es.e: Can you smell something burning?
es.c: 你闻到什么东西烧焦了吗？

es.e: I can’t understand why you’re so upset.
es.c: 我不明白你为何这么沮丧。

d: n 英里；一英里赛跑；较大的距离 a unit for measuring distance, equal to 1,760  yard s  or about 1,609 metres

es.c: 从这里到波兰边界有40英里。

es.e: an area 50 miles wide and 150 miles long
es.c: 一片50英里宽、150英里长的地区

es.e: We walked about half a mile .
es.c: 我们大约走了半英里。

d: n 加拿大（北美洲国家）

es.c: 她在加拿大定居。

es.c: 加拿大出产优质小麦。

es.c: 他在加拿大已经住了二十多年了，现在完全加拿大化了。

d: prep 离开；脱落；adv 切断；走开 used to say how much of something someone has；adj 远离的；空闲的

es.c: 你的体育运动装备够不够？

d: v 允许；给予；认可 to let someone do or have something, or let something happen

es.e: We don’t allow diving in the pool.
es.c: 泳池内禁止跳水。

d: v 邀请，招待；招致 to ask someone to come to a party, wedding, meal etc；n 邀请 an invitation to a party, meal etc

es.e: I’m afraid I wasn’t invited.
es.c: 恐怕我没有受到邀请。

d: n 思想；思考；想法；关心 something that you think of, remember, or realize；v 想，思考；认为（think的过去式和过去分词）

es.c: 这想法很有趣。

es.e: The thought that I might not have a job next year is a bit troubling.
es.c: 想到明年可能失业我有点心烦。

d: adj （男子）英俊的；可观的；大方的，慷慨的；健美而端庄的 a handsome amount of money is large

es.c: 他从这笔买卖中赚取了丰厚的利润。

es.e: a handsome fee
es.c: 一大笔费用

d: n 家务事 work that you do to take care of a house, for example washing, cleaning etc

es.e: Men are doing more housework nowadays.
es.c: 现今男人正在承担越来越多的家务。

d: pron 我自己；我亲自；我的正常的健康状况和正常情绪 used by the person speaking or writing to show that they are affected by their own action

es.e: I blame myself for what has happened.
es.c: 发生这一切都怪我自己。

es.e: I can look after myself.
es.c: 我可以照顾好自己。

es.e: I’m making myself a sandwich.
es.c: 我在给自己做三明治。

d: n 四月 the fourth month of the year, between March and May

es.c: 这些变更将于4月实施。

es.c: 在过去一年里，公司的债务激增。

es.c: 天色转暗，开始下起冰冷的雨来。

es.c: 一颗流星划过天空。

es.c: 暴风雨袭击中西部，造成20人死亡。

es.c: 奶酪和饼干

es.c: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。

es.c: 我泪流满面。

es.c: 这些商店中有许多是由亚洲人经营的。

es.c: 德国人今年平均将享有40天带薪假期。

es.c: 经常锻炼对心脏有好处。

es.c: 她脸颊发烫，心怦怦直跳。

es.c: 哪面是南？

es.c: 病人迅速康复。

es.c: 蝌蚪会变成青蛙。

es.c: 这只青蛙突然伸出舌头捕捉蚊子。

es.c: 政府在处理种族歧视问题上应该为企业树立榜样。

es.c: 新地毯是什么颜色的？

es.c: 他养过猪和家禽。

es.c: 他吻了一下她的头顶。

es.c: 艾伦头一挨枕头就睡着了。

es.c: 她因缺乏经验而被拒绝。

es.c: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

es.c: 他承诺要严惩任何在选举中有欺诈行为的官员。

es.c: 他们置乘客于危险之中，理应受到惩罚。

es.c: 遗传学领域的知识发展非常迅速。

es.c: 请向全家人致以最美好的祝愿。
