es.e: It’s impossible to predict what will happen next.
es.c: 不可能预测接下来会发生什么。

es.e: She carried on as if nothing had happened.
es.c: 她继续干，似乎什么都未曾发生。

d: adj 美味的；可口的 very pleasant to taste or smell

es.e: ‘The meal was absolutely delicious,’ she said politely.
es.c: “这顿饭味道好极了。” 她礼貌地说道。

es.e: the delicious smell of new-mown grass
es.c: 新修剪的草坪的芳香

d: n 操作；经营；[外科] 手术；[数][计] 运算 the process of cutting into someone’s body to repair or remove a part that is damaged

es.e: Many small businesses fail in the first year of operation.
es.c: 许多小企业在经营的第一年就倒闭了。

d: n 联营；撞球；水塘；共同资金 a small area of still water in a hollow place；v 联营，合伙经营

es.e: pools of water with tiny fish in them
es.c: 有小鱼的一个个水池

es.e: Mosquitoes breed in stagnant pools of water.
es.c: 蚊子在死水塘中繁殖。

d: v 滑冰；滑过 to move on skates；n 溜冰；冰鞋 one of a pair of boots with metal blades on the bottom, for moving quickly on ice

es.e: The children skated on the frozen pond.
es.c: 孩子们在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

d: adv 错误地；邪恶地，不正当地 not in the correct way；n 坏事；不公正 behaviour that is not morally right；adj 错误的；失常的；不适当的 not correct, and not based on true facts；v 委屈；无理地对待；诽谤 Wrong is also an adverb

es.e: You’ve spelt my name wrong.
es.c: 你把我的名字拼错了。

es.e: What? Have I done it wrong ?
es.c: 什么？我做得不对吗？

es.e: I asked him to sort those files, but he’s done it all wrong (= in completely the wrong way ) .
es.c: 我让他整理这些文件，可是他弄得根本不对。

d: n 一天；时期；白昼 a period of 24 hours；adv 每天；经常在白天地；adj 日间的；逐日的

es.e: We spent three days in Paris.
es.c: 我们在巴黎度过了三天。

es.e: ‘What day is it today?’ ‘Friday.’
es.c: “今天星期几？” “星期五。”

es.e: He left two days ago.
es.c: 他两天前离开的。

d: adj 金色的，黄金般的；珍贵的；金制的 having a bright yellow colour like gold；n (Golden)人名；(英、法、罗、德、瑞典)戈尔登

es.e: golden hair
es.c: 金发

es.e: golden sand
es.c: 金色的沙

d: n 借口；理由 a reason that you give to explain careless or offensive behaviour；v 原谅；为…申辩；给…免去 to forgive someone for doing something that is not seriously wrong, such as being rude or careless

es.e: I’m tired of listening to his excuses.
es.c: 我听厌了他的种种理由。

d: adj 寂寞的；偏僻的 unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to；n 孤独者

es.e: a lonely old man
es.c: 一个孤单的老人

es.e: Don’t you get lonely being on your own all day?
es.c: 你整天独自一人不感到寂寞吗？

d: adj 沉默的；寂静的；无记载的 without any sound, or not making any sound；n 无声电影

es.e: The large house was silent and lonely.
es.c: 这幢大房子寂静荒凉。

es.e: At last the guns fell silent .
es.c: 枪声终于沉寂了下来。

es.e: Julie offered up a silent prayer that she would pass her exam.
es.c: 朱莉默默地祈祷，希望能通过这次考试。

d: n 诗 a piece of writing that expresses emotions, experiences, and ideas, especially in short lines using words that  rhyme (= end with the same sound )

es.e: ...a book of love poems.
es.c: …一本爱情诗集。

d: adj 晚的；迟的；已故的；最近的 arriving, happening, or done after the time that was expected, agreed, or arranged；adv 晚；迟；最近；在晚期 after the usual time

es.e: Sorry I’m late – I overslept.
es.c: 对不起，来晚了——我睡过头了。

es.e: The train was even later than usual.
es.c: 火车到得甚至比平时还晚。

es.e: We apologize for the late departure of flight AZ709.
es.c: 我们为AZ709航班延误起飞表示歉意。

d: n 病，[医] 疾病；弊病 an illness which affects a person, animal, or plant；vt 传染；使…有病

es.e: His father died of heart disease.
es.c: 他父亲死于心脏病。

es.e: She contracted the disease while she was abroad on holiday.
es.c: 她在国外度假时染上了这种疾病。

d: n 铃，钟；钟声，铃声；钟状物 a piece of electrical equipment that makes a ringing sound, used as a signal or to get someone’s attention；v 装钟于，系铃于

es.e: church bells
es.c: 教堂的钟

d: n 实验室，研究室 a laboratory

es.e: the school science lab
es.c: 学校的科学实验室

d: n 孙子；外孙 the son of your son or daughter

es.e: My grandson's birthday was on Tuesday.
es.c: 我孙子的生日是星期二。

d: adj 受欢迎的 if someone is welcome in a place, other people are glad that they are there；n 欢迎 the way in which you greet someone when they arrive at a place；v 欢迎 to say hello in a friendly way to someone who has just arrived

es.e: I had the feeling I wasn’t really welcome.
es.c: 我感觉到我其实不受欢迎。

es.e: I didn’t feel welcome in the club.
es.c: 我觉得我在俱乐部里不受欢迎。

es.e: Mary made us very welcome.
es.c: 玛丽让我们感觉很受欢迎。

d: n 女儿；[遗][农学] 子代 someone’s female child；adj 女儿的；子代的

es.e: She’s got two daughters and one son.
es.c: 她有两个女儿和一个儿子。

es.e: our eldest daughter
es.c: 我们的长女

d: n 肉，肉类（食用） the flesh of animals and birds eaten as food

es.e: I gave up eating meat a few months ago.
es.c: 我几个月以前开始不吃肉了。

es.e: raw meat
es.c: 生肉

es.e: a meat pie
es.c: 肉馅饼

d: n 道路；小路；轨道 a track that has been made deliberately or made by many people walking over the same ground

es.e: I walked nervously up the garden path towards the front door.
es.c: 我提心吊胆地沿着花园的小道向前门走去。

es.e: a well-worn path across the grass
es.c: 草地上被踏出的小径

es.e: Follow the path along the river to the bridge.
es.c: 沿着河边的小路走到那座桥。

d: adj 两个的；两者的；adv 并；又；两者皆；pron 双方都；两者都；conj 既…且… used to emphasize that something is true not just of one person, thing, or situation but also of another

es.e: To help the talks along, both of us should make some concessions.
es.c: 为了会谈有所进展，我们双方都得做出一些让步。

d: adv 起来；上涨；向上 towards a higher place or position；prep 在…之上；向…的较高处；adj 涨的；起床的；向上的 If you are up, you are not in bed；n 上升；繁荣

es.e: We walked slowly up the hill.
es.c: 我们慢慢地爬上山。

es.e: She picked her jacket up off the floor.
es.c: 她从地板上捡起外套。

es.e: paths leading up into the mountains
es.c: 通往山里的小径

d: adj 可能的；合理的；合适的 if something is possible, it can be done or achieved；n 可能性；合适的人；可能的事物 someone or something that might be suitable or acceptable for a particular purpose

es.e: Is it possible toget tickets for the game?
es.c: 有没有可能弄到比赛的门票？

es.e: It might be possible for the documents to be sent over.
es.c: 这些文件也许可以发送过去。

es.e: Computer technology makes it possible for many people to work from home.
es.c: 计算机技术让很多人可以在家里工作。

d: n 事情；东西；事物；情况 an idea, action, feeling, or fact that someone thinks, does, says, or talks about, or that happens

es.e: People say things they don’t mean when they are angry.
es.c: 人生气时就会口不择言。

es.e: It was a horrible thing to happen.
es.c: 发生这样的事情太糟糕了。

es.e: I plan to do all the things I’ve been meaning to do for ages.
es.c: 我打算去做我多年以来一直想做的事。

d: n 印度（南亚国家）

es.e: Burma borders on India.
es.c: 缅甸与印度毗邻。

es.e: This book treats of the caste system in India.
es.c: 这本书论述了印度的种姓制度。

es.e: If you come to India for just one thing, this should be it.
es.c: 如果你只为一件事来到印度，那就到这儿来吧。

d: v 挑选；采摘；挖 to choose a person or thing, for example because they are the best or most suitable；n 选择；鹤嘴锄；挖；掩护 if you can have your pick or take your pick of different things, you can choose which one you want

es.e: Students have to pick three courses from a list of 15.
es.c: 学生必须从15门课中选修3门。

es.e: I don’t know which colour to pick.
es.c: 我不知道要选哪个颜色。

es.e: Who’s going to pick the team for the match on Saturday?
es.c: 谁将为星期六的比赛挑选队员？

d: n 区域，地区；面积；范围 a particular part of a country, town etc

es.e: Only cheeses made in this area may be labelled ‘Roquefort.’
es.c: 只有这个地区出产的干酪才能被称作“罗克福尔干酪”。

es.e: Crime rates are much higher in urban areas.
es.c: 城镇地区的犯罪率要高很多。

d: v 说明；解释 to tell someone about something in a way that is clear or easy to understand

es.e: He carefully explained the procedure.
es.c: 他仔细解释了程序。

d: adj 社会的，社交的；群居的 relating to human society and its organization, or the quality of people’s lives；n 联谊会；联欢会 a party for the members of a group, club, or church

es.e: social issues, such as unemployment and education
es.c: 失业和教育之类的社会问题

es.e: the country’s serious social problems
es.c: 该国严重的社会问题

es.e: a challenge to the social order
es.c: 对社会秩序的一个挑战

d: v 权衡；考虑；称…重量 to have a particular weight；n 权衡；称重量

es.e: The young birds weigh only a few grams.
es.c: 雏鸟重量只有几克。

es.e: Do you know how much it weighs?
es.c: 你知道它的重量吗？

es.e: (= how much ) do you weigh?
es.c: 你的体重是多少？

d: n 九，九个 the number 9；num 九；九个 the number 9；adj 九的，九个的

es.e: He’s only been in this job for nine months.
es.c: 他干这份工作才九个月。

es.e: We open at nine (= nine o’clock ).
es.c: 我们9点开始营业。

es.e: Kay was taught by her mother till she was nine (= nine years old ).
es.c: 凯一直由她妈妈教到九岁。

d: neg 没什么；毫不；n 无；零；不关紧要之事 zero；adv 毫不；决不；pron 无事；无物 if you have nothing to do with someone or something, or if someone or something has nothing to do with you, you are not involved or connected with it

es.e: I owe him nothing.
es.c: 我不欠他什么。

d: n 工作；职业 the regular paid work that you do for an employer；v 承包；代客买卖

es.e: Do you enjoy your job?
es.c: 你喜欢自己的工作吗？

es.e: It was the first paid job I ever had.
es.c: 这是我第一份拿工资的工作。

es.e: He’s been in the job for six years.
es.c: 他干这份工作有六年了。

d: n 博物馆 a building where important  cultural  , historical, or scientific objects are kept and shown to the public

es.e: the Museum of Modern Art
es.c: 现代艺术博物馆

es.e: The museum has an extensive collection of early photographs.
es.c: 这座博物馆藏有大量早期的照片。

d: n 里面；内部；内情；内脏 the inner part of something, which is surrounded or hidden by the outer part；adj 里面的；内部的；秘密的 in or facing the inner part of something；adv 在里面 in or into a container or other closed space so as to be complet

es.e: The door had been locked from the inside.
es.c: 门从里面锁上了。

d: adj 有耐心的，能容忍的 able to wait calmly for a long time or to accept difficulties, people’s annoying behaviour etc without becoming angry；n 病人；患者 someone who is receiving medical treatment from a doctor or in a hospital

es.e: You’ll just have to be patient and wait till I’m off the phone.
es.c: 你只能耐心点，等我打完电话。

d: n 番茄，西红柿 a round soft red fruit eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable

es.e: He staked his tomato vines with bamboo.
es.c: 他用竹竿支撑起西红柿秧。

es.e: The salmon was brought to the table whole, garnished with parsley and slices of tomato and cucumber.
es.c: 整条大麻哈鱼被端上了桌，并用欧芹、西红柿片和黄瓜片作为花色配菜。

d: adj 不同的；个别的，与众不同的 not like something or someone else, or not like before

es.e: The place looks completely different now.
es.c: 这地方现在完全变了。

es.e: They decided to try a radically different approach.
es.c: 他们决定尝试一种全然不同的办法。

es.e: We found women had significantly different political views from men.
es.c: 我们发现女性的政治观点与男性大不相同。

d: n [语] 单词；话语；消息；诺言；命令 a single group of letters that are used together with a particular meaning；v 用言辞表达 to use words that are carefully chosen in order to express something

es.e: Write an essay of about five hundred words.
es.c: 写一篇约500字的文章。

es.e: What does that word mean?
es.c: 那个单词是什么意思？

es.e: ‘Vater’ is the German word for (= that means ) ‘father’.
es.c: vater在德语中是“父亲”的意思。

d: n 女士，夫人；小姐；妻子 used as the title of the wife or daughter of a British noblemanor the wife of a knight

es.e: Lady Spencer
es.c: 斯宾塞夫人

d: n 风筝 a light frame covered in coloured paper or plastic that you let fly in the air on the end of one or two long strings；v 使用空头支票；像风筝一样飞；轻快地移动

es.e: She has a blue and green kite.
es.c: 她有一只蓝色和绿色的风筝。

es.e: The child tailed his kite.
es.c: 小孩儿给自己的风筝装了尾巴。

es.e: He tried to fly his kite.
es.c: 他试图放飞他的风筝。

d: n 外地人，外国人 someone who comes from a different country

es.e: Some of the local people are suspicious of foreigners.
es.c: 有些当地人不信任外国人。

d: adv 从未；决不 not at any time, or not once

es.e: He’s never been to Australia.
es.c: 他从未去过澳大利亚。

es.e: I’m never going back there again, not as long as I live.
es.c: 只要我活着，我再也不会回到那儿去。

es.e: It is never too late to give up smoking.
es.c: 戒烟不言晚。

d: n 垃圾；废物 waste material that has been thrown away；v 拒绝；不愿；抵制 to say firmly that you will not do something that someone has asked you to do

es.e: a refuse dump
es.c: 垃圾场

es.e: refuse collection
es.c: 垃圾收集

d: n 高温；压力；热度；热烈 warmth or the quality of being hot；v 使激动；把…加热 to make something become warm or hot

es.e: Ice needs heat to melt.
es.c: 冰需要热才能融化。

es.e: Insulating the attic is a good way to reduce heat loss.
es.c: 为阁楼安装隔热层是减少热量流失的好方法。

d: n 火；火灾；炮火；炉火；热情；激情；磨难 uncontrolled flames, light, and heat that destroy and damage things；v 点燃；解雇；开除；使发光；烧制；激动；放枪 to force someone to leave their job

es.e: The warehouse was completely destroyed by fire.
es.c: 仓库全给烧毁了。

es.e: Thirty people died in a fire in downtown Chicago.
es.c: 30人死于芝加哥市中心的一场火灾。

es.e: Police think that the fire was started deliberately.
es.c: 警方认为有人故意纵火。

d: adv 或许；（表示不确定）也许；（用于粗略的估计）或许；（表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许；可能 used to say that something may be true, but you are not sure；n 假定；猜想；未定之事

es.e: Perhaps she’s next door.
es.c: 她也许在隔壁。

es.e: Perhaps it will snow tomorrow.
es.c: 明天可能会下雪。

es.e: It won’t take so long next time, perhaps.
es.c: 也许下次不用那么久。

d: n 老板；首领；工头 the person who employs you or who is in charge of you at work；v 指挥，调遣；当…的领导 to tell people to do things, give them orders etc, especially when you have no authority to do it

es.e: I’ll have to ask my boss for a day off.
es.c: 我得向老板请一天假。

es.e: Since I’m my own boss (=  I work for myself, rather than for an employer  ) , my hours are flexible.
es.c: 我自己当老板，所以我的时间很灵活。

d: n 供给，补给；供应品 an amount of something that is available to be used；v 供给，提供；补充 to provide people with something that they need or want, especially regularly over a long period of time

es.e: The nation’s fuel supplies will not last forever.
es.c: 这个国家的燃料供应不会无穷无尽。

es.e: To protect the food supply , the government ordered the slaughter of affected cattle.
es.c: 为保护食品供应，政府下令宰杀被感染的牛。

d: n 袜子（sock的复数） Socks are pieces of clothing which cover your foot and ankle and are worn inside shoes

es.e: ...a pair of knee-high socks.
es.c: …一双齐膝的短袜。

d: n 昨天；往昔 the day before today；adv 昨天 on or during the day before today

es.e: yesterday’s meeting
es.c: 昨天的会议

es.e: They arrived the day before yesterday.
es.c: 他们前天到的。

d: adj 那些的；pron 那些（that的复数）

es.e: He dotted down those notes.
es.c: 他匆匆记下了那些注解。

es.e: She ganged up on me with those rough boys.
es.c: 她伙同那些粗野的男孩对付我。

d: n 成功，成就；胜利；大获成功的人或事物 when you achieve what you want or intend

es.e: The experiment was a big success.
es.c: 实验非常成功。

d: n 网站（全球资讯网的主机站） a place on the Internet where you can find information about something, especially a particular organization

es.e: For more information on weight loss and healthy eating, visit our website.
es.c: 有关减肥和健康饮食的更多信息，请访问我们的网站。

d: adj 相似的 almost the same；n 类似物

es.e: We have similar tastes in music.
es.c: 我们对音乐的品位相近。

es.e: Both approaches seem to achieve similar results.
es.c: 两种方法都得出了相似的结果。

es.e: A number of his friends had been affected in a similar way .
es.c: 他的一些朋友也受到了类似的影响。

d: n 钢铁；钢制品；坚固 strong metal that can be shaped easily, consisting of iron and  carbon；v 钢化；使冷酷；adj 钢制的；钢铁业的；坚强的

es.e: a steel bridge
es.c: 钢铁大桥

es.e: (= steel that does not change colour ) knives
es.c: 不锈钢小刀

d: adv 此外；而且 used when adding another reason；prep 除…之外

es.e: I need the money. And besides, when I agree to do something, I do it.
es.c: 我需要这笔钱，而且，我一旦答应做什么事情就会做到。

d: adj 全部的；adv 全然地；越发 completely；n 全部 the whole of an amount, thing, or type of thing；pron 全部

es.e: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
es.c: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。

es.e: a strange woman, dressed all in black
es.c: 一袭黑衣的奇怪女子

es.e: If people want more freedom of choice, then I’m all for it (=  I strongly support it  ) .
es.c: 如果民众想要更多选择的自由，我完全支持。

d: n 建议；忠告；劝告；通知 an opinion you give someone about what they should do

es.e: You should have followed my advice.
es.c: 你真该听我的建议。

d: n 音乐，乐曲 a series of sounds made by instruments or voices in a way that is pleasant or exciting

es.e: I often listen to classic music when I’m in the car.
es.c: 我在车上经常听古典音乐。

es.e: A new piece of music was specially written for the occasion.
es.c: 为了这个活动专门写了一首新曲子。

d: n 实践；练习；惯例 when you do a particular thing, often regularly, in order to improve your skill at it；v 练习；实习；实行

es.e: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
es.c: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

es.e: With a little more practice you should be able to pass your test.
es.c: 稍微再练一练，你应该能通过考试了。

es.e: We have choir practice on Tuesday evening.
es.c: 星期二晚上我们要练习合唱。

es.c: 我们在70年代失去了联系。

d: n 惊奇；奇迹；惊愕 used to say that something is very surprising；v 怀疑；想知道；惊讶 to think about something that you are not sure about and try to guess what is true, what will happen etc；adj 奇妙的；非凡的 If you refer, for example, to a yo

es.c: 竟然没有人受伤，真是奇迹。

es.e: Mickelson was hailed as the wonder boy of American golf.
es.c: 米克尔森被称颂为美国高尔夫球界的神奇男孩。

d: adj 每一的，每个的；每隔…的 Every is also an adjective；n (Every)人名；(英)埃夫里

es.e: His every utterance will be scrutinized.
es.c: 他说的每句话都会被细查。

d: n 屏，幕；屏风 the part of a television or computer where the picture or information appears；v 筛；拍摄；放映；掩蔽 to do tests on a lot of people to find out whether they have a particular illness

es.e: a computer with an 18-inch colour screen
es.c: 带18英寸彩色屏幕的电脑

es.e: He went on staring at the TV screen .
es.c: 他继续盯着电视屏幕看。

d: n 母鸡；女人；雌禽 an adult female chicken

es.e: The hen sits in the hencoop [henroost].
es.c: 母鸡卧窝。

d: n 面包；生计 a type of food made from flour and water that is mixed together and then baked；v 在…上洒面包屑

es.e: Would you like some bread with your soup?
es.c: 你喝汤时要吃点面包吗？

es.e: a loaf of brown bread
es.c: 一条黑面包

es.e: a piece of bread and butter
es.c: 一块黄油面包

d: n 人；身体；容貌，外表；人称 a human being, especially considered as someone with their own particular character

es.e: He was a very nice person, always pleasant and friendly.
es.c: 他是个很好的人，始终彬彬有礼。

es.e: The only person who really said anything helpful was Jack.
es.c: 只有一个人真正说了些有用的话，就是杰克。

es.e: I like her as a person , but not as a boss.
es.c: 我喜欢她这个人，但作为老板我就不喜欢了。

d: pron 他们自己；他们亲自 used to show that the people who do something are affected by their own action

es.e: Teachers have no choice but to take measures to protect themselves.
es.c: 教师们别无选择，只能采取措施来保护自己。

es.e: Our neighbours have just bought themselves a jacuzzi.
es.c: 我们邻居刚刚买了一个按摩浴缸。

es.e: The kids seem very pleased with themselves.
es.c: 那些孩子好像自得其乐。

d: v 用粉笔写；用白垩粉擦；记录；规划 to write, mark, or draw something with chalk；n 粉笔；白垩；用粉笔划的记号 soft white or grey rock formed a long time ago from the shells of small sea animals；adj 用粉笔写的

es.e: He chalked the message on the blackboard.
es.c: 他用粉笔把这条消息写在黑板上。

d: n [食品] 奶酪；干酪；要人 a solid food made from milk, which is usually yellow or white in colour, and can be soft or hard；v 停止；adj 叛变的；胆小的

es.c: 半公斤干酪

es.c: 干酪三明治

es.e: Sprinkle with the grated cheese.
es.c: 撒上磨碎的干酪。

d: adj 欲睡的；困乏的；不活跃的 tired and ready to sleep

es.c: 暖洋洋的炉火使她昏昏欲睡。

d: adj 十六的，十六个的；num 十六 the number

es.c: 但是，这份报告里有一项非常耐人寻味的数据：在2008年，金融保险业出现近十六年来的首次萎缩。

es.e: I’ve got tons of work to do.
es.c: 我有很多工作要做。

d: n 头发；毛发；些微 the mass of things like fine threads that grows on your head；vt 除去…的毛发；vi 生长毛发；形成毛状纤维；adj 毛发的；护理毛发的；用毛发制成的

es.e: Her hair was short and dark.
es.c: 她的头发又短又黑。

es.e: a short fat man with no hair on his head
es.c: 光头的矮胖男人

d: n 奶奶；外婆；婆婆妈妈的人 grandmother

es.c: …我的老奶奶。

d: n 云；阴云；云状物；一大群；黑斑 a white or grey mass in the sky that forms from very small drops of water；v 使混乱；以云遮敝；使忧郁；玷污

es.e: Fears of renewed terrorist attacks cast a cloud over the event (= spoilt the happy situation ) .
es.c: 对恐怖分子再次发动袭击的担心给这次活动蒙上了一层阴影。

d: adv 很少，不常 very rarely or almost never

es.e: Karen had seldom seen him so angry.
es.c: 卡伦很少见他这么生气过。

d: n （美）电话；电话机；电话耳机 the system of communication that you use to have a conversation with someone in another place；v 打电话 to talk to someone by telephone

es.c: 我正要走，电话铃响了。

d: n 属，种；种族，人种；家庭，门第 one of the main groups that humans can be divided into according to the colour of their skin and other physical features；v 使参加比赛；和…竞赛；使急走，使全速行进 to compete against someone or something in a race

es.c: 该校欢迎各种族的学生就读。

es.e: a person of mixed race
es.c: 混血儿

es.e: The law forbids discrimination on the grounds of race or religion.
es.c: 法律禁止以种族或宗教信仰为由歧视他人。

d: n 计算机；电脑；电子计算机 an electronic machine that stores information and uses programs to help you find, organize, or change the information

es.c: 巨大的全球计算机网络

es.e: the latest computer software
es.c: 最新的计算机软件

d: v 听，倾听；听从，听信 to pay attention to what someone is saying or to a sound that you can hear；n 听，倾听 an act of listening

es.c: 听！引擎发出奇怪的声音。

d: n 贸易，交易；行业；职业 the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods within a country or between countries；v 交易，买卖；以物易物 to buy and sell goods, services etc as your job or business

es.e: international trade agreements
es.c: 国际贸易协定

es.e: unfair trade practices
es.c: 不公平的贸易行为

pron 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切；万事 each thing or all things

es.e: Everything was covered in a thick layer of dust.
es.c: 所有东西上面都蒙着厚厚一层灰。

es.e: I decided to tell her everything.
es.c: 我决定把一切都告诉她。

es.e: Apart from the bus arriving late, everything else seemed to be going according to plan.
es.c: 除了公共汽车晚点之外，其他一切似乎都在按计划进行。

d: adv 代替；反而；相反 used to say what is not used, does not happen etc, when something else is used, happens etc

es.e: You probably picked up my keys instead of yours.
es.c: 你可能没拿你的钥匙而错拿了我的。

es.e: Could I have tuna instead of ham?
es.c: 我可否要金枪鱼来代替火腿？

es.e: Instead of being annoyed, he seemed quite pleased.
es.c: 他没有生气，反而似乎很高兴。

es.c: 我带你去你的房间，我们的房间在你的隔壁。

es.e: The main difference between our brains and those of monkeys is that ours are bigger.
es.c: 我们的大脑和猴子的大脑之间的主要差别在于我们的要大些。

es.e: No, that’s not ours.
es.c: 不，那不是我们的。

d: n 语法；语法书 the rules by which words change their forms and are combined into sentences, or the study or use of these rules

es.c: 检查你的拼写和语法。

es.c: 英语的语法规则

es.c: 你的名字怎么拼写？

es.c: 我怎么帮你？

es.c: 我想帮点忙，可不知道该怎么做。

es.c: 我看见你和那个女孩子说话。 她是谁？

es.c: 他的英语很地道。

es.c: 这辆车的车况极佳。

es.e: You’re very lucky to have perfect teeth.
es.c: 你能拥有一口完美的牙齿太幸运了。

es.c: 美术类书籍制作成本很高，尤其是那些带彩色插图的。

es.c: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

d: int 再见 goodbye；n 轮空；次要的东西；adj 次要的

d: n 物理学；物理现象 the science concerned with the study of physical objects and substances, and of natural forces such as light, heat, and movement

es.c: …物理学定律。

es.c: 他在两餐之间吃点东西来补充正餐。

es.e: Mother interposed in the dispute between my brother and me.
es.c: 母亲干预了我和哥哥之间的争论。

es.c: 这些实验的目的就是探索这两种现象之间的联系，如果存在着任何联系的话。

es.c: 请来一杯可乐和一杯番茄汁。

es.c: 毛茸茸的小动物

es.c: 这些化妆品没有进行过动物试验。

es.c: 他深深地感到羞愧。

es.c: 玛丽亚羞得脸都红了。

es.c: 让她感到惭愧的是，她减掉的体重全又长回来了。

d: n 天堂；天空；极乐 the place where God is believed to live and where good people are believed to go when they die

es.c: 他仰望苍穹。

es.c: 这些玩具不适合五岁以下的儿童玩。

es.c: 所列活动项目的花费大多低于 60 英镑。

es.e: I spend just under four hours a day seeing customers.
es.c: 我一天接待客户所花的时间将近四小时。

es.c: 他们分享我们的胜利。

es.c: 她在草地上摆好了我们的午饭。

es.e: We avenged ourselves on  our enemy.
es.c: 我们向我们的敌人报仇。

es.c: 宗教事务在全国都非常重要。

es.c: 1929至1933年间，美国的国民收入下降过半。

es.e: There are strong indications that the Prime Minister will call national elections in May.
es.c: 有明显迹象预示首相将于5月召集全国大选。

d: n 金属；合金 a hard, usually shiny substance such as iron, gold, or steel；v 以金属覆盖；adj 金属制的

es.c: 一个黑色的金属小盒子

es.c: 他们做黄金和其他贵金属的交易。

es.c: 快点，你还没准备好吗？

es.c: 你外出怎么要准备那么长时间？

es.e: It’s Dad’s birthday and we’re going out for a meal to celebrate.
es.c: 今天是爸爸的生日，我们打算出去吃饭庆祝一下。

es.c: 我父母正在庆祝他们结婚50周年。

es.c: 土伦以南15英里的一个滨海村落

es.e: the Norwegian national coach
es.c: 挪威国家队教练

es.c: 大卫俊朗的外表和完美的风度总是令她对他的缺点视而不见。

d: n 巧克力，巧克力糖；巧克力色 a sweet brown food that you can eat as a sweet or use in cooking to give foods such as cakes a special sweet taste；adj 巧克力色的；巧克力口味的

es.c: 巧克力条

es.c: 一包巧克力饼干

es.c: 宝宝玩的一些玩具

es.c: 安妮正高兴地玩着玩具。

d: n 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所 the standard unit of money in Britain, which is divided into 100 pence；v 捣烂；敲打；监禁，拘留 If you pound something, you crush it into a paste or a powder or into very small pieces

es.c: 他们花了一千多英镑。

es.e: a multi-million pound business
es.c: 一笔几百万英镑的生意

es.e: a five pound note
es.c: 五英镑的纸币

d: n 两倍；双精度型 something that is twice as big, as much etc as usual or as something else；adj 双重的；两倍的 consisting of two parts that are similar or exactly the same；v 加倍，加倍努力；快步走 to become twice as big or twice as much, or to ma

es.e: Scotch and water, please – make it a double.
es.c: 请来苏格兰威士忌加水——要双份的。

es.e: ‘They offered me £10,000.’ ‘I’ll give you double.’
es.c: “他们向我开价1万英镑。” “我给你加倍。”

d: n 老虎；凶暴的人 a large wild animal that has yellow and black lines on its body and is a member of the cat family

es.e: The trainer backed away from the enraged tiger.
es.c: 驯兽师从被激怒的老虎身旁往后退。

d: adj 坚强的；强壮的；牢固的；擅长的 having a lot of physical power so that you can lift heavy things, do hard physical work etc；adv 强劲地；猛烈地；n (Strong)人名；(英)斯特朗

es.e: He was a big strong man.
es.c: 他高大健壮。

es.c: 杰克又高又壮。

es.e: I’m not strong enough to fight him.
es.c: 和他打我还不够强壮。

d: adj 容易的；舒适的 not difficult to do, and not needing much effort；adv 不费力地，从容地；vi 停止划桨；vt 发出停划命令

es.e: The test was easy.
es.c: 考试很容易。

es.e: Finishing the task will not be easy.
es.c: 完成这项任务并不容易。

es.e: There must be an easier way to do that.
es.c: 一定有更容易的方法去做那件事。

d: n 电视，电视机；电视业 a piece of electronic equipment shaped like a box with a screen, on which you can watch programmes

es.e: Lucy turned on the television to watch the evening news.
es.c: 露西打开电视收看晚间新闻。

es.e: They have a television in every room.
es.c: 他们每个房间都配有电视。

d: n 想法；主意；概念 a plan or suggestion for a possible course of action, especially one that you think of suddenly

es.e: You should talk to Ken – he's always full of good ideas.
es.c: 你应该和肯谈谈，他总是满脑子好主意。

es.e: I knew it was a bad idea to leave him on his own.
es.c: 我知道把他独自留下不是个好主意。

es.e: It was my wife’s idea to move house.
es.c: 要搬家是我妻子的主意。

d: adv 一起；同时；相互；连续地；总共 if two or more people do something together, they do it with each other；adj 新潮的；情绪稳定的，做事有效率的

es.e: We’ve very much enjoyed working together .
es.c: 我们在一起工作非常开心。

es.e: They’ve decided to spend more time together.
es.c: 他们决定要花更多时间在一起。

es.e: He and my father were at school together.
es.c: 他和我父亲一起上过学。

d: art 这；那；adv 更加（用于比较级，最高级前） used before two  comparative  adjectives or adverbs to show that the degree of one event or situation is related to the degree of another one

es.e: He described the scene to me.
es.c: 他向我描述了那个情景。

es.e: He telegraphed me to go to the party.
es.c: 他发电报要我去参加那个聚会。

es.e: The world exists, whether you like it or not.
es.c: 不管你喜欢与否，这个世界照样存在。

d: n 恋爱；亲爱的；酷爱；喜爱的事物；爱情，爱意；疼爱；热爱；爱人，所爱之物 a strong feeling of liking someone a lot combined with sexual attraction；v 爱，热爱；爱戴；赞美，称赞；喜爱；喜好；喜欢；爱慕 to have a strong feeling of  affection  for someone, combined with sexual attract

es.e: Tara is madly in love with you.
es.c: 塔拉疯狂地爱着你。

d: n 刷子；画笔；毛笔；争吵；与某人有效冲突；灌木丛地带；矮树丛；狐狸尾巴 an object that you use for cleaning, painting, making your hair tidy etc, made with a lot of hairs,  bristle s  , or thin pieces of plastic, fastened to a handle；v 刷；画； to clean somet

es.e: a scrubbing brush
es.c: 硬毛刷，板刷

d: n 卡车；交易；手推车 a large road vehicle used to carry goods；v 驾驶卡车；以物易物；adj （美）运货汽车的

es.e: a truck driver
es.c: 卡车司机

d: n 口，嘴；河口 the part of your face which you put food into, or which you use for speaking；v 做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出

es.e: He lifted his glass to his mouth.
es.c: 他把玻璃杯举到嘴边。

es.e: Liam was fast asleep with his mouth wide open.
es.c: 利亚姆大张着嘴，睡得很熟。

d: adj 厌恶的；病态的；不舒服；渴望的；恶心的 ；生病的 suffering from a disease or illness；n 病人 people who are ill；v 使狗去咬；呕吐；追击

es.e: His mother’s very sick.
es.c: 他母亲病得很重。

es.e: Maria can’t come in today because she’s sick.
es.c: 玛丽亚因为生病今天不能来了。

es.e: a sick child
es.c: 生病的孩子

d: adv 只，仅仅；不料 not more than a particular number, age etc；adj 唯一的，仅有的；最合适的 used to say that there is one person, thing, or group in a particular situation and no others；conj 但是；不过；可是 used like ‘but’ to give the reason why s

es.e: Naomi was only 17 when she got married.
es.c: 娜奥米结婚时才17岁。

es.e: There are only a few cars on the island.
es.c: 这个岛上只有几辆汽车。

es.e: It’s only eight o’clock.
es.c: 才8点钟。

d: adv 快；不久，一会儿；立刻；宁愿 in a short time from now, or a short time after something else happens

es.e: It will be dark soon.
es.c: 天很快就要黑了。

es.e: David arrived sooner than I expected.
es.c: 戴维到得比我预料的快。

es.e: ‘Who?’ ‘You’ll find out soon enough (= fairly soon ) .’
es.c: “谁？”“你很快就会知道的。”

d: adj 友好的；亲切的；支持的；融洽的，和睦的 behaving towards someone in a way that shows you like them and are ready to talk to them or help them；adv 友善地；温和地；n (Friendly)人名；(英)弗兰德利

es.e: a friendly smile
es.c: 亲切的微笑

es.e: I’ve found a great pub – good beer and a friendly atmosphere.
es.c: 我找到了一家很棒的酒馆——啤酒好，氛围也亲切。

d: n 墙壁，围墙；似墙之物 an upright flat structure made of stone or brick, that divides one area from another or surrounds an area；v 用墙围住，围以墙；adj 墙壁的

es.e: the Great Wall of China
es.c: 中国的长城

es.e: We climbed over the wall into the orchard.
es.c: 我们翻墙进了果园。

d: adj [经] 疲软的；虚弱的；无力的；不牢固的 not physically strong

es.e: The illness left her feeling weak.
es.c: 疾病使她感到身体虚弱。

es.e: Poor light produces weak plants.
es.c: 光照不足，植物就生长不好。

es.e: The animal was weak from loss of blood.
es.c: 那只动物因失血而虚弱无力。

d: n 钱；货币；财富 what you earn by working and can use to buy things. Money can be in the form of notes and coins or cheques, and can be kept in a bank

es.e: Don’t spend all your money on the first day of your holiday!
es.c: 别在度假的第一天就把钱都花完了！

es.e: The repairs will cost quite a lot of money.
es.c: 修理要花一大笔钱。

es.c: 他忘了锁门，真是粗心大意。

es.c: 粗心造成的错误

es.e: careless driving
es.c: 粗心驾驶

es.e: It is helpful if we address a few key questions here.
es.c: 如果我们在这里解决一些关键问题会很有用的。

es.c: 五英里外还有个高尔夫球场。

es.c: 我五点前回来。

es.e: The family moved to Canada when he was five (= five years old ) .

d: adj 欧洲的；欧洲人的 relating to Europe or its people；n 欧洲人 someone from Europe

es.c: 我们的欧洲伙伴

es.c: 他老是照镜子！

es.e: When I looked in the mirror I couldn’t believe it. I looked fantastic!
es.c: 我看着镜子简直不敢相信，我看上去棒极了！

es.c: 这座监狱的条件糟透了。

es.e: In May, staff went on strike, demanding better pay and conditions .
es.c: 五月份员工举行了罢工，要求提高工资和改善工作条件。

es.c: 以一个舒服的姿势躺下。

es.e: Frankie shifted his position so that his knees would not become cramped.
es.c: 弗朗基换了个姿势，这样他的膝盖就不会老蜷着动弹不得。

es.e: Dad really loves to fish.
es.c: 爸爸很喜欢钓鱼。

d: v 统治；管辖；裁定 to have the official power to control a country and the people who live there；n 统治；规则 an official instruction that says how things must be done or what is allowed, especially in a game, organization, or job

es.e: Queen Victoria ruled England for 64 years.
es.c: 维多利亚女王统治英格兰64年。

es.e: African tribal societies were traditionally ruled by a council of elders.
es.c: 非洲部落社会传统上由长老会统治。

es.c: 他宣布他将从此实行专制统治。

es.e: Why, look who’s here!
es.c: 哎呀，看看这是谁！

es.e: And I thought to myself, why, I can do that.
es.c: 我就对自己说，嗨，我能行的。

es.e: We’re just here on a short visit.
es.c: 我们只在这儿作短暂逗留。

es.e: Why don’t you come for a visit this summer?
es.c: 你们何不今年夏天来这里做客呢？

es.e: I decided to pay him a visit at his office.
es.c: 我决定去他的办公室拜访他。

d: n 勇气；胆量 the quality of being brave when you are facing a difficult or dangerous situation or when you are very ill

es.c: 休在生病期间表现出了极大的勇气。

es.e: Driving again after his accident must have taken a lot of courage (= needed courage ) .
es.c: 他出事故后再驾车肯定需要很大的勇气。

d: n 洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人 a child’s toy that looks like a small person or baby；v 把…打扮得花枝招展

es.c: 一个小木玩偶

es.c: 毕业典礼在5月初举行。

es.e: spring flowers
es.c: 春花

es.e: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
es.c: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”

es.c: “你还要再来点吗？”“不要了，谢谢。”

es.c: “你能帮我写这个吗？”“抱歉，不行，我现在没时间。”

d: n 欢乐，快乐；乐趣；高兴 something or someone that gives you happiness and pleasure；v 欣喜，欢喜 to be happy because of something

es.c: 这座花园是他的骄傲和乐趣所在。

es.c: 快点！大家在等着呢。

es.e: Would you mind waiting outside?
es.c: 你在外面等好吗？

es.e: We’ve been waiting ages.
es.c: 我们已经等了很长时间了。

es.e: Tom: No.Although 75% of its raw materials is elephant dung, it is light delicate fragrance instead of stink. This is due to its special fabrication technology.
es.c: 不，尽管这种纸里75％的原料都是大象的粪便，但它不但不臭，反而有一种淡淡的清香，这是源于它的特殊的制造工艺。

d: n 挑战；挑动 something dangerous that you have dared someone to do；v 敢冒；不惧 said to warn someone not to do something because it makes you angry

es.e: Jones broke into a military base on a dare.
es.c: 约翰接受了挑战，冲进一个军事基地。

es.c: 计算机应用概论

es.e: I skimmed through it to get a general impression of the text.
es.c: 我把文章浏览了一下，让自己有个大致的了解。

es.e: I have a general idea of what I want to express.
es.c: 我对自己想要表达什么有个大致的想法。

d: n 片刻，瞬间，时刻；重要，契机 a particular point in time

es.c: 这是他一生中最激动人心的时刻之一。

es.e: She may be in trouble at this very moment and trying to call you.
es.c: 此时此刻她可能遇到了麻烦，正想方设法给你打电话。

es.e: I remember the moment when I first saw him after the operation.
es.c: 我还记得手术后第一次见到他的那一刻。

d: adj 明智的；聪明的；博学的 wise decisions and actions are sensible and based on good judgment；v 使知道；教导；n (Wise)人名；(英)怀斯

es.c: 明智的预防措施

es.e: I don’t think that would be a very wise move (= not be a sensible thing to do ).
es.c: 我认为那样做不是很明智。

es.c: 玻璃碗

es.c: 一块碎玻璃片

es.e: the cathedral’s stained glass windows
es.c: 教堂的彩色玻璃窗

d: n 菜单 a list of all the kinds of food that are available for a meal, especially in a restaurant

es.c: 请把菜单给我们，好吗？

es.e: a three course set menu
es.c: 三道菜的套餐

es.c: 外交事务经验丰富的人

es.e: Our aim is to bring classical music to a wider audience.
es.c: 我们的目的是把古典音乐带给更多的听众。

d: n 科目；课程；过程；进程；道路；路线，航向；一道菜 a period of time or process during which something happens；v 追赶；跑过
n 先生；绅士；有身份的人 a polite word for a man, used especially when talking to or about a man you do not know

es.e: Could you serve this gentleman please, Miss Bath?
es.c: 巴思小姐，请你接待一下这位先生好吗？

es.e: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen .
es.c: 早上好，女士们，先生们。

es.e: An elderly gentleman was asleep next to the fire.
es.c: 一位老先生在火炉旁边睡着了。

d: adj 公开的；敞开的；空旷的；坦率的；营业着的 not closed, so that things, people, air etc can go in and out or be put in and out；v 开始；展现 to raise your eyelids so that you can see, or to be raised in this way；n 公开；空旷；户外 outdoors

es.e: He threw the door open and ran down the stairs.
es.c: 他猛地打开门，往楼下跑去。

es.e: an open window
es.c: 打开的窗户

es.e: The gates swung silently open.
es.c: 大门悄悄地打开了。

d: n 早晨；黎明；初期 the early part of the day, from when the sun rises until 12 o’clock in the middle of the day

es.e: I hated those cold winter mornings.
es.c: 我讨厌冬天里寒冷的早晨。

es.e: I’m not feeling very well this morning.
es.c: 今天早上我觉得不大舒服。

es.e: He stayed in bed late on Sunday morning.
es.c: 星期日早上他睡到很晚。

d: adj 软的，柔软的；温柔的，温和的；软弱的；笨的 having a surface that is smooth and pleasant to touch；adv 柔软地；温和地；n 柔性；柔软的东西；柔软部分

es.e: a baby’s soft skin
es.c: 婴儿细嫩的皮肤

es.e: The fur was soft to the touch.
es.c: 这皮毛摸起来很柔滑。

d: adv 在楼上，向楼上；上楼；往楼上 towards or on an upper floor in a building；adj 楼上的 An upstairs room or object is situated on a floor of a building that is higher than the ground floor；n 楼上 one or all of the upper floors in a building

es.e: I went upstairs and had a shower.
es.c: 我上楼冲了个澡。

es.e: She’s upstairs in bed feeling ill.
es.c: 她身体不舒服，在楼上躺着。

es.e: Marsani moved into the upstairs apartment.
es.c: 玛萨妮搬进了楼上的公寓。

d: n 假期；（房屋）搬出 a holiday, or time spent not working；v 休假，度假 to go somewhere for a holiday

es.e: We’re planning a vacation in Europe.
es.c: 我们正计划去欧洲度假。

es.e: We’re planning to go on vacation soon.
es.c: 我们在计划近期去度假。

d: n 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西 the number 50；adj 五十的；五十个的；众多的

es.e: Standards of living rose in the fifties.
es.c: 50年代生活水平提高了。

d: adv 向前；（门等）关上 if a door is pushed to, it closes or almost closes；prep 到；向；（表示时间、方向）朝…方向 used to say where someone or something goes；n (To)人名；(柬)多；(中)脱(普通话·威妥玛)

es.e: The wind blew the door to.
es.c: 风把门吹上了。

d: v 杀死；扼杀；使终止；抵消 to make a person or animal die；n 杀戮；屠杀 the act of killing a hunted animal；adj 致命的；致死的

es.e: Why did she kill her husband?
es.c: 她为什么杀死丈夫？

es.e: Murray held a gun to his head and threatened to kill him.
es.c: 默里拿枪指着他的头并威胁要杀了他。

es.e: Four people were killed when a train plunged into a flooded river.
es.c: 火车冲进洪水泛滥的河中，造成四人身亡。

d: num 七个，七 the number 7；n 七个，七 the number 7；adj 七的；七个的

es.e: The women visited cities in seven states.
es.c: 这些女性访问了七个州的城市。

es.e: We close the store at seven (= seven o’clock ) .
es.c: 我们商店七点关门。

es.e: ‘How old’s Sam?’ ‘He’s seven (= seven years old ) .’
es.c: “萨姆多大了？”“他七岁。”

d: n 空间；太空；距离 the amount of an area, room, container etc that is empty or available to be used；v 留间隔

es.e: How much space is there on each disk?
es.c: 每张磁盘有多大容量？

es.e: The hedge takes up too much space .
es.c: 这树篱占了太多的地方。

d: n 电冰箱 a large piece of electrical kitchen equipment, used for keeping food and drinks cool

es.e: Then all three of you sign the contract and post in on the fridge.
es.c: 然后你们三个人要都在协议上签名，并把它贴在冰箱上。

es.e: I want this beer to chill so I'll leave it in the fridge for an hour.
es.c: 我想要啤酒变凉，因此我把它放在冰箱里一小时。

es.e: It can be anything: spoiled milk from the back of your fridge right down to tar and feathers.
es.c: 它可以是任何玩意儿：从你冰箱后面那些变质的牛奶到沥青和羽毛。

d: n 球；舞会 a round object that is thrown, kicked, or hit in a game or sport；v 成团块

es.e: ...a golf ball.
es.c: …一个高尔夫球。

d: v 飞；驾驶飞机；飘扬 to travel by plane；n 飞行；苍蝇；两翼昆虫 a small flying insect with two wings；adj 敏捷的 knowing and sharp; smart

es.e: She’s flying back to the States tomorrow.
es.c: 她明天乘飞机回美国。

es.e: Will you take the train there or fly?
es.c: 你去那里是坐火车还是坐飞机？

es.e: Maurice is nervous about flying, so he usually travels overland.
es.c: 莫里斯害怕乘坐飞机，因此他一般走陆路。

d: v 问，询问；要求；需要；邀请；讨价 to speak or write to someone in order to get an answer, information, or a solution；n (Ask)人名；(芬、瑞典)阿斯克

es.e: ‘What’s your name?’ she asked.
es.c: “你叫什么名字？”她问道 。

es.e: Don’t ask him – he won’t know.
es.c: 别问他，他不知道。

es.e: That kid’s always asking awkward questions .
es.c: 那孩子总是问一些尴尬的问题。

d: n 手，手艺；帮助；指针；插手 the part of your body at the end of your arm, including your fingers and thumb, that you use to hold things；v 传递，交给；支持；搀扶 to give something to someone else with your hand

es.e: Steve gripped the steering wheel tightly with both hands.
es.c: 史蒂夫双手紧握方向盘。

es.e: In her hand was a tattered old photograph.
es.c: 她手中拿着的是一张破旧的老照片。

d: n 围巾；嵌接，嵌接处；头巾领巾 a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck, head, or shoulders, especially to keep warm；v 披嵌接；用围巾围

es.e: He reached up to loosen the scarf around his neck.
es.c: 他伸出手松开围在脖子上的围巾。

d: n 发展；开发；发育；住宅小区（专指由同一开发商开发的）；[摄] 显影 the process of gradually becoming bigger, better, stronger, or more advanced

es.e: child development
es.c: 儿童发育

d: adj 平的；单调的；不景气的；干脆的；平坦的；扁平的；浅的 smooth and level, without raised or hollow areas, and not sloping or curving；adv （尤指贴着另一表面）平直地；断然地；水平地；直接地，完全地 in a position in which the surface of something is against another surface wit

es.e: houses with flat roofs
es.c: 平顶房

es.e: a perfectly flat sandy beach
es.c: 十分平坦的沙滩

es.e: The countryside near there is flat as a pancake (= very flat ) .
es.c: 那儿附近的乡间地势非常平坦。

d: adv 在下面，在较低处；在本页下面 in a lower place or position, or on a lower level；prep 在…下面；n (Below)人名；(英、德、芬、瑞典)贝洛

es.e: an animal that lives below ground
es.c: 生活在地下的动物

es.e: Water was dripping onto the floor below.
es.c: 水滴到下面的地板上。

es.e: I could hear voices in the courtyard below my window.
es.c: 我能听到院子里有人在我的窗下说话。

d: adj 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的 extremely good, attractive, enjoyable etc；n 古怪的人

es.e: You look fantastic!
es.c: 你看上去棒极了！

es.e: It’s a fantastic place, really beautiful!
es.c: 这真是个好地方，漂亮极了！

d: n 世界；领域；世俗；全人类；物质生活 the  planet  we live on, and all the people, cities, and countries on it

es.e: Tuberculosis is still common in some parts of the world .
es.c: 结核病在世界上某些地区仍很常见。

es.e: At that time China was the most powerful country in the world .
es.c: 当时中国是世界上最强大的国家。

es.e: The Taj Mahal attracts visitors from around the world .
es.c: 泰姬陵吸引了来自世界各地的游客。

d: conj 因为；由于；既然；自…以来；自…以后；prep 自…以来；自…以后 from a particular time or event in the past until the present, or in that period of time；adv 后来 When you are talking about an event or situation in the past, you use since to indica

es.e: We’ve been waiting here since two o’clock.
es.c: 我们从两点钟开始就在这里等了。

es.e: I haven’t played rugby since I left university.
es.c: 我大学毕业后就没打过橄榄球。

es.e: She left London ten years ago, and I haven’t seen her since.
es.c: 她十年前离开伦敦，此后我再没有见过她。

d: pron 它自己；它本身 used to show that a thing, organization, animal, or baby that does something is affected by its own action

es.e: The cat lay on the sofa, washing itself.
es.c: 猫躺在沙发上把自己舔干。

es.e: The machine switches itself off when the process is complete.
es.c: 工作程序结束，机器会自动关闭。

es.e: a small local enterprise that has transformed itself into a highly successful company
es.c: 已发展为业绩喜人的公司的一家小型地方企业

d: adj 完整的；纯粹的 all of something；n 整体；全部 something that consists of a number of parts, but is considered as a single unit

es.e: You have your whole life ahead of you!
es.c: 你有一辈子要过呢！

es.e: His whole attitude bugs me.
es.c: 他的整个态度都让我讨厌。

es.e: We ate the whole cake in about ten minutes.
es.c: 大约十分钟的时间，我们就把整个蛋糕都给吃完了。

d: adj 可怕的；很糟的；令人讨厌的 very bad；adv 很，非常

es.e: The hotel was absolutely terrible.
es.c: 这家宾馆糟糕透了。

es.e: I’d better write this down; I have a terrible memory.
es.c: 我最好把它记下来，我的记性很差。

d: adj 这样的，如此的；n (Such)人名；(英)萨奇；(德)祖赫 used to show that you think that something is not good enough or that there is not enough of it

es.e: How dared they do such a thing?
es.c: 他们怎么敢做出这样的事?

es.e: He would not succumb to such an item.
es.c: 他不会对这样的条款做出让步的。

d: v 种田，务农；经营农场；n 农场；农家；畜牧场 an area of land used for growing crops or keeping animals

es.e: The family has farmed here for generations.
es.c: 这家人世代在此务农。

d: n 杂志；弹药库；胶卷盒 a large thin book with a paper cover that contains news stories, articles, photographs etc, and is sold weekly or monthly

es.e: a magazine article
es.c: 杂志中的文章

es.e: She glanced over the magazine racks.
es.c: 她扫了一眼杂志架。

d: adj 懒惰的；懒洋洋的；怠惰的；慢吞吞的 not liking work and physical activity, or not making any effort to do anything；n (Lazy)人名；(德)拉齐

es.e: the laziest boy in the class
es.c: 班上最懒的男孩

es.e: He felt too lazy to get out of bed.
es.c: 他懒得都不想起床。

d: v 修理；修复 to fix something that is damaged, broken, split, or not working properly；n 修理，修补；修补部位 something that you do to fix a thing that is damaged, broken, or not working

es.e: Dad was up the ladder, repairing the roof.
es.c: 爸爸在梯子上修补屋顶。

es.e: Where can I get my shoes repaired ?
es.c: 哪儿能修补鞋子？

d: n 活动；行动；活跃 things that people do, especially in order to achieve a particular aim

es.e: Everyone is free to engage in peaceful political activity.
es.c: 每个人都可以自由参加和平的政治活动。

es.e: fund-raising activities
es.c: 筹款活动

es.e: Regular physical activity helps to control your weight.
es.c: 定期参加体育活动有助于控制体重。

d: n 努力；成就 an attempt to do something, especially when this involves a lot of hard work or determination

es.e: please make an effort to be polite.
es.c: 请尽量礼貌些。

es.e: Church leaders are prepared to meet the terrorists in an effort to (= in order to try to ) find peace.
es.c: 为寻求和平，教会领袖准备与恐怖分子会面。

d: pron 每个人；人人 everyone
n 胜利；成功；克服 a situation in which you win a battle, game, election, or dispute

es.e: Union leaders are heading for victory in their battle over workplace rights.
es.c: 工会领袖们在争取工作场所权利的斗争中正迈向胜利。

d: adj 棕色的，褐色的；太阳晒黑的 having the colour of earth, wood, or coffee；v 变成褐色 to heat food so that it turns brown, or to become brown by being heated；n 褐色，棕色 the colour of earth, wood, or coffee

es.e: dark brown hair
es.c: 深褐色的头发

d: n 碗；木球；大酒杯 a wide round container that is open at the top, used to hold liquids, food, flowers etc；v 玩保龄球；滑动；平稳快速移动 to travel along very quickly and smoothly

es.e: Mix all the ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl.
es.c: 将所有配料放在大碗里搅拌均匀。

es.e: Fill the bowl with water.
es.c: 在碗里装满水。

d: adj 精密的；美好的；细微的；和蔼的 pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable；n (Nice)人名；(英)尼斯

es.e: They’ve got a very nice house.
es.c: 他们的房子真漂亮。

es.e: Did you have a nice time?
es.c: 你们玩得开心吗？

es.e: It’s such a nice day (= good weather ), why not go for a swim?
es.c: 天气真好，为什么不去游泳呢？

d: n 竞争；比赛，竞赛 a situation in which people or organizations try to be more successful than other people or organizations

es.e: Going to trade fairs is an ideal opportunity to size up the competition .
es.c: 参加商品交易会是估量竞争规模的理想机会。

d: n 口袋；钱；容器 a type of small bag in or on a coat, trousers etc that you can put money, keys etc in；v 隐藏；忍受；将…放入衣袋 If someone pockets something, they put it in their pocket, for example, because they want to steal it or hide

es.e: Luke came in with his hands in his pockets.
es.c: 卢克走了进来，双手插在口袋里。

es.e: The policeman told me to turn out my pockets (= take everything out of them ) .
es.c: 警察让我把口袋里的东西都掏出来。

es.e: Anthony snatched his letters and pocketed them.
es.c: 安东尼抓过他的信，放进了衣袋中。

d: n 九月 the ninth month of the year, between August and October

es.e: Her son, Jerome, was born in September.
es.c: 她的儿子杰罗姆出生于9月。

d: n 分，分钟；片刻，一会儿；备忘录，笔记；会议记录 a unit for measuring time. There are 60 minutes in one hour；v 将…记录下来 to make an official note of something in the record of a meeting；adj 微小的，详细的 [maɪˈnjuːt; US -ˈnuːt; maɪˋnut] extremely small

es.e: It takes me ten minutes to walk to work.
es.c: 我步行上班要用十分钟。

es.e: The train arrived at four minutes past eight.
es.c: 火车于八点零四分到达。

es.e: He returned a few minutes later.
es.c: 几分钟后他回来了。

d: n 手指；指针，指状物 one of the four long thin parts on your hand, not including your thumb；v 伸出；用手指拨弄 to touch or handle something with your fingers

es.e: The woman had a ring on her finger, so I assumed she was married.
es.c: 那女人手指上戴着戒指，因此我猜想她已经结婚了。

es.e: We ate with our fingers.
es.c: 我们用手抓着吃。

d: n 惊奇，诧异；突然袭击 the feeling you have when something unexpected or unusual happens；v 使惊奇；奇袭 to make someone feel surprised；adj 令人惊讶的

es.e: The man had a look of surprise on his face.
es.c: 那人脸上一副惊讶的表情。

d: v 分享，分担；分配 to let someone have or use something that belongs to you；n 份额；股份 one of the equal parts into which the  ownership  of a company is divided

es.e: As a kid he’d never share his toys.
es.c: 他小时候从不肯与人分享他的玩具。

d: n 底部；末端；臀部；尽头 the lowest part of something；adj 底部的 in the lowest place or position；v 装底；测量深浅；查明真相

es.e: The drugs had been hidden in a suitcase with a false bottom.
es.c: 毒品藏在一个带假底板的行李箱里。

d: adj 公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象] 晴朗的 treating everyone in a way that is right or equal；adv 公平地；直接地；清楚地 absolutely or squarely; quite；v 转晴；n 展览会；市集；美人 an outdoor event, at which there are large machines to ride on, games to play, and

es.e: Why does Eric get to go and I don’t? It’s not fair!
es.c: 为什么埃里克能去我不能？这不公平！

es.e: Life isn’t always fair.
es.c: 生活并非总是公平的。

es.e: My boss expects a lot – but he’s very fair.
es.c: 我的老板要求很高——但是他很公平。

d: n 点头；打盹；摆动 an act of nodding；v 点头；点头表示 to move your head up and down, especially in order to show agreement or understanding

es.e: The woman greeted us with a nod of the head.
es.c: 那个女人向我们点点头打招呼。

es.e: I showed the doorman my card and he gave a friendly nod.
es.c: 我向门卫出示了卡片，他友善地点了点头。

d: v 感谢 to tell someone that you are pleased and grateful for something they have done, or to be polite about it；n 感谢 When you express your thanks to someone, you express your gratitude to them for something；int 谢谢 When you

es.e: I haven’t had a chance to thank him yet.
es.c: 我还没有机会向他表示谢意。

es.e: They accepted their certificates with words of thanks.
es.c: 他们接过证书，同时表示了谢意。

es.e: They accepted their certificates with words of thanks.
es.c: 他们接过证书，同时表示了谢意。

d: adv 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着；prep 向，朝……；关于；在……之上；在……时候 used to say what part of someone or something is hit or touched；adj 开着的；发生着的，正在进行中 used to say that something is written somewhere；n (On)人名；(日)温(姓、名)；(缅、柬、印)翁

es.e: I wanted to punch him on the nose.
es.c: 我真想一拳打到他鼻子上。

es.e: Matt kissed her on the cheek.
es.c: 马特亲吻了她的脸颊。

d: adj 通常的，惯例的；平常的 happening, done, or existing most of the time or in most situations

es.e: Make a cheese sauce in the usual way.
es.c: 按通常的做法做奶酪酱。

es.e: I’ll meet you at the usual time.
es.c: 我在老时间和你碰头。

es.e: She ate twice as much as usual.
es.c: 她吃了平时食量两倍的东西。

d: v 改善，增进；提高…的价值 to make something better, or to become better

es.e: a course for students wishing to improve their English
es.c: 为想提高英语水平的学生开设的一门课

es.e: The doctors say she is improving (= after being ill ).
es.c: 医生说她正在康复。

es.e: You could use the money for improving your home.
es.c: 你可以用这笔钱改善家居。

d: n 稻；米饭 a food that consists of small white or brown grains that you boil in water until they become soft enough to eat；v 把…捣成米糊状

es.e: a tasty sauce served with rice or pasta
es.c: 配米饭或意面的美味酱汁

es.e: a plate of brown rice
es.c: 一盘糙米饭

es.e: Serve with plain boiled rice .
es.c: 配白米饭一起上桌。

d: n 神；（大写首字母时）上帝 the spirit or  being  who Christians, Jews, Muslims etc pray to, and who they believe created the universe；vt 膜拜，崇拜

es.e: Prayer is a way of talking to God.
es.c: 祈祷是同上帝交流的一种方式。

d: n 种类；方式；品质 a group or class of people, things etc that have similar qualities or features；v 分类；协调；交往 to put things in a particular order or arrange them in groups according to size, type etc

es.e: Most of the victims developed psychological problems of one sort or another (= of various different types ) .
es.c: 大多数受害者都出现了这样那样的心理问题。

es.e: They do burgers, pizzas, that sort of thing .
es.c: 他们供应汉堡包、比萨饼什么的。

d: n 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票 an international sports game；adj 国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的 relating to or involving more than one nation

es.e: the response of the international community
es.c: 国际社会的反响

es.e: the UN and other international organizations
es.c: 联合国和其他国际组织

d: adj 空的；无意义的；无知的；徒劳的 having nothing inside；v 使失去；使…成为空的 If you empty a container, or empty something out of it, you remove its contents, especially by tipping it up；n 空车；空的东西

es.e: an empty box
es.c: 空盒子

es.e: an empty bottle
es.c: 空瓶子

es.e: an empty space behind the desk
es.c: 书桌后面的空位

d: n 感觉，功能；观念；道理；理智 a feeling about something；v 感觉到；检测 if you sense something, you feel that it exists or is true, without being told or having proof

es.e: Cats have a very acute sense of hearing (= very good, so that they can hear even the smallest sound ) .
es.c: 猫的听觉非常敏锐。

d: adj 昂贵的；花钱的 costing a lot of money

es.e: the most expensive restaurant in town
es.c: 城里最贵的餐馆

es.e: Petrol is becoming more and more expensive.
es.c: 汽油越来越贵了。

es.e: Photography is an expensive hobby.
es.c: 摄影是一项很花钱的业余爱好。

d: v 举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭 to move something or someone upwards into the air；n 电梯；举起；起重机；搭车 a machine that you can ride in, that moves up and down between the floors in a tall building

es.e: Sophie lifted the phone before the second ring.
es.c: 铃响了一下苏菲就接起了电话。

es.e: He lifted the lid on the pot of soup.
es.c: 他揭开汤锅的盖子。

es.e: The lumber was lifted by crane and dropped into the truck.
es.c: 木材由起重机搬运到卡车上。

d: v 躺下；产卵；搁放；放置；铺放；涂，敷 to put someone or something down carefully into a flat position；adj 世俗的；外行的；没有经验的 not trained or not knowing much about a particular profession or subject；n 位置；短诗；花纹方向；叙事诗；性伙伴 a poem or song

es.e: He laid his hand on my shoulder.
es.c: 他把一只手搭在我的肩上。

es.e: They laid a wreath at the place where so many people died.
es.c: 他们在这么多人丧生的地方放了一个花圈。

es.e: Lay the material flat on the table.
es.c: 把布料平铺在桌上。

d: v 猜测；认为；推测；猜中 to try to answer a question or form an opinion when you are not sure whether you will be correct；n 猜测；推测 an attempt to answer a question or make a judgement when you are not sure whether you will be correct

es.e: I’d say he’s around 50, but I’m only guessing.
es.c: 我想他50岁左右，不过也只是猜测。

es.e: What star sign are you? No, let me guess .
es.c: 你是什么星座的？别说，让我来猜猜看。

d: adv 只是，仅仅；刚才，刚刚；正好，恰好；实在；刚要 exactly；adj 公正的，合理的；正直的，正义的；正确的；公平的；应得的 morally right and fair；n (Just)人名；(英)贾斯特；(法)朱斯特；(德、匈、波、捷、挪)尤斯特；(西)胡斯特

es.e: A good strong cup of coffee is just what I need right now.
es.c: 我现在正需要喝一杯浓浓的咖啡。

es.e: The house was large and roomy; just right for us.
es.c: 那幢房子大而宽敞，正合我们的需要。

es.e: She looks just like her mother.
es.c: 她看上去就像她妈妈。

d: adv 永远；曾经；究竟 for all time；n (Ever)人名；(英)埃弗；(俄)叶韦尔；(西、法)埃韦尔

es.e: Nothing lasts for ever.
es.c: 没有什么是永恒的。

d: adj 能；[经管] 有能力的；能干的 clever or good at doing something；n (Able)人名；(伊朗)阿布勒；(英)埃布尔

es.e: one of my more able students
es.c: 我班上能力比较强的学生之一

d: pron 她的（所有格） used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned；n (Hers)人名；(法)埃尔

es.e: He bent and touched his mouth to hers.
es.c: 他俯身吻她的嘴唇。

es.e: These are my gloves. Hers are in the drawer.
es.c: 这是我的手套，她的在抽屉里。

es.e: The idea was hers.
es.c: 这个主意是她出的。

d: adv 今天；现今 on the day that is happening now；n 今天；现今 the day that is happening now

es.e: I couldn’t go shopping yesterday so I’ll have to go today.
es.c: 我昨天没能去买东西，所以今天我必须去。

es.e: Ed has his music lesson today.
es.c: 埃德今天有音乐课。

d: n 主席，会长；董事长 someone, especially a man, who is in charge of a meeting or directs the work of a committee or an organization

es.e: deputy/vice chairman Barrett serves as vice chairman.
es.c: 巴雷特担任副主席一职。

d: n 政府；政体；管辖 the group of people who govern a country or state

es.e: The Government are planning further cuts in public spending.
es.c: 政府正计划进一步削减公共支出。

es.e: The US government has tightened restrictions on firearms.
es.c: 美国政府已经加强了对枪支的管制。

es.e: Neither party had the majority necessary to form a government.
es.c: 两个政党都没有获得组阁所必需的多数票。

d: n 照相机；摄影机 a piece of equipment used to take photographs or make films or television programmes

es.e: Her grandmother lent her a camera for a school trip to Venice and Egypt.
es.c: 她的祖母借给她一部相机，让她在学校组织的到威尼斯和埃及的旅行中使用。

d: prep 关于；属于；…的；由…组成的 used to show what a part belongs to or comes from

es.e: the back of the house
es.c: 房子的后部

es.e: the last scene of the movie
es.c: 电影的最后一个场景

es.e: the end of the day
es.c: 一天的末了

d: n 竹，竹子 a tall tropical plant with hollow stems that is used for making furniture；vt 为…装上篾条；adj 竹制的；土著居民的

es.e: Everything there is made of bamboo.
es.c: 那里什么都是竹子做的。

es.e: Do you like bamboo?
es.c: 你喜欢竹子吗?

d: n 工作；[物] 功；产品；操作；职业；行为；事业；工厂；著作；文学、音乐或艺术作品 a job or activity that you do regularly, especially in order to earn money；v 使工作；操作；经营；使缓慢前进 to do the activities and duties that are part of your job

es.e: There isn’t a lot of work at this time of the year.
es.c: 每年这个时候工作机会都不多。

es.e: He’s been out of work (= without a job ) for two years.
es.c: 他失业有两年了。

es.e: More people are in work (= have a job ) than ten years ago.
es.c: 现在有工作的人比十年前多。

d: prep 关于；大约 concerning or relating to a particular subject；adj 在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的；adv 大约；周围；到处 a little more or less than a particular number, amount, or size；n 大致；粗枝大叶；不拘小节的人

es.e: a book about politics
es.c: 一本有关政治的书

es.e: She said something about leaving town.
es.c: 她说了些要离开镇子的话。

es.e: He lied about his age.
es.c: 他谎报年龄。

d: n 家庭；亲属；家族；子女；[生]科；语族；[化]族 a group of people who are related to each other, especially a mother, a father, and their children；adj 家庭的；家族的；适合于全家的 You can use family to describe things that belong to a particular family

es.e: Do you know the family next door?
es.c: 你认识隔壁那家人吗？

es.e: The Webb family still has its farm over there.
es.c: 韦伯家依然保留着那里的农场。

es.e: The family now live in London.
es.c: 那家人现居伦敦。

d: v 欢呼；使高兴；为…加油 to shout as a way of showing happiness, praise, approval, or support of someone or something；n 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事 a shout of happiness, praise, approval, or encouragement

es.e: Everybody cheered when the firemen arrived.
es.c: 消防员到达时，大家都欢呼起来。

es.e: The audience was shouting and cheering.
es.c: 观众在呐喊欢呼。

es.e: The spectators cheered him wildly.
es.c: 观众拼命为他加油。

d: n 十二月 the 12th month of the year, between November and January

es.e: In the dark of December.
es.c: 在十二月的黑夜里。

es.e: Our summers are short and our winters long.In December, when it is darkest, we only have a few hours of very weak sunlight per day.
es.c: 我们的夏天很短但是冬天很长，在十二月，也就是最黑的时候，我们的一天中只有很短的时间可以看到微弱的阳光。

es.e: I send out Valentine’s cards with the girls’ photo, instead of trying to mail cards in December.
es.c: ——我寄出有女孩子照片的情人节贺卡，以代替试图在十二月寄出的贺卡。

d: adv 以前，以往 used to show how far back in the past something happened；adj 以前的；过去的；n (Ago)人名；(英、西、意、塞、瑞典)阿戈

es.e: They moved to a new house some time ago (=  a fairly long time ago  ) .
es.c: 他们搬进新居已有些日子了。

es.e: We had our bicentenary celebrations not that long ago.
es.c: 不久前，我们举行了200周年庆典活动。

d: n [作物] 土豆，[作物] 马铃薯 a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or pale yellow skin, that grows under the ground

es.e: Marie stood at the sink, peeling potatoes (= cutting off the skin ) .
es.c: 玛丽站在洗涤槽边削土豆皮。

d: adj 好的；不错的 satisfactory but not extremely good；adv 行；很好；int 好；可以 used to show that you agree with something or give permission for someone to do something；v 对…表示同意

es.e: ‘How was the film?’ ‘It was okay, but not brilliant.’
es.c: “电影怎么样？”“还算可以，但谈不上很好。”

es.e: I think I did okay in the exam.
es.c: 我觉得这次考试我考得还可以。

d: v 拥有；承认 to have something which belongs to you, especially because you have bought it, been given it etc and it is legally yours；adj 自己的；特有的 used to emphasize that something belongs to or is connected with a particular p

es.e: The building is owned by the local council.
es.c: 这幢大楼归地方议会所有。

es.e: You need to get permission from the farmer who owns the land.
es.c: 你要得到拥有这块土地的农场主同意。

es.e: Many more people now own their own homes.
es.c: 现在更多的人拥有了自己的住房。

d: v 取得；获得；实现；成功 to successfully complete something or get a good result, especially by working hard

es.e: Frances achieved very good exam results.
es.c: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

es.e: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
es.c: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

es.e: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
es.c: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

d: adj 完全的，完整的；满的，充满的；丰富的；完美的；丰满的；详尽的 containing as much or as many things or people as possible, so there is no space left；adv 十分，非常；完全地；整整；v 把衣服缝得宽大；n 全部；完整 including the whole of something

es.e: The train was completely full.
es.c: 火车坐得满满的。

es.e: Don’t talk with your mouth full.
es.c: 嘴里塞满东西时不要说话。

es.e: The class is full, but you can register for next term.
es.c: 这个班已经满了，不过你可以注册下学期的。

d: n 炊具；烹饪用水果；窜改者

es.e: a gas cooker
es.c: 煤气炉灶

d: v 讨论；论述，辩论 to talk about something with another person or a group in order to exchange ideas or decide something

es.e: Littman refused to discuss the case publicly.
es.c: 利特曼拒绝公开讨论此案。

es.e: If you would like to discuss the matter further, please call me.
es.c: 如果你想进一步讨论此事，请打电话给我。

d: adv 足够地，充足地 to the degree that is necessary or wanted；n 很多；充足 as many or as much as is needed or wanted；adj 充足的 Enough is also an adjective；int 够了！

es.e: Are the carrots cooked enough?
es.c: 胡萝卜煮熟了吗？

es.e: He just hadn’t thought enough about the possible consequences.
es.c: 他就是没有充分考虑可能造成的后果。

es.e: You can go to school when you’re old enough.
es.c: 你够年龄就可以上学了。

d: n 小山；丘陵；斜坡；山冈 an area of land that is higher than the land around it, like a mountain but smaller

es.e: Their house is on a hill overlooking the sea.
es.c: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

es.e: A cart was making its way up the hill.
es.c: 一辆马车正在爬上山丘。

d: n 香蕉；喜剧演员；大鹰钩鼻 a long curved tropical fruit with a yellow skin

es.e: ...a bunch of bananas.
es.c: …一串香蕉。

d: n 人；人类；民族；公民 used as the plural of ‘person’ to refer to men, women, and children；v 居住于；使住满人 if a country or area is peopled by people of a particular type, they live there

es.e: How many people were at the meeting?
es.c: 有多少人到会？

es.e: At least 40 people were killed.
es.c: 至少有40人遇害。

es.e: the people who live next door
es.c: 住在隔壁的那些人

d: n 笔记本，笔记簿；手册 a book made of plain paper on which you can write notes

es.e: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
es.c: 他从口袋里掏出了一个笔记本和一支钢笔。

d: n 协议；同意，一致 an arrangement or promise to do something, made by two or more people, companies, organizations etc

es.e: It is easier for two parties to reach agreement than for three.
es.c: 两方达成一致比三方达成一致容易。

d: n 回顾；复习；评论；检讨；检阅 a careful examination of a situation or process；v 回顾；检查；复审 to examine, consider, and judge a situation or process carefully in order to see if changes are necessary

es.e: The policy comes up for review (= will be reviewed ) in April.
es.c: 这项政策将在4月份予以审议。

es.e: All fees are subject to review(= may be reviewed ).
es.c: 所有费用有待审查。

es.e: Mr Crowther asked for judicial review of the decision(= an examination of the decision by a judge ).
es.c: 克劳瑟先生要求对判决进行司法审查。

d: n 中国；adj 中国的；中国制造的
pron [指无生命的东西、动物、植物]它；这；那 used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, idea etc that has already been mentioned or is already known about；abbr 信息技术information technology

es.e: ‘Where’s your office?’ ‘It’s on the third floor.’
es.c: “你的办公室在哪儿？”“在三楼。”

es.e: I love the spring – it’s a wonderful time of the year.
es.c: 我喜欢春季——这是一年里最美妙的时节。

es.e: There were people crying, buildings on fire. It was terrible!
es.c: 有人在哭喊，楼房在燃烧―太可怕了！

d: n 茶叶；茶树；茶点 a hot brown drink made by pouring boiling water onto the dried leaves from a particular Asian bush, or a cup of this drink；vt 给…沏茶；vi 喝茶；进茶点

es.e: Would you like a cup of tea or coffee?
es.c: 你想来一杯茶还是咖啡？

es.e: Do you take milk and sugar in your tea?
es.c: 你的茶里面要放牛奶和糖吗？

es.e: I’d like two teas and a piece of chocolate cake, please.
es.c: 我想要两杯茶和一块巧克力蛋糕。

d: v 预防，防止；阻止 to stop something from happening, or stop someone from doing something

es.e: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
es.c: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

es.e: We were prevented from entering the site.
es.c: 我们被阻止进入现场。

es.e: Wrap small ornaments in paper to prevent them being damaged.
es.c: 把小饰品用纸包上以免损坏。

d: adj 清楚的；清澈的；晴朗的；无罪的 expressed in a simple and direct way so that people understand；v 通过；清除；使干净；跳过 to make somewhere emptier or tidier by removing things from it；adv 清晰地；完全地；n 清除；空隙

es.e: clear instructions
es.c: 明确的指示

es.e: The question wasn’t very clear.
es.c: 这问题不是很清楚。

es.e: It’s the clearest guide I’ve used.
es.c: 我从没用过这么清晰易懂的指南。

d: n 冲进；匆促；急流；灯心草 a sudden fast movement of things or people；adj 急需的 requiring speed or urgency；v 使冲；突袭；匆忙地做；飞跃 to attack a person or place suddenly and in a group

es.e: At five past twelve there was a mad rush to the dinner hall.
es.c: 12点零5分，人们疯狂地冲向餐厅。

es.e: a rush job

d: adj 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的 belonging to a time long ago in history, especially thousands of years ago；n 古代人；老人 people who lived long ago, especially the Greeks and Romans

es.e: the ancient civilizations of Asia
es.c: 亚洲的古代文明

d: n 手提包 a small bag in which a woman carries money and personal things

es.e: I have sent  Tom back for your handbag.
es.c: 我已经让汤姆回去取你的手提袋了。

es.e: Will you please remove your handbag from the seat?
es.c: 您把您的手提包从座位上拿开好吗?

d: v 提议，建议；启发；使人想起；显示；暗示 to tell someone your ideas about what they should do, where they should go etc

es.e: The zoo asked its visitors to suggest a name for the new baby panda.
es.c: 动物园请游客提建议，给刚出生的大熊猫起一个名字。

es.e: It has been suggested that the manager will resign if any more players are sold.
es.c: 有人提议，如果再有球员被出售，球队主教练就辞职。

d: adj 值…的；n 价值；财产 an amount of something worth ten pounds, $500 etc

es.e: You should not deprecate your own worth.
es.c: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

d: n 飞机；平面；程度，水平 a vehicle that flies in the air and has wings and at least one engine；v 刨；乘飞机旅行；翱翔 if you plane a piece of wood, you make it smoother or smaller, using a plane；adj 平的；平面的 completely flat and smooth

es.e: It is a big airline with a large fleet of planes.
es.c: 这是一家大航空公司，拥有庞大的机群。

es.e: It’s much quicker to go by plane .
es.c: 乘飞机去会快很多。

es.e: She slept on the plane .
es.c: 她在飞机上睡着了。

d: n 三，三个 the number 3；num 三 the number 3；adj 三的，三个的

es.e: They’ve won their last three games.
es.c: 他们赢了最近三场比赛。

es.e: We’d better go. It’s almost three (= three o’clock ) .
es.c: 我们该走了。快3点了。

es.e: My little sister’s only three (= three years old ) .
es.c: 我的小妹妹只有3岁。

d: n 问候，招呼；祝贺 something you say or do when you meet someone；v 致敬，欢迎（greet的现在分词）

es.e: I smiled a polite greeting, but the woman hardly acknowledged me.
es.c: 我客气地笑着打了个招呼，可是那女人没有答理我。

es.e: The two cousins exchanged greetings (= greeted each other ) .
es.c: 表兄妹俩互相问候。

d: adj 不管什么样的；pron 无论什么；诸如此类；conj 无论什么
v 重复；复制；背诵 to do something again；n 重复；副本 the sign that tells a performer to play a piece of music again, or the music that is played again

es.e: Repeat the exercises twice a day.
es.c: 这套操每天做两次。

es.e: We must not repeat the mistakes of the past.
es.c: 我们不能再犯以前的错误。

es.e: The team are hoping to repeat their success (= achieve the same good result ) of last season.
es.c: 球队希望再续上一赛季的佳绩。

d: n 一月 the first month of the year, between December and February
