es.e: a spool of thread (= small object that thread is wound around )
es.c: 一卷线

d: n 熨斗；烙铁；坚强 a common hard metal that is used to make steel, is  magnetic  , and is found in very small quantities in food and blood. It is a chemical  element  : symbol Fe；v 熨；用铁铸成 to make clothes smooth using an iron；adj

es.e: the iron and steel industry
es.c: 钢铁工业

es.e: a driveway with large iron gates
es.c: 安装了大铁门的私家车道

es.e: the absorption of iron from food
es.c: 对食物中铁的吸收

d: num 六，六个 the number 6；n 六，六个 the number 6

es.e: six months ago
es.c: 六个月前

es.e: She arrived just after six (= six o’clock ) .
es.c: 她六点刚过就到了。

es.e: He learnt to play the violin when he was six (= six years old ) .
es.c: 他六岁学拉小提琴。

d: v 敲；打；敲击 to hit a door or window with your closed hand to attract the attention of the people inside；n 敲；敲打；爆震声 the sound of something hard hitting a hard surface

es.e: I knocked and knocked but nobody answered.
es.c: 我把门敲了又敲，但无人回应。

d: n 艺术；美术；艺术品 the use of painting, drawing,  sculpture  etc to represent things or express ideas；adj 艺术的；艺术品的 Arts or art is used to describe theatres that show plays or films that are intended to make the audience think d

es.e: the Museum of Modern Art in New York
es.c: 纽约现代艺术博物馆

es.e: an example of early Indian art
es.c: 印度早期艺术的范例

es.e: ...a lower Manhattan art theatre.
es.c: …下曼哈顿区的一座艺术剧院。

d: n 匆忙，急忙 more quickly than usual；v 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理 to make someone do something more quickly

es.e: Sorry, I can’t stop, I’m in a hurry.
es.c: 对不起，我不能停下，我赶时间。

es.e: You’ll make mistakes if you do things in too much of a hurry.
es.c: 做事太仓促会出错。

d: adj 人的；人类的 belonging to or relating to people, especially as opposed to machines or animals；n 人；人类 a person

es.e: There are many different cell types in the human body .
es.c: 人体中有许多种不同的细胞类型。

es.e: the power of the human mind
es.c: 人脑的威力

es.e: The desire for joy lies deep within the human spirit .
es.c: 对快乐的渴求藏在人类心灵深处。

d: n 岩石；摇滚乐；暗礁 a type of popular modern music with a strong loud beat, played using  guitar s  and drums；v 摇动；使摇晃 to make the future of something seem less certain or steady than it was before, especially because of problem

es.e: the late rock star, Freddie Mercury
es.c: 已故摇滚乐明星弗雷迪·默丘利

es.e: The stadium has hosted numerous rock concerts .
es.c: 这个体育场举行过许多场摇滚乐音乐会。

d: adj 又一，另一；另外的；不同的；pron 另一个；又一个；prep 另一个；另一个人

es.e: Can you cite another case like this one?
es.c: 你能举出另一个像这样的例子吗?

es.e: The conversation drifted from one subject to another.
es.c: 谈话从一个话题转到另一个话题。

es.e: She buddied up with a student from another university.
es.c: 她与来自另一大学的一名学生交朋友。

d: n 录音机；记录器；记录员；八孔直笛 a piece of electrical equipment that records music, films etc

es.e: Rodney put the recorder on the desk top and pushed the play button.
es.c: 罗德尼把录音机放在桌面上，按下了播放键。

d: n 十八，十八个 the number 18；adj 十八个的，十八的；num 十八 the number 18

es.e: At least eighteen bullets were fired.
es.c: 至少射出了18颗子弹。

es.e: Jim was eighteen (= 18 years old ).
es.c: 吉姆18岁。

d: v 背诵；叙述；列举 to say a poem, piece of literature etc that you have learned, for people to listen to

es.e: She recited a poem that she had learnt at school.
es.c: 她背诵了一首学校里学的诗。

d: n 种类；性质 one of the different types of a person or thing that belong to the same group；adj 和蔼的；宽容的；令人感激的 saying or doing things that show that you care about other people and want to help them or make them happy

es.e: Get me a sandwich – any kind will do.
es.c: 给我一份三明治，随便哪种都可以。

d: adj 多云的；阴天的；愁容满面的 a cloudy sky, day etc is dark because there are a lot of clouds

es.e: a cloudy night with some light rain
es.c: 伴有些许小雨的多云的夜晚

es.e: Tomorrow, it will be cloudy and cool.
es.c: 明天多云，天气凉爽。

d: n 背景；隐蔽的位置 someone’s family, education, previous work etc；v 作…的背景；adj 背景的；发布背景材料的

es.e: Students with a background in chemistry will probably find the course easier.
es.c: 学过化学的学生可能会觉得这门课程容易些。

es.e: It’s important to understand other people, people from different backgrounds .
es.c: 要理解别人，理解那些来自不同背景的人，这是很重要的。

es.e: Do you know anything about his background?
es.c: 关于他的背景，你知道什么吗？

d: n 年龄；时代；寿命，使用年限；阶段 the number of years someone has lived or something has existed；v 成熟；变老 to start looking older or to make someone or something look older

es.e: Francis is the same age as me.
es.c: 弗朗西斯和我同年岁。

es.e: Experts disagree over the age of the drawings.
es.c: 专家对这些画作的年代意见不统一。

es.e: Dad retired at the age of 56.
es.c: 爸爸是在56岁时退休的。

d: n 名称，名字；姓名；名誉 what someone is called；v 命名，任命；指定；称呼；提名；叫出 to give someone or something a particular name；adj 姓名的；据以取名的

es.e: Her name is Mandy Wilson.
es.c: 她的名字是曼迪•威尔逊。

es.e: What’s your name?
es.c: 你叫什么名字？

d: v 加；增加；加起来；做加法 to put something with something else or with a group of other things；n 加法，加法运算

es.e: If the mixture seems dry, add water.
es.c: 如果混合物看上去干，加点水。

d: n 年；年度；历年；年纪；一年的期间；某年级的学生 a period of about 365 days or 12 months, measured from any particular time

es.e: I arrived here two years ago.
es.c: 我两年前来到这里。

es.e: We’ve known each other for over a year.
es.c: 我们相识一年多了。

es.e: It’s almost a year since Sue died.
es.c: 休去世快一年了。

d: n 监狱；监禁；拘留所 a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial；vt 监禁，关押

es.e: He visits his dad in prison every week.
es.c: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

es.e: Ricky has been out of prison for three years now.
es.c: 里基现已出狱三年。

es.e: They’ll probably put him in prison for a long time.
es.c: 他们很可能会让他在监狱里待很长时间。

d: n [语][计] 句子，命题；宣判，判决 a group of words that usually contains a subject and a verb, and expresses a complete idea. Sentences written in English begin with a capital letter and usually end with a  full stop  or a  question

es.e: His voice dropped at the end of the sentence.
es.c: 到句子结尾处，他压低了嗓音。

d: n 裤子，长裤 a piece of clothing that covers the lower half of your body, with a separate part fitting over each leg

es.e: His trousers were slightly too short.
es.c: 他的裤子有点短。

es.e: I need a new pair of trousers for work.
es.c: 我需要一条上班穿的新裤子。

d: adv 无论如何，不管怎样；总之 in spite of the fact that you have just mentioned

es.e: Catherine wasn’t sure the book was the right one, but she bought it anyway.
es.c: 凯瑟琳不能确定就是这本书，但她还是买了。

es.e: This idea probably won’t work, but let’s try it anyway.
es.c: 这个办法可能行不通，不过我们还是试试吧。

d: n 光；光线；灯；打火机；领悟；浅色；天窗 one of a set of red, green, and yellow lights used for controlling traffic；adj 轻的；浅色的；明亮的；轻松的；容易的；清淡的 a light colour is pale and not dark；v 点着；变亮；着火 to provide light for a place；adv 轻地；清楚地；轻便地

es.e: We waited for the lights to change.
es.c: 我们等着红绿灯转换。

es.e: Eventually the lights turned green.
es.c: 绿灯终于亮了。

es.e: The driver had failed to stop at a red light.
es.c: 红灯亮时司机没有把车停下。

d: v 提供；出价；试图 to ask someone if they would like to have something, or to hold something out to them so that they can take it；n 提议；出价；意图；录取通知书 a statement saying that you are willing to do something for someone or give them

es.e: A number of groups offer their services free of charge.
es.c: 一些团体免费提供服务。

d: adj 危险的 able or likely to harm or kill you

es.e: laws about dangerous dogs
es.c: 有关危险犬类的法律

es.e: Some of these prisoners are extremely dangerous.
es.c: 这些囚犯中有些极为危险。

es.e: The powdered milk was not as good as breast milk, and was downright dangerous (= actually dangerous ) when it was mixed with unclean water.
es.c: 奶粉没有母乳好，用不洁净的水冲调更会造成危险。

d: n 红色，红颜料；赤字 the colour of blood；adj 红色的；红肿的，充血的 having the colour of blood

es.e: I like the way the artist uses red in this painting.
es.c: 我喜欢画家在这幅作品中对红色的运用。

es.e: the reds and yellows of the trees
es.c: 红黄斑斓，层林尽染

es.e: The corrections were marked in red (= in red ink ) .
es.c: 修改处用红笔标出。

d: n [计量] 公里；[计量] 千米（等于kilometre）

es.e: She had to battle snowstorms, landslides, snakes and loneliness on her 350 kilometer journey.
es.c: 在350公里的行程中，她要克服暴风雪、滑坡、蛇和孤独寂寞。

es.e: But it says food grown and harvested in the 30-kilometer exclusion zone after the emergency might be contaminated and should be avoided.
es.c: 但是，该组织说，事故发生后，在30公里禁区内种植和收获的食物可能受到污染，应该避免食用。

es.e: For example, the researchers last week said they had managed to gather enough energy from a TV station a half-kilometer away to power a small temperature sensor.
es.c: 例如，研究人员上周说，他们已经设法从半公里远的一座电视发射台收集了足够了能量给一个小型温度传感器供电。

d: n 亚洲

es.e: The European powers extended their authority in Asia.
es.c: 欧洲列强在亚洲扩大他们的管辖权。

es.e: The teacher chalked out a map of Asia on the blackboard.
es.c: 老师用粉笔在黑板上画了一张亚洲地图。

es.e: His extensive experience in other parts of Asia helped him to overcome cultural barriers.
es.c: 在亚洲其他地区的广泛经历帮助他克服了文化障碍。

d: n 窗；窗口；窗户 a space or an area of glass in the wall of a building or vehicle that lets in light

es.e: Television provides us with a useful window on the world.
es.c: 电视为我们提供了了解世界的有用渠道。

d: n 温度；体温；气温；发烧 a measure of how hot or cold a place or thing is

es.e: The temperature of the water was just right for swimming.
es.c: 这水温游泳正好。

es.e: Water boils at a temperature of 100˚C.
es.c: 水在100摄氏度沸腾。

d: adj 医学的；药的；内科的 relating to medicine and the treatment of disease or injury；n 医生；体格检查 an examination of your body by a doctor to see if you are healthy

es.e: medical research
es.c: 医学研究

es.e: medical staff
es.c: 医务人员

es.e: a medical student
es.c: 医科学生

d: n 自然；性质；本性；种类 everything in the physical world that is not controlled by humans, such as wild plants and animals, earth and rocks, and the weather

es.e: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
es.c: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

es.e: nature conservation
es.c: 自然保护

es.e: Disease is nature’s way of keeping the population down.
es.c: 疾病是大自然控制人口的方法。

d: n 筷子

es.e: We still lack a pair of chopsticks.
es.c: 还少一双筷子。

es.e: Before lunch he learned the foreigner how to use chopsticks.
es.c: 午饭前他教那个外国人怎样使筷子。

es.e: If you want your friend to try something they should pick it up from your plate with their own chopsticks.
es.c: 如果你想让你的朋友尝尝某道菜时，应该让他们用他们自己的筷子从你的盘中夹。

d: n 增加，增长；提高 a rise in amount, number, or degree；v 增加，增大；繁殖 if you increase something, or if it increases, it becomes bigger in amount, number, or degree

es.e: Recent tax increases have affected the poor more than the rich.
es.c: 新近的增税对穷人的影响比对富人的大。

es.e: the dramatic increase in the population aged over 65
es.c: 65岁以上人口的急剧增加

es.e: There has been a marked increase in the use of firearms.
es.c: 使用枪支的人数显著增加了。

d: n 会议；讨论；协商；联盟；（正式）讨论会；[工会、工党用语]（每年的）大会 a large formal meeting where a lot of people discuss important matters such as business, politics, or science, especially for several days；vi 举行或参加（系列）会议

es.e: Representatives from over 100 countries attended the International Peace Conference in Geneva.
es.c: 来自一百多个国家的代表出席了在日内瓦举行的国际和平大会。

d: n 赞扬；称赞；荣耀；崇拜 words that you say or write in order to praise someone or something；v 赞美，歌颂；表扬 to say that you admire and approve of someone or something, especially publicly

es.e: It’s important to give children plenty of praise and encouragement.
es.c: 对小孩子多加表扬和鼓励是很重要的。

es.e: Her teacher was full of praise for her work.
es.c: 老师对她的作业赞不绝口。

es.e: His first novel received high praise .
es.c: 他的第一部小说受到了高度赞扬。

d: adv 在国外；到海外 in or to a foreign country；adj 往国外的；n 海外；异国

es.e: I’ve never lived abroad before.
es.c: 我以前从未在国外生活过。

es.e: She often goes abroad on business.
es.c: 她经常出国公干。

es.e: We never travelled abroad when we were kids.
es.c: 我们小时候从来没有去国外旅行过。

d: conj 也不；也不是 used when mentioning two things that are not true or do not happen；adv 也不；也没有；n (Nor)人名；(中)挪(广东话·威妥玛)；(马来、俄)诺尔；(柬)诺

es.e: He can neither read nor write (= he cannot read or write ).
es.c: 他既不会读也不会写。

es.e: Hilary was neither shocked nor surprised by the news.
es.c: 希拉里对这个消息既没有感到震惊，也没有觉得意外。

es.e: Neither Matt nor Julie said anything.
es.c: 马特和朱莉都没有说什么。

d: n 健身房；体育；体育馆 a special building or room that has equipment for doing physical exercise

es.e: I go to the gym as often as I can.
es.c: 我一有空就去健身房健身。

d: n 创伤，伤口 an injury to your body that is made by a weapon such as a knife or a bullet；v 使受伤

es.e: A nurse cleaned and bandaged the wound.
es.c: 护士把伤口清洗包扎好。

es.e: It took several months for his wounds to heal .
es.c: 他的伤口几个月后才愈合。

es.e: The doctor said it was only a flesh wound (= one that does not cut the skin very deeply ) .
es.c: 医生说那只是皮肉伤。

d: pron 你的，你们的

es.e: You should keep in with your colleagues.
es.c: 你应当与你的同事友好相处。

es.e: You should not deprecate your own worth.
es.c: 你不应该贬低你自己的价值。

d: v 同意，赞成；承认；约定，商定 to have or express the same opinion about something as someone else

es.e: Teenagers and their parents rarely agree.
es.c: 十几岁的孩子跟父母意见很少一致。

d: n 问题，疑问；询问；疑问句 a sentence or phrase that is used to ask for information or to test someone’s knowledge；v 询问；怀疑；审问 to ask someone questions in order to get information about something such as a crime

es.e: Can I ask you a question?
es.c: 我能问你个问题吗？

es.e: I’m afraid I can’t answer that question.
es.c: 我恐怕无法回答那个问题。

d: n 飞行员；领航员 someone who operates the controls of an aircraft or spacecraft；adj 试点的 A pilot plan or a pilot project is one that is used to test an idea before deciding whether to introduce it on a larger scale；v 驾驶；领航；试用 to

es.e: an airline pilot
es.c: 航空公司飞行员

es.e: a fighter pilot
es.c: 战斗机驾驶员

es.e: The official report into the accident says that it was caused by pilot error (= a mistake by the pilot ) .
es.c: 那宗事故的官方报告称事故是由飞行员失误造成的。

d: adv 大声地；出声地 if you read, laugh, say something etc aloud, you read etc so that people can hear you

es.e: When we were children, our father read aloud to us.
es.c: 当我们是孩子时，我们的父亲大声地朗读给我们听。

d: n 十一；十一个 the number；adj 十一的；十一个的；num 十一；十一个 the number

es.e: She was sent to jail for eleven months.
es.c: 她被判入狱11个月。

es.e: I never go to bed before eleven (= 11 o’clock ).
es.c: 我从不在11点钟以前上床睡觉。

es.e: James had worked every summer since he was eleven (= 11 years old ).
es.c: 詹姆斯自11岁起每年夏天都打工。

d: adj 无聊的；令人厌烦的 not interesting in any way；n 钻孔 the act or process of making or enlarging a hole；v 钻孔；使厌烦；挖空（bore的ing形式）

es.e: Her husband is about the most boring person I’ve ever met.
es.c: 她丈夫可以说是我见过的最无聊的人。

es.e: The job was dull and boring.
es.c: 这份工作枯燥乏味。

d: adj 残酷的，残忍的；使人痛苦的，让人受难的；无情的，严酷的 making someone suffer or feel unhappy

es.e: His death was a cruel blow .
es.c: 他的死是个无情的打击。

es.e: Sometimes life seems unbearably cruel.
es.c: 有时候生活残酷得让人无法承受。

d: adj 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的 worried or frightened about something, and unable to relax

es.e: I wish you’d stop looking at me like that. You’re making me nervous.
es.c: 我希望你不要再那样看着我了，你让我紧张。

es.e: By the time I got into the interview I was a nervous wreck (= was extremely nervous ).
es.c: 到了面试的时候，我紧张得要命。

d: adv 是, 是的 used as an answer to say that you want something or want to do something；n 是（表示肯定）

es.e: ‘Would you like a sandwich?’ ‘Yes, please.’
es.c: “你想来个三明治吗？”“好的，谢谢。”

es.e: ‘Would you like to come with us?’ ‘Yes, I’d love to.’
es.c: “你想和我们一起去吗？”“好的，我很乐意。”

d: n 河，江 a natural and continuous flow of water in a long line across a country into the sea

es.e: the Mississippi River
es.c: 密西西比河

es.e: the River Thames
es.c: 泰晤士河

d: n 澳大利亚，澳洲

es.e: He transplanted his family to Australia.
es.c: 他把家迁到澳大利亚。

es.e: He went out to Australia about five years ago.
es.c: 他大约在五年前移居澳大利亚。

es.e: Australia won the toss and put England in to bat.
es.c: 澳大利亚队掷币获胜，要求英格兰队首先击球。

d: n 医院 a large building where sick or injured people receive medical treatment

es.e: They are building a new hospital.
es.c: 他们正在建一家新医院。

d: n 训练；培养；瞄准；整枝 the process of teaching or being taught the skills for a particular job or activity；v 训练；教养（train的ing形式）

es.e: Police drivers have to undergo intensive training .
es.c: 警察驾驶员都得接受强化训练。

es.e: a rigorous training session
es.c: 一节严格的训练课

es.e: On-the-job training will be supplemented by classroom lectures.
es.c: 除了在职培训，还将有课堂授课作为补充。

d: n 克隆；无性系；无性繁殖；靠营养生殖而由母体分离繁殖的植物 an animal or plant produced by scientists from one cell of another animal or plant, so that they are exactly the same；v 无性繁殖，复制 to make an exact copy of a plant or animal by taking a cell f
n 消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词 a spoken or written piece of information that you send to another person or leave for them；v 报信，报告；[通信] 报文

es.e: He left a message saying he would probably be a little late.
es.c: 他留言说可能会晚一点来。

d: num 六十；六十个 the number

es.e: sixty years ago
es.c: 六十年前

d: n 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼 physical activities that you do in order to stay healthy and become stronger；v 锻炼；练习；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐 to use a power, right, or quality that you have

es.e: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
es.c: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

es.e: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
es.c: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

d: n 村庄；村民；（动物的）群落 a very small town in the countryside

es.e: a little fishing village
es.c: 一座小渔村

d: adj 安全的；可靠的；平安的 not in danger of being harmed, lost, or stolen；n 保险箱；冷藏室；纱橱 a strong metal box or cupboard with special locks where you keep money and valuable things

es.e: She doesn’t feel safe in the house on her own.
es.c: 她独自一人在家感到不安全。

es.e: Make sure you keep these documents safe .
es.c: 你一定要妥善保管这些文件。

d: v 结果实，开花（正式） if a tree bears fruit, it produces fruit；n 熊 a large strong animal with thick fur, that eats flesh, fruit, and insects

es.e: As the plants grow and start to bear fruit they will need a lot of water.
es.c: 随着植物的生长及开始结果，它们将需要大量的水分。

d: n 毛线衣，运动衫；大量出汗的人，发汗剂 a piece of warm wool or cotton clothing with long sleeves, which covers the top half of your body

es.e: Somebody pinched my sweater.
es.c: 有人偷了我的运动衫。

d: n 游戏；比赛 a children’s activity in which they play with toys, pretend to be someone else etc；adj 勇敢的 If you are game for something, you are willing to do something new, unusual, or risky；v 赌博 to play games of chance for mo

es.e: The boys were playing a game in the backyard.
es.c: 男孩们在后院里玩游戏。

es.e: He said he's game for a similar challenge next year.
es.c: 他说明年他敢尝试一次类似的挑战。

d: n 价格；价值；代价 the amount of money you have to pay for something；v 给……定价；问……的价格 to decide the price of something that is for sale

es.e: They may pay a high price for their few years of glory.
es.c: 为了短短几年的辉煌，他们也许要付出高昂的代价。

d: n 星期四 the day between Wednesday and Friday

es.e: She was working Thursday.
es.c: 她星期四在工作。

d: n 肥皂 the substance that you use to wash your body；v 将肥皂涂在……上；对……拍马屁（俚语） to rub soap on or over someone or something

es.e: Wash thoroughly with soap and water .
es.c: 用肥皂和水彻底洗一洗。

es.e: a bar of soap
es.c: 一块肥皂

d: n 意图；目的；意向；愈合 a plan or desire to do something

es.e: They went into town with the intention of visiting the library.
es.c: 他们进了城，打算参观图书馆。

d: n 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节 the process of doing something, especially in order to achieve a particular thing

es.e: The government must take action (=  do something  ) now to stop the rise in violent crime.
es.c: 政府现在必须采取行动遏止暴力犯罪的上升。

es.e: She was looking forward to putting her ideas into action (=  doing the things she had planned  ) .
es.c: 她盼望着将自己的想法付诸实施。

es.e: Ambulance crews are ready to spring into action (=  suddenly start doing something  ) if anything goes wrong during the race.
es.c: 救护车急救人员随时准备出动，以应对比赛期间发生的意外。

d: n 理智，精神；意见；智力；记忆力 used to show you are giving your opinion about something；v 介意；专心于；照料 to feel annoyed or upset about something

es.e: The Internet, to my mind, represents information exchange at its best.
es.c: 因特网在我看来是最好的信息交换方式。

d: n 食物；养料 things that people and animals eat, such as vege-tables or meat

es.e: The restaurant serves good food at affordable prices.
es.c: 那家餐厅物美价廉。

es.e: I love Italian food, especially pasta.
es.c: 我喜欢意大利食物，尤其是面食。

es.e: He was told to cut down on salty and fatty foods.
es.c: 他被告知要少吃过咸和油腻的食物。

d: v 坚持，强调 to demand that something should happen

es.e: Stay for supper – I insist!
es.c: 留下来吃晚餐——一定的！

d: n 计划；平面图 something you have decided to do；v 计划；设计；打算 to think carefully about something you want to do, and decide how and when you will do it

es.e: His plan is to get a degree in economics and then work abroad for a year.
es.c: 他计划先取得经济学学位，然后去国外工作一年。

es.e: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
es.c: 你周末有什么打算？

es.e: There’s been a change of plan – we’re not going to Ibiza after all.
es.c: 计划有变，我们终究还是不去伊维萨岛了。

d: n 农夫，农民

es.e: She dickered with the farmer for the best fruit.
es.c: 她要买最好的水果而跟农民讨价还价。

es.e: The farmer peddled his fruit from house to house.
es.c: 那个农民挨家挨户兜售他的水果。

es.e: As a farmer, you should learn how to yoke the oxen together.
es.c: 作为农民，你应该学会怎样把一对牛用轭连起来。

d: v 修理，修补；改善；修改 to repair a tear or hole in a piece of clothing；n 好转，改进；修补处 to be getting better after an illness or after a difficult period

es.e: My father used to mend our shoes.
es.c: 我父亲过去常为我们修补鞋子。

d: n 胸，胸部；衣柜；箱子；金库 the front part of your body between your neck and your stomach

es.e: Her heart was pounding in her chest.
es.c: 她的心在胸口怦怦直跳。

es.e: a hairy chest
es.c: 毛茸茸的胸部

d: v 警告，提醒；通知 to tell someone that something bad or dangerous may happen, so that they can avoid it or prevent it；n (Warn)人名；(英)沃恩；(德)瓦恩

es.e: ‘Be careful, the rocks are slippery,’ Alex warned.
es.c: “小心，岩石很滑。”亚历克斯提醒说。

d: n 眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点 one of the two parts of the body that you use to see with；v 注视，看 to look at someone or something carefully, especially because you do not trust them or because you want something

es.e: He’s got beautiful eyes.
es.c: 他有一双漂亮的眼睛。

es.e: There were tears in her eyes as she listened to the story.
es.c: 她听故事时眼里噙着泪水。

es.e: Ow! I’ve got something in my eye!
es.c: 哎呀！我眼睛里进了什么东西！

d: n 演讲者；扬声器；说话者；说某种语言的人 someone who makes a formal speech to a group of people

es.e: The keynote speaker (= main or most important speaker ) was Robert Venturi, the architect.
es.c: 主要发言人是建筑师罗伯特·文图里。

d: n 钢琴 a large musical instrument that has a long row of black and white  key s  . You play the piano by sitting in front of it and pressing the keys.

es.e: Jean accompanied her on the piano .
es.c: 琼为她钢琴伴奏。

d: n 药；医学；内科；巫术 a substance used for treating illness, especially a liquid you drink；v 用药物治疗；给…用药

es.e: Medicines should be kept out of the reach of children.
es.c: 药应放在孩子够不到的地方。

es.e: Have you been taking your medicine ?
es.c: 你一直在服药吗？

es.e: a medicine bottle
es.c: 药瓶

d: n 军人；[昆] 兵蚁；懒汉；一片烤面包 a member of the army of a country, especially someone who is not an officer；v 当兵；磨洋工；坚持干；假称害病

es.e: A British soldier was wounded in the fighting.
es.c: 战斗中，有一名英国士兵受了伤。

es.e: an enemy soldier
es.c: 敌兵

d: n 野餐 if you have a picnic, you take food and eat it outdoors, especially in the country；v 去野餐 to have a picnic

es.e: We decided to have a picnic down by the lake.
es.c: 我们决定在湖边野餐。

es.e: a picnic table
es.c: 野餐桌

es.e: There is free parking for visitors, as well as a restaurant and picnic area (= a special area with tables where people can have a picnic ) .
es.c: 除了餐厅和野餐区，我们还为游客提供免费停车位。

d: v 控制；精通；征服 to learn a skill or a language so well that you have no difficulty with it；n 硕士；主人；大师；教师 someone who is very skilled at something；adj 主人的；主要的；熟练的 most important or main

es.e: the skills needed to master a new language
es.c: 掌握一门新语言所需的技能

es.e: I never quite mastered the art of walking in high heels.
es.c: 我一直学不会穿高跟鞋走路。

d: n 盐；风趣，刺激性 a natural white mineral that is added to food to make it taste better or to preserve it；adj 咸水的；含盐的，咸味的；盐腌的；猥亵的 preserved with salt；v 用盐腌；给…加盐；将盐撒在道路上使冰或雪融化 to add salt to food to make it taste better

es.e: This might need some salt and pepper.
es.c: 这里面也许要加点盐和胡椒粉。

es.e: a pinch of salt
es.c: 一撮盐

es.e: Could you pass the salt?
es.c: 递一下盐好吗？

d: adj 澳大利亚的，澳大利亚人的 relating to Australia or its people；n 澳大利亚人 someone from Australia

es.e: She went solo backpacking for eight months in the Australian outback.
es.c: 她在澳大利亚内陆独自背包旅行了八个月。

d: n 分数；二十；配乐；刻痕 a written or printed copy of a piece of music, especially for a large group of performers, or the music itself；v 获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下 to win a point in a sport, game, competition, or test

es.e: a musical score
es.c: 乐谱

es.e: Who wrote the score for the movie?
es.c: 这部电影的配乐是谁谱写的？

d: num 第十；十分之一 one of ten equal parts of something；adj 十分之一的；第十个的 coming after nine other things in a series

es.e: in the tenth century
es.c: 在10世纪

es.e: her tenth birthday
es.c: 她的10岁生日

d: v 发明；创造；虚构 to make, design, or think of a new type of thing

es.e: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876.
es.c: 亚历山大 · 格雷厄姆 · 贝尔于1876年发明了电话。

d: adv 其他；否则；另外 besides or in addition to someone or something；adj 别的；其他的 You use else after words such as "anywhere," "someone," and "what" to refer in a vague way to another person, place, or thing；n (Else)人名；(英)埃尔斯；(德)埃尔

es.e: There’s something else I’d like to talk about as well.
es.c: 我还有其他事情要谈一谈。

es.e: I’d like you to come, and anyone else who’s free.
es.c: 我想请你过来，其他人有空也可以来。

es.e: He was awake now, as was everyone else.
es.c: 他现在已经醒了，其他人也都醒了。

d: adj 简单的；单纯的；天真的 not difficult or complicated to do or understand；n 笨蛋；愚蠢的行为；出身低微者

es.e: a simple but effective solution to the problem
es.c: 对这个问题简单而有效的解决办法

es.e: There is no simple answer to this question.
es.c: 这个问题没有简单的答案。

es.e: I’m sure there’s a perfectly simple explanation.
es.c: 我相信一定有一个很简单的解释。

d: v 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖 If you depend on someone or something, you need them in order to be able to survive physically, financially, or emotionally

es.e: He depended on his writing for his income.
es.c: 他靠写作谋生。

d: n 真理；事实；诚实；实质 the true facts about something, rather than what is untrue, imagined, or guessed

es.e: How do we know you’re telling us the truth?
es.c: 我们怎么知道你告诉我们的是真话？

d: v 进入；开始；参加 to start working in a particular profession or organization, or to start studying at a school or university；n [计] 输入；回车

es.e: Both the boys entered the army.
es.c: 两个男孩都参了军。

es.e: She entered politics in 1996.
es.c: 她于1996年进入政界。

es.e: He entered the Church (= became a priest ) as a young man.
es.c: 他年轻时就领了圣职。

d: conj 考虑到；既然；当…时；在…时；如果；adv 什么时候，何时；（用于时间的表达方式之后）在那时；其时；当时 at what time；pron 那时；什么时侯；n 时间，时候；日期；场合

es.e: When are we leaving?
es.c: 我们什么时候走？

es.e: When did you first meet Dr Darnall?
es.c: 你是什么时候认识达纳尔博士的？

es.e: When will the work be finished?
es.c: 这项工作什么时候完成？

d: adj 和平的；温和的；平静的 peaceful and loving or wanting peace；n 太平洋

es.e: a normally pacific community
es.c: 平日里静悄悄的社区

d: n 方面；侧面；旁边 one of the two areas that are on the left or the right of an imaginary line, or on the left or the right of a border, wall, river etc；v 支持；赞助；偏袒 to support or argue against a person or group in a quarrel, figh

es.e: Fuel is cheaper on the French side of the border.
es.c: 燃料在边境那边的法国要便宜些。

es.e: A man stood watching me from the other side of the road.
es.c: 有个男人站在马路的对面看着我。

es.e: His friends and family were all on the other side of the world.
es.c: 他的朋友和家人都在地球的另一边。

d: n 姐妹；（称志同道合者）姐妹；修女；护士 a girl or woman who has the same parents as you；adj 姐妹般的；同类型的 You can use sister to describe something that is of the same type or is connected in some way to another thing you have mentioned. For e

es.e: Janet and Abby are sisters.
es.c: 珍妮特和阿比是两姐妹。

es.e: He has two sisters and a brother.
es.c: 他有两个姊妹和一个弟弟。

es.e: She’s my twin sister .
es.c: 她是我的孪生妹妹。

d: n 护照，通行证；手段 a small official document that you get from your government, that proves who you are, and which you need in order to leave your country and enter other countries

es.e: I have an Irish passport.
es.c: 我持爱尔兰护照。

es.e: They need to check that your passport is in order.
es.c: 他们要检查一下你的护照是否有效。

d: n 伦敦

es.e: He was nursed in London.
es.c: 他是在伦敦长大的。

es.e: I trained to London.
es.c: 我乘火车到伦敦。

es.e: He hopped to and fro between London and Paris for the business.
es.c: 为了这笔生意他曾不停地往返于伦敦和巴黎。

d: prep 为，为了；因为；给；对于；至于；适合于 used to say who is intended to get or use something, or where something is intended to be used；conj 因为 used to introduce the reason for something

es.e: I’ve got a present for you.
es.c: 我有件礼物送给你。

es.e: Someone left a message for Vicky.
es.c: 有人给维基留了言。

es.e: an English course for foreign students
es.c: 为外国学生开的一门英语课程

d: adj 大的；多数的；广博的 big in size, amount, or number；adv 大大地；夸大地；n 大

es.e: Los Angeles is the second largest city in the US.
es.c: 洛杉矶是美国的第二大城市。

es.e: The T-shirt comes in Small, Medium and Large.
es.c: 这种T恤有小号、中号和大号。

es.e: a large ovenproof pan
es.c: 一只耐热的大烤盘

d: n 使用；用途；发挥 the action or fact of using something；v 利用；耗费 to take an amount of something from a supply of food, gas, money etc

es.e: an exit for use in emergencies
es.c: 紧急出口

d: adj 好的；优良的；细小的，精美的；健康的；晴朗的 in good health；n 罚款 money that you have to pay as a punishment；v 罚款；澄清；adv 很好地；精巧地 in a way that is satisfactory or acceptable

es.e: ‘How are you?’ ‘Fine, thanks, how are you?’
es.c: “你好吗？”“很好，谢谢，你呢？”

es.e: I feel fine , really.
es.c: 我感觉很好，真的。
